matches.title: Steady translation of a chemically active viscous drop along a rigid wall
matches.title_zh: 化学活性粘性液滴沿刚性壁稳定平移
matches.authors: Desai, Nikhil, Michelin, Sébastien
matches.abstract_zh: 化学活性液滴释放化学溶质，其浓度梯度导致界面流动，使释放的溶质平流。如果系统的佩克莱特数 Pe（平流与扩散溶质传输的比率）大于有限阈值，则溶质分布和流体流动之间的非线性耦合会导致液滴通过平流不稳定性游动。理论分析通常将活性液滴建模为扩散电泳驱动的活性粒子，主要是为了简化液滴表面边界条件的实现。然而，依赖于这种简化的关于液滴运动的物理见解存在对液滴的适用性有限的风险，特别是当液滴与其环境发生化学流体动力学相互作用时。为此，我们在这里研究化学活性粘性液滴平行于刚性壁的平移，在刚性壁上它受到外力的限制。我们考虑了一种推进机制，其中液滴由于界面马兰戈尼应力和扩散电泳流而游动，并将我们的结果与“各向同性活性粒子”模型的结果进行比较，以检查后者的有效性。我们的分析表明，对于相同的限制力，粘性较小的水滴比较粘性较高的水滴游得更靠近壁。由于驱动水滴运动的浓度梯度更强，这会导致游泳速度更快。还表明，对于中等 Pe ，液滴的游动速度弱取决于其迁移率（扩散电泳和马兰戈尼流的相对强度）。这种弱依赖性为研究扩散电泳驱动的活性粒子以推断马兰戈尼应力驱动的活性液滴的运动提供了定量依据。
matches.abstract_en: Chemically active drops release a chemical solute, gradients in the concentration of which cause interfacial flows that advect the emitted solute. This nonlinear coupling between solute distribution and fluid flow causes the drop to swim via an advective instability, if the system’s Péclet number Pe – ratio of advective to diffusive solute transport – is larger than a finite threshold. Theoretical analyses often model active drops as diffusiophoresis-driven active particles, primarily to simplify the implementation of boundary conditions at the drop surface. However, physical insights about drop motion that rely on this simplification risk having limited applicability to fluid drops, especially when the drop is interacting chemohydrodynamically with its environment. Towards this, we study here the translation of a chemically active viscous drop parallel to a rigid wall, where it is confined by an external force. We consider a propulsion mechanism where the drop swims due to interfacial Marangoni stresses and diffusiophoretic flows, and compare our results with those of the ‘isotropic active particle’ model, to examine the validity of the latter. Our analysis shows that, for the same confining force, a less viscous drop swims closer to the wall than a more viscous drop. This results in faster swimming, due to stronger concentration gradients driving the drop’s motion. It is also shown that for moderate Pe , the swimming speed of the drop depends weakly on its mobility ratio (relative strength of diffusiophoretic and Marangoni flows). This weak dependence provides a quantitative justification for studying diffusiophoresis-driven active particles to infer the motion of Marangoni-stress-driven active drops.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop、drops、Marangoni、Marangoni flows、Marangoni stresses、interfacial；降权方法：model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Ultrasound-controlled stream splitting in a microfluidic coflow
matches.title_zh: 微流体协流中的超声控制流分裂
matches.authors: Ghosh, Debasish, Hoque, Sazid Zamal, Sujith, T., Satpathi, Niladri S., Malik, Lokesh, Sen, Ashis Kumar
matches.abstract_zh: 多相微流体的精确控制支撑着从化学加工到生物医学诊断的各种应用。我们研究了矩形微通道中液-液共流对外部施加的驻声场的响应。声激发破坏了原本稳定的界面的稳定性，产生了一系列可逆的界面状态：波纹、分裂、重新定位和流-液滴破碎。值得注意的是，出现了一种独特的分裂机制，其中连续流在可调节位置部分分裂成液滴，同时保留细小的残余流。与传统的液滴破碎不同，这种方式避免了主流的完全破坏，能够以高毛细管数生成液滴，并允许对液滴形成进行空间控制。扩展到广泛的毛细管数量，我们研究了流动条件和施加的声功率的变化如何影响这些状态。结合实验、数值模拟和理论尺度，我们阐明了控制这种液滴生成模式和相关状态转变的机制。系统测量表明，液滴尺寸和残余流厚度主要由流体动力学参数控制，而声输入功率控制破裂的开始和空间位置。这些结果为微流体协流中的流分裂和按需液滴生成建立了一个简单的途径，为多相流的空间可编程操纵开辟了新的可能性。
matches.abstract_en: Precise control of multiphase microfluidic flows underpins applications ranging from chemical processing to biomedical diagnostics. We investigate the response of a liquid–liquid coflow in a rectangular microchannel to an externally applied standing acoustic field. Acoustic excitation destabilises an otherwise stable interface, giving rise to a sequence of reversible interfacial regimes: waviness, splitting, relocation and stream–droplet breakup. Remarkably, a distinct splitting regime emerges, in which a continuous stream partially splits into droplets at tuneable locations while retaining a thin residual stream. Unlike conventional droplet breakup, this regime avoids complete disruption of the main flow, enables droplet generation at high capillary numbers and allows spatial control over droplet formation. Extending across a broad range of capillary numbers, we examine how variations in flow conditions and applied acoustic power influence these regimes. Combining experiments, numerical simulations and theoretical scaling, we elucidate the mechanisms governing this droplet generation mode and the associated regime transitions. Systematic measurements show that the droplet size and residual stream thickness are governed primarily by hydrodynamic parameters, whereas the acoustic input power controls the onset and spatial location of the breakup. These results establish a simple avenue for stream splitting and on-demand drop generation in a microfluidic coflow, opening new possibilities for spatially programmable manipulation of multiphase flows.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、drop、capillary、interfacial、interface；方法：experiments；降权方法：numerical simulations、simulations；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Evaporation and deposition of colloidal drops on an inclined substrate
matches.title_zh: 胶体滴在倾斜基底上的蒸发和沉积
matches.authors: Anna Kalogirou, Mark G. Blyth, and Alexandros Askounis
matches.abstract_zh: 蒸发胶体液滴通过毛细管流动、蒸发和颗粒传输的相互作用产生复杂的沉积模式；然而，基板倾斜度的影响仍然知之甚少。这项工作开发了一种润滑理论模型，该模型结合了振荡结构分离压力，以捕获倾斜表面上蒸发液滴中颗粒平台的形成。该研究揭示了重力如何打破内部流动的对称性，从而增强前进接触线处的颗粒积累并产生不对称的阶地形态。实验定性地验证了模型的预测，并确认了平台高度受颗粒尺寸的影响。
matches.abstract_en: Evaporating colloidal droplets produce complex deposition patterns through the interplay of capillary flow, evaporation, and particle transport; yet the influence of substrate inclination remains poorly understood. This work develops a lubrication-theory model incorporating oscillatory structural disjoining pressure to capture particle terrace formation in evaporating drops on inclined surfaces. The study reveals how gravity breaks symmetry in the internal flow, enhancing particle accumulation at the advancing contact line and producing asymmetric terrace morphologies. Experiments qualitatively validate the model predictions and confirm that terrace heights are governed by particle size.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets、drops、evaporation、evaporating、capillary、contact line；方法：experiments；降权方法：model；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Thermodynamic demonstration of tetracriticality and multicomponent superconductivity in UTe 2
matches.authors: Sahas Kamat, Jared Dans, Shanta Saha, Artem D. Kokovin, Johnpierre Paglione, Jörg Schmalian, B. J. Ramshaw
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: The candidate topological superconductor UTe2 exhibits a complex phase diagram with multiple superconducting states, and the nature of their coexistence is not yet resolved. In particular, the apparent observation of two intersecting second-order phase boundaries at a triple point in the pressure–temperature phase diagram is thermodynamically forbidden. This suggests either a hidden phase transition or a fundamental misunderstanding of the superconductivity in this material. Here we observe an additional phase boundary that is characterized by an upward jump in the sound velocity. This is direct thermodynamic evidence for a phase transition in which superconducting order is lost on cooling. Our results establish a tetracritical point beyond which the ambient and pressure-induced superconducting order parameters form a multicomponent state. We use the measured phase diagram to demonstrate that strong competition between the two superconducting order parameters drives the loss of order when cooling, and leads to phase locking that suppresses superconducting fluctuations. These findings provide the definitive magnetic field–pressure–temperature phase diagram of UTe2 and establish a thermodynamic foundation for multicomponent superconductivity. Prior measurements of the phase diagram of UTe2 contain a triple point that is forbidden by thermodynamics. Now, an additional phase boundary is discovered that resolves this problem and confirms multicomponent superconductivity in this material.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：multicomponent；期刊：Nature Physics

matches.title: Dynamics of liquid-jet breakup and droplet size distribution in a cross-flow airstream
matches.title_zh: 横流气流中液体射流破碎和液滴尺寸分布的动力学
matches.authors: Majji, Gowri Padmaja, Tudu, Aman John, Chandrala, Lakshmana Dora, Sahu, Kirti Chandra
matches.abstract_zh: 交叉流动气流中液体射流的破碎是由空气动力强迫和作用于各种长度尺度的界面不稳定性之间复杂的相互作用引起的。我们结合使用高速阴影成像和数字在线全息术来检查沿喷射轨迹的液滴尺寸分布的空间演变，从而可以同时表征喷射形态和体积液滴尺寸分布。结果表明，从近场袋破裂到下游边缘、韧带和节点解体，破裂机制有明显的进展，每种机制都与不同的特征长度尺度相关。这种演变反映在液滴尺寸分布中，相对于近场分布，液滴尺寸分布在下游变宽并变得越来越多分散。通过系统地改变液体射流和气流韦伯数，我们识别了不同的破碎模式，并构建了一个描述柱破碎、孤立袋破碎和相互作用袋破碎状态的状态图。此外，通过结合主要的不稳定机制，包括与观察到的柱、袋和多袋破碎模式相关的瑞利-泰勒和瑞利-高原不稳定性，我们开发了横流中喷射雾化的理论框架。该框架将不稳定性波长与特征液滴尺寸联系起来，并合理地捕获了实验观察到的趋势。我们发现，更强的空气动力强迫会导致更早的分裂，降低特征不稳定性长度尺度，并产生分散在更广泛空间区域的更细的液滴。总体而言，该研究建立了不稳定性驱动的破碎动力学与液滴尺寸分布之间的定量关系，从而将界面不稳定性与可测量的喷雾特性联系起来。
matches.abstract_en: The fragmentation of a liquid jet in a cross-flowing airstream arises from a complex interplay between aerodynamic forcing and interfacial instabilities acting across a wide range of length scales. We examine the spatial evolution of droplet size distributions along the jet trajectory using a combination of high-speed shadowgraphy and digital in-line holography, allowing simultaneous characterisation of jet morphology and volumetric droplet size distributions. The results demonstrate a clear progression of breakup mechanisms, from near-field bag rupture to downstream rim, ligament and node disintegration, each associated with distinct characteristic length scales. This evolution is reflected in the droplet size distributions, which broaden and become increasingly polydisperse downstream relative to the near-field distributions. By systematically varying the liquid-jet and airstream Weber numbers, we identify distinct breakup modes, and construct a regime map that delineates the column-breakup, isolated-bag-breakup and interacting-bag regimes. Furthermore, by incorporating the dominant instability mechanisms, including Rayleigh–Taylor and Rayleigh–Plateau instabilities associated with the observed column, bag and multi-bag breakup modes, we develop a theoretical framework for jet atomisation in cross-flow. The framework relates instability wavelengths to characteristic droplet sizes, and reasonably captures the experimentally observed trends. We found that stronger aerodynamic forcing induces earlier breakup, decreases the characteristic instability length scales and generates finer droplets dispersed over a wider spatial region. Overall, the study establishes a quantitative relationship between the instability-driven fragmentation dynamics and droplet size distributions, thereby connecting interfacial instabilities with measurable spray characteristics.

matches.title: Pendant drop rotation in vertical, turbulent, shearing flows
matches.title_zh: 垂直、湍流、剪切流中的悬滴旋转
matches.abstract_zh: 在自然和工程应用中，移动液滴经常遇到不均匀的流动，这种相互作用既没有特征，也很难通过实验观察到。在这项研究中，我们记录了悬滴（从针末端悬浮的液体滴）的动力学，这是一种自然且普遍存在的滴状态，受到空气动力湍流和剪切的不均匀扰动。我们的湍流、剪切流是由伪同轴射流形成的。通过使共流射流穿过吸力式垂直风洞的中心，我们创建了一种称为鞘式同轴射流（SCJF）的新型流场。调整射流（核心）和隧道（鞘）速度使我们能够创建因流动界面处的相互作用而产生的湍流、剪切流场。我们采用基于欧拉的有限体积 CFD 求解器来表征我们的新颖流动并了解其中的液滴动力学。受到湍流、剪切流的影响，悬滴可能会旋转。液滴旋转的开始受到低于由针直径定义的阈值雷诺数的湍流的影响。我们发现 SCJF 中的悬垂液滴动力学受到毛细管支撑尺寸、芯与鞘之间的速度比、液滴尺寸以及施加在液滴上的湍流强度和剪切力大小的影响。我们发现，与层流条件下观察到的相比，悬滴表现出有限的模态行为，并且小滴比大滴旋转得更快。我们基于旋转水滴的能量学形成了一个缩放论证，以揭示由修改后的斯特劳哈尔数给出的无量纲水滴旋转与反水滴雷诺数成比例。通过将我们的结果与之前的层流研究结果进行比较，我们发现湍流不会显着影响无量纲液滴旋转。
matches.abstract_en: In natural and engineering applications, mobile drops frequently encounter nonuniform flows, and such interactions are both uncharacterized and difficult to experimentally observe. In this study, we record the dynamics of pendant drops (drop of liquid suspended from the end of a needle), a natural and ubiquitous drop state, subject to the non-uniform disturbances of aerodynamic turbulence and shear. Our turbulent, shearing flow is formed by a pseudo-coaxial jet. By protruding a co-flowing jet through the center of a suction-type vertical wind tunnel, we create a novel flow field termed sheathed, coaxial jet-flow (SCJF). Tuning the jet (core) and tunnel (sheath) velocities allows us to create turbulent, shearing flow fields that arise from the interactions at the flow interface. We employ an Eulerian-based finite-volume CFD solver within to characterize our novel flow and understand the drop dynamics therein. Subject to turbulent, shearing flows, pendant drops may rotate. The onset of drop rotation is influenced by turbulence below a threshold Reynolds number defined by the needle diameter. We find that pendant drop dynamics in SCJF are influenced by the size of the capillary support, the velocity ratio between the core and sheath, the drop size, and the magnitudes of turbulence intensity and shear imposed on the drop. We find that pendant drops exhibit limited modal behavior compared to that observed for laminar conditions and that small drops rotate faster than large drops. We form a scaling argument based upon the energetics of a rotating drop to reveal that dimensionless drop rotation, given by a modified Strouhal number, scales with an inverse drop Reynolds number. By comparing our results to the findings of our previous work in laminar flows, we discover that turbulence does not notably influence dimensionless drop rotation.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop、drops、capillary、interface；期刊：Experiments in Fluids

matches.abstract_zh: 毛细管上升是一个经典的界面流动问题，其中弯曲弯液面处的毛细管吸力通过粘性阻力、惯性和重力来平衡。在这里，我们制定了活性向列液毛细管上升的连续介质理论。从主动流体动量方程和界面法向应力平衡出发，我们推导了上升高度的一维主动Bosanquet方程。主动应力在液-气界面上提供额外的法向牵引力，从而使有效毛细管驱动压力重新正常化。在静态极限下，这给出了由主动 Jurin 数控制的广义主动 Jurin 定律，该定律将主动正应力与经典拉普拉斯压力进行比较。根据该数字的符号和大小，以及活性成分的界面排列，活性可以增强、减少或抑制毛细管上升，甚至可以驱动名义上非润湿毛细管的吸入。早期动力学表明，恒定的主动正应力保留了经典的 Lucas-Washburn (LW) 指数，同时通过主动 Jurin 数修改了前因子。状态相关的主动反馈改变了稳定高度结构：线性弱响应反馈仅产生单个耗散稳定高度，而非线性反馈可以产生多个允许的平衡。线性稳定性分析 (LSA) 表明，真正的活动引起的双稳态需要由不稳定高度隔开的两个稳定高度。惯性不会产生额外的稳定高度或改变其稳定性顺序，而是通过过阻尼、临界阻尼或欠阻尼松弛来控制瞬态接近。该理论将毛细管上升视为一种简单的宏观探针，用于检测受限活动流体中的主动法向应力、界面排列和非线性定向反馈。
matches.abstract_en: Capillary rise is a classical interfacial-flow problem in which capillary suction at a curved meniscus is balanced by viscous resistance, inertia and gravity. Here, we formulate a continuum theory for the capillary rise of active nematic fluids. Starting from the active-fluid momentum equation and the interfacial normal stress balance, we derive a one-dimensional active Bosanquet equation for the rise height. The active stress contributes an additional normal traction at the liquid–gas interface and thereby renormalises the effective capillary driving pressure. In the static limit, this gives a generalised active Jurin’s law controlled by an active Jurin number, which compares the active normal stress with the classical Laplace pressure. Depending on the sign and magnitude of this number, and on the interfacial alignment of the active constituents, activity can enhance, reduce or suppress capillary rise, and can even drive imbibition in nominally non-wetting capillaries. The early-time dynamics shows that a constant active normal stress preserves the classical Lucas–Washburn (LW) exponent, while modifying the prefactor through the active Jurin number. State-dependent active feedback changes the steady-height structure: linear weak-response feedback produces only a single dissipative steady height, whereas nonlinear feedback can generate multiple admissible equilibria. Linear stability analysis (LSA) shows that true activity-induced bistability requires two stable heights separated by an unstable one. Inertia does not create additional steady heights or alter their stability ordering, but controls the transient approach through overdamped, critically damped or underdamped relaxation. The theory identifies capillary rise as a simple macroscopic probe of active normal stresses, interfacial alignment and nonlinear orientational feedback in confined active fluids.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary、interfacial、interface、wetting；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Thermal effect on the global instability of liquid jets
matches.title_zh: 热效应对液体射流整体不稳定性的影响
matches.authors: Qiao, Ran, Mu, Kai, Zhao, Chengxi, Si, Ting
matches.abstract_zh: 通过双全局稳定性分析从理论上研究了热场下毛细管液体射流的全局不稳定性。为了获得基本流的下游演变，利用了利用射流细长性的近似公式，在入口处采用均匀或非均匀的初始速度。对于不均匀的初始速度分布，由于速度弛豫引起的热对流增强，表面温度比均匀分布的情况更快地向环境温度下降。理论结果表明，热场促进均匀和非均匀初始速度的全局稳定性，促进非等温条件下喷射模式的出现。对于均匀的初始速度，表面温度的基本状态由流体内的传导电阻对粘性耗散的相对重要性决定。热毛细管效应将全局不稳定射流转化为全局稳定模态，随着热毛细管应力的增强，主模态的时间增长率变为负值。还提供了识别不同不稳定状态的相图。对于不均匀的初始速度，射流收缩和对流冷却迅速降低表面温度，从而抑制热毛细应力。尽管如此，速度弛豫和热损失之间的耦合仍然降低了主导模的时间增长率并促进了喷射模。
matches.abstract_en: The global instability of capillary liquid jets under a thermal field is investigated theoretically by biglobal stability analysis. To obtain the downstream evolution of basic flow, an approximate formulation that exploits the slenderness of jets is utilised, employing either uniform or non-uniform initial velocities at the inlet. For a non-uniform initial velocity profile, the surface temperature declines more rapidly toward the ambient temperature than for a uniform profile because of the enhanced thermal convection caused by the velocity relaxation. Theoretical results demonstrate that the thermal field promotes global stability for both uniform and non-uniform initial velocities, facilitating the onset of jetting modes in non-isothermal conditions. For a uniform initial velocity, the basic state of surface temperature is governed by the relative importance of the conductive resistance within the fluid to the viscous dissipation. The thermocapillary effect converts the globally unstable jet into a globally stable mode, with the temporal growth rate of leading mode turning negative with the enhancement of thermocapillary stress. Phase diagrams identifying different instability regimes are also presented. For a non-uniform initial velocity, the jet contraction and convective cooling rapidly lower the surface temperature, thereby suppressing the thermocapillary stress. Nevertheless, the coupling between velocity relaxation and heat loss still decreases the temporal growth rate of leading mode and encourages the jetting mode.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：thermocapillary、capillary；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.authors: Fintzi, Nicolas, Pierson, Jean-Lou

matches.abstract_en: In this work, we compute the hydrodynamic force and the first and second moments of force acting on a translating spherical droplet immersed in a uniform flow using the reciprocal theorem. We consider the low but finite Reynolds number regime, , and the dilute limit of small droplet volume fraction . Here, denotes the magnitude of the relative velocity between the phases, the droplet radius and and the density and viscosity of the continuous phase, respectively. We show that the inertial corrections to the first and second moments of force scale as and , respectively. Equivalently, in dimensionless form, these corrections scale as and , where denotes the macroscopic length scale. Moreover, the ensemble average of the drag force and the higher-order force moments over the distribution of droplet velocities introduces additional contributions proportional to the velocity variance of the dispersed phase, both in the interphase momentum exchange and in the effective stress of the continuous phase. As a consequence, in dilute emulsions of buoyant droplets, the effective stress depends quadratically on the relative velocity between the phases, on the velocity variance of the dispersed phase and on the spatial gradients of these quantities. Finally, we consider a steady-state pipe flow to examine how the force moments derived in this study affect the behaviour of the two-phase flow in this particular configuration.

matches.title: Capillary breakup of free and wetting liquid bridges of aqueous xanthan gum solutions
matches.title_zh: 黄原胶水溶液的自由液桥和润湿液桥的毛细管破坏
matches.abstract_zh: 通过实验研究了由黄原胶 (XG) 水溶液组成的液桥的破裂动力学。对空气中的液桥（自由桥）和固体表面上的液桥（润湿桥）进行了两个系列的实验。采用相空间表示来表征一系列聚合物浓度、溶剂粘度和基材润湿性（对于润湿桥）的破裂动力学。对于自由液桥，确定了三种不同的动态状态：惯性毛细管、弹性毛细管和终端粘性毛细管。与之前对半柔性聚合物的观察结果一致，发现弹性毛细管响应是短暂的。在末端粘性毛细管状态中，有效拉伸粘度与聚合物浓度和溶剂粘度呈线性关系，表明稀溶液的拉伸响应特征，尽管溶液在平衡条件下是半稀释的。另一方面，润湿液桥没有表现出明显的状态转变，并且它们的破碎动力学在整个破碎过程中与单个末端粘性毛细管样响应保持一致。值得注意的是，控制自由桥末端粘性毛细管状态的相同比例被证明可以将不同 XG 浓度和溶剂粘度的润湿桥动力学折叠成主曲线。假设这种行为是由与桥形成、基质诱导流动和毛细管变薄相关的组合流动历史引起的，这可能会改变聚合物构象并模糊在自由液桥中观察到的动态转变。此外，XG 润湿液桥对基材润湿性的依赖性明显弱于牛顿液体。最后，适当的重新缩放揭示了自由液桥轮廓和润湿接触线轮廓的几乎普遍的演变。
matches.abstract_en: The breakup dynamics of liquid bridges consisting of aqueous solutions of xanthan gum (XG) is investigated experimentally. Two series of experiments with liquid bridges in air (free bridges) and on solid surfaces (wetting bridges) are performed. Phase-space representations are employed to characterize the breakup dynamics over a range of polymer concentrations, solvent viscosities, and substrate wettabilities (for wetting bridges). For free liquid bridges, three distinct dynamic regimes are identified: inertia-capillary, elasto-capillary, and terminal viscous-capillary. Consistent with previous observations for semi-flexible polymers, the elasto-capillary response is found to be short-lived. In the terminal viscous-capillary regime, the effective extensional viscosity scales linearly with polymer concentration and solvent viscosity, indicating an extensional response characteristic for dilute solutions despite the solutions being semi-dilute under equilibrium conditions. On the other hand, wetting liquid bridges exhibit no distinct regime transitions, and their breakup dynamics remains consistent with a single terminal viscous-capillary-like response over the entire breakup process. Remarkably, the same scaling governing the terminal viscous-capillary regime of free bridges is shown to collapse the wetting-bridge dynamics for different XG concentrations and solvent viscosities to a master curve. This behavior is hypothesized to result from the combined flow history associated with bridge formation, substrate-induced flow, and capillary thinning, which may modify the polymer conformations and obscure the dynamic transitions observed in free liquid bridges. Additionally, XG wetting liquid bridges exhibit a markedly weaker dependence on substrate wettability than Newtonian liquids. Finally, appropriate rescaling reveals a nearly universal evolution of both the free liquid bridge profile and the wetting contact line profile.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary、wetting、contact line；方法：experiments；期刊：Experiments in Fluids

matches.title: Hydrodynamic resistance on oscillating planar interfacial bodies
matches.title_zh: 振荡平面界面体的流体动力阻力
matches.authors: Ian Ho, Ajay Harishankar Kumar, and Daniel M. Harris
matches.abstract_zh: 预测物体在流体中移动的阻力是流体力学中的一个经典问题。然而，小物体在空气-水界面处加速的作用力仍然不太清楚。在这里，我们重新审视斯托克斯的第二个问题，并测试它如何扩展到漂浮在水面上的厘米大小的圆盘。我们使用磁铁来回驱动圆盘，将摩擦力与周围水的加速效应分开。我们的研究结果表明，该理论预测了当振荡很小、表面几乎保持平坦并且流动被限制在圆盘下方的薄层时它们的响应。我们的实验是测量界面上的水动力的简单方法。
matches.abstract_en: Predicting drag on objects moving through a fluid is a classical problem in fluid mechanics. Yet the forces on small objects accelerating at an air–water interface remain less well understood. Here, we revisit Stokes’ second problem and test how well it extends to centimeter-sized disks floating on water. Using magnets, we drive the disks back and forth, separating friction from the effect of accelerating the surrounding water. Our findings indicate that the theory predicts their response when the oscillations are small, the surface remains nearly flat, and the flow is confined to a thin layer beneath the disks. Our experiments are a simple way to measure hydrodynamic forces on interfaces.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interfacial、interface；方法：experiments；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Flow features and jet formation in droplet–bubble collision
matches.title_zh: 液滴-气泡碰撞中的流动特征和射流形成
matches.authors: Senapati, Arahata, Singh, Gaurav, Atta, Arnab, Biswas, Gautam, Lakkaraju, Rajaram
matches.abstract_zh: 我们使用三维流体体积模拟研究静态、不含表面活性剂的粘性液体中的正面液滴-气泡碰撞。通过系统地改变小 Ohnesorge 数 ( ) 下的气泡与液滴半径比 ( ) 和韦伯数 ( )，我们确定了孤立碰撞期间控制界面变形、附着、射流形成和涡流演化的机制。出现了四种不同的碰撞方式，从振荡附着到射流介导的穿透和耦合环形变形。从弱到惯性主导动力学的转变发生在临界韦伯数 处，几乎独立于 ，而完全射流穿透的开始强烈依赖于尺寸比。与脉冲加速刚性球的非稳态 Oseen 解进行比较，建立了一个流体动力学基线，该基线隔离了界面流动性和变形的影响，揭示了环形涡流、界面振荡和喷射的逐渐出现。能量分析表明，射流形成是通过将冲击动能转化为表面能来控制的，从而产生与冲击速度相当的特征射流速度，而粘性耗散则将射流抑制在临界 Ohnesorge 数标度之上。这些结果提供了一个统一的物理框架，将基本液滴-气泡相互作用中的惯性、毛细作用和涡流动力学联系起来，为浮选、曝气、乳化和液-液分离等多相过程提供了预测性见解。
matches.abstract_en: We investigate head-on droplet–bubble collisions in a quiescent, surfactant-free viscous liquid using three-dimensional volume-of-fluid simulations. By systematically varying the bubble-to-droplet radius ratio ( ) and Weber number ( ) at small Ohnesorge number ( ), we identify the mechanisms governing interfacial deformation, attachment, jet formation and vortex evolution during an isolated collision. Four distinct collision regimes emerge, ranging from oscillatory attachment to jet-mediated penetration and coupled toroidal deformations. A transition from weak- to inertia-dominated dynamics occurs at a critical Weber number of , nearly independent of , whereas the onset of complete jet penetration depends strongly on the size ratio. Comparison with the unsteady Oseen solution for an impulsively accelerated rigid sphere establishes a hydrodynamic baseline that isolates the effects of interface mobility and deformation, revealing the progressive emergence of toroidal vortices, interfacial oscillations and jetting. An energy analysis demonstrates that jet formation is controlled by the conversion of impact kinetic energy into surface energy, yielding a characteristic jet velocity comparable to the impact speed, while viscous dissipation suppresses jetting above a critical Ohnesorge number scaling as . These results provide a unified physical framework linking inertia, capillarity and vortex dynamics in elementary droplet–bubble interactions, offering predictive insight into multiphase processes such as flotation, aeration, emulsification and liquid–liquid separation.

matches.title: Superspreading droplets for scalable and green perovskite photovoltaics
matches.title_zh: 用于可扩展和绿色钙钛矿光伏的超级扩散液滴
matches.abstract_zh: 将钙钛矿太阳能电池从实验室演示过渡到商业生产需要最大限度地减少原材料浪费，同时最大限度地提高制造产量。尽管滴涂是一种连续的、可能无浪费的制造途径，但其对基材表面的敏感性限制了其更广泛的采用。在这里，我们描述了一种含有驱动溶剂的墨水配方，该驱动溶剂可以放大向外的表面张力梯度，迫使液滴快速散布在各种材料上，包括高度疏水的表面。这种超级扩散机制使得前体化学品几乎完全得到利用，同时将薄膜沉积速率加快了 30 倍以上。全滴涂钙钛矿太阳能电池的电力转换效率达到26.36%（认证为26.11%）。该配方还在放大过程中保留了潜在的结晶途径，从而可以直接转化为工业相关的涂层技术。通过刀片涂层制造的大面积微型模块在 54.8 cm2 孔径上实现了 22.81% 的效率。通过将液滴扩散与基底表面化学分离，该策略为高通量、材料高效的钙钛矿薄膜制造提供了一条广泛适用的途径，并促进了高效光伏电池的可规模化生产。扩大钙钛矿太阳能电池的生产规模需要快速、零浪费的薄膜沉积。作者设计了一种通用墨水，可将生产速度提高 30 倍，实现高效率。
matches.abstract_en: Transitioning perovskite solar cells from laboratory demonstrations to commercial production requires minimizing raw material waste while maximizing manufacturing throughput. Although drop-coating is a continuous, potentially waste-free manufacturing route, its sensitivity to substrate surfaces has limited its wider adoption. Here we describe an ink formulation containing driving solvents that amplify outward surface-tension gradients, forcing droplets to rapidly spread over a wide range of materials, including highly hydrophobic surfaces. This superspreading mechanism enables near-complete utilization of the precursor chemicals, while accelerating film-deposition rates by more than 30-fold. Fully drop-coated perovskite solar cells achieved a power conversion efficiency of 26.36% (certified 26.11%). The formulation also preserves the underlying crystallization pathway during scale-up, allowing direct translation to industrially relevant coating techniques. A large-area minimodule fabricated by blade-coating achieved an efficiency of 22.81% over a 54.8 cm2 aperture. By decoupling droplet spreading from substrate surface chemistry, this strategy provides a broadly applicable route to high-throughput, material-efficient perovskite film manufacturing and advances the scalable production of high-efficiency photovoltaics. Scaling up the manufacturing of perovskite solar cells requires rapid, zero-waste film deposition. The authors design a universal ink that accelerates production 30-fold, achieving high efficiencies.

matches.title: Droplet-Assisted Growth of Re-Entrant Micro-Mushroom Surfaces with Switchable Superhydrophobicity and Adhesive Resistance
matches.title_zh: 具有可切换超疏水性和抗粘附性的可再入微蘑菇表面的液滴辅助生长
matches.abstract_zh: 受自然启发的表面微米和纳米结构设计长期以来因其潜在的多功能性而引起人们的关注。这项研究介绍了一种通过一步原位动态液滴辅助生长和成形策略实现的蘑菇形有机硅凹入结构。这些有机硅微蘑菇 (SMM) 的惰性棒底座和可化学改性的球形头具有独特的形状和多组分混合特性，可提供卓越的表面润湿和粘附特性。工程化的单层粗糙表面呈现出卓越的玫瑰花瓣效果，水接触角超过150°，表现出非凡的水附着力。这些表面的润湿状态可以通过 O2 等离子体处理和重建二级和三级分层纳米结构轻松改变。这种方法还有效地将花瓣效应表面转化为莲花效应表面，显着增强其自清洁性能。此外，SMM 涂层对各种粘合剂（包括胶带、热胶和通用粘合剂）的粘附力极低，拉拔力接近 0。这一特性可确保从粘性表面顺利剥离。 SMM 结构的耐用性值得注意，因为即使经过 1,000 次环粘性测试，它们仍能保持其形态，并且可以承受 8.7 MPa 压缩和粘性表面上 500 次线性磨损。陈等人。开发具有独特凹入结构的耐用蘑菇形有机硅涂层，该涂层结合了可调水润湿性、对粘性材料的强大抵抗力和多功能保护功能。
matches.abstract_en: Nature-inspired designs for surface micro- and nanostructures have long attracted attention for their potential multifunctionality. This study introduces a mushroom-shaped silicone re-entrant structure achieved through a one-step, in-situ dynamic Droplet-Assisted Growth and Shaping strategy. The unique shape and multicomponent hybrid properties of the inert rod base and chemically modifiable spherical head of these silicone micro-mushrooms (SMMs) provide exceptional surface wetting and adhesion characteristics. The engineered single-scale rough surface exhibits the remarkable rose petal effect, featuring a water contact angle exceeding 150° and demonstrating extraordinary water adhesion. The wetting states of these surfaces can be easily altered through O2-plasma treatment with the reconstruction of secondary and tertiary hierarchical nanostructures. This approach also effectively converts petal-effect surfaces into lotus-effect surfaces, significantly enhancing their self-cleaning performance. Furthermore, the SMM coatings display extremely low adhesion to various adhesives, including tapes, hot glue, and all-purpose adhesives, with pull-off forces nearing 0. This characteristic ensures a smooth detachment from sticky surfaces. The durability of the SMM structures is noteworthy, as they maintain their morphology even after 1,000 loop tack tests and can endure 8.7 MPa compression and 500 cycles of linear abrasion on sticky surfaces. Chen et al. develop durable mushroom-shaped silicone coatings with unique re-entrant structures that combine tunable water wetting, strong resistance to sticky materials, and versatile protective capabilities.

matches.title: Effect of transient shell formation on shock-induced atomization of an evaporating nanofluid droplet
matches.title_zh: 瞬态壳形成对蒸发纳米流体液滴冲击诱导雾化的影响
matches.authors: Gautham Vadlamudi, Bal Krishan, Akarsh Choudhary, Saptarshi Basu
matches.abstract_zh: 传统液滴的空气动力破碎已得到很好的证实，然而，当蒸发改变液滴成分和界面力学时，人们对空气动力破碎的了解仍然知之甚少。我们展示了蒸发驱动的溶胶-凝胶转变和纳米颗粒团聚如何将纳米流体液滴转化为凝胶状和固体壳状态，将冲击诱导的雾化从传统的破碎转变为新的壳介导的破碎模式，包括破裂、分层和脆性断裂。由此产生的框架将瞬态壳演化和力学与蒸发充满颗粒的液滴的分解路径联系起来，与喷雾干燥、涂料、增材制造和药物气雾剂相关。
matches.abstract_en: Aerodynamic breakup is well established for conventional droplets, however, remains poorly understood when evaporation alters droplet composition and interfacial mechanics. We show how evaporation-driven sol--gel transition and nanoparticle agglomeration transform a nanofluid droplet into gelatinous and solid-shelled states, shifting shock-induced atomization from conventional breakup to new shell-mediated fragmentation modes involving rupture, delamination, and brittle fracture. The resulting framework links transient shell evolution and mechanics to breakup pathways in evaporating particle-laden droplets, relevant to spray drying, coatings, additive manufacturing, and pharmaceutical aerosols.

matches.title: Electrification mechanisms in sliding liquid and frozen drops
matches.title_zh: 滑动液体和冰滴的起电机制
matches.abstract_zh: 当水滴穿过绝缘表面并积累和沉积电荷时，就会发生滑动带电的微观和基本起源，这一现象仍然存在争议。电荷转移通常归因于后退接触线处的离子转移。然而，仅离子转移是否可以完全解释观察到的电荷分离仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们研究了极性、自电离液体和非极性液体的载玻片带电。通过将它们冷却到熔化温度以下，我们能够将该过程与各个冷冻部件的摩擦起电进行比较。尽管在低于冰点的温度下离子迁移率降低，但冷冻的极性化合物继续积累大量电荷。非极性液体在不同基质上的液相和冷冻相中表现出较低的电荷和几乎相同的电荷行为。由于非极性液体含有很少的自由离子，这些观察结果表明了另一种充电机制，这可能是电子转移。我们的研究结果表明，滑动起电至少通过两种机制进行，主要的电荷转移途径根据电负性、相位和温度在离子和电子转移之间转移。当沿着绝缘表面滑动时，液滴带电。在不同基底上进行的自电离和非极性液体的实验表明，至少有两种潜在机制存在竞争。
matches.abstract_en: The microscopic and fundamental origin of slide electrification, which happens when water drops move across insulating surfaces while accumulating and depositing electrical charges, is still debated. Charge transfer is often attributed to ion transfer at the receding contact line. However, it remains an open question whether ion transfer alone can fully account for the observed charge separation. Here we examined slide electrification of polar, self-ionizing liquids and non-polar liquids. By cooling them below the melting temperature, we were able to compare this process to tribocharging of the respective frozen components. Despite reduced ion mobility at sub-freezing temperatures, the frozen polar compounds continued to accumulate substantial charge. Non-polar liquids exhibited lower charging and nearly identical charging behaviour in both their liquid and frozen phases on different substrates. As non-polar liquids contain few free ions, these observations indicate an alternative charging mechanism, which could be electron transfer. Our findings suggest that slide electrification operates through at least two mechanisms, with the dominant charge transfer pathway shifting between ions and electron transfer depending on electronegativity, phase and temperature. When sliding along an insulating surface, liquid drops become charged. Experiments with self-ionizing and non-polar liquids on different substrates suggest the competition of at least two underlying mechanisms.

matches.title: Interfacial instabilities and thermo-hydrodynamic mechanisms in high-temperature vapour-ventilated supercavitation

matches.abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验研究了高温可凝蒸汽通风超空泡的界面不稳定性和热流体力学机制。使用高速成像和基于人工智能的分割模型，我们建立了一个流态图来描绘超空泡包络线，识别与相变和湍流之间相互作用相关的独特的粗糙超空泡流态。一个关键发现是可冷凝蒸汽通风的非单调腔体长度响应，其中高流量回归由冷凝辅助的源汇不平衡控制，并且在机械上不同于空气通风中观察到的泄漏/关闭响应。具体来说，冷凝引起的质量损失充当内部水槽，可能超过蒸汽供应并导致空腔退化。虽然腔直径仍然受到惯性约束，但其长度对这些热力学效应高度敏感。时空分析表明界面不稳定性的耦合热流体动力学途径。观察到的不稳定性是由液滴撞击、欠膨胀射流膨胀和通风影响区域内的接触凝结驱动的热力学自激引发的。这些扰动通过开尔文-亥姆霍兹型剪切层过程向下游传递。腔体波动的上下不对称性与重力相关的选择一致，重力选择通过瑞利-泰勒型路径优先放大上界面的长波扰动，并抑制下界面的波动。这些发现将经典的空化理论扩展到以快速相变为主的体系，为多相流中的热流体动力学耦合提供了新的见解。
matches.abstract_en: This study experimentally investigates the interfacial instabilities and thermo-hydrodynamic mechanisms of supercavities ventilated by high-temperature condensable vapour. Using high-speed imaging with an AI-based segmentation model, we establish a flow regime map that delineates the supercavitation envelope, identifying a distinct rough supercavity regime associated with the interaction between phase change and turbulence. A key finding is the non-monotonic cavity-length response of condensable vapour ventilation, in which high-flow regression is governed by a condensation-assisted source–sink imbalance, and differs mechanistically from the leakage/closure response observed in air ventilation. Specifically, condensation-induced mass loss acts as an internal sink that can exceed the vapour supply and cause cavity regression. While the cavity diameter remains inertially constrained, its length is highly sensitive to these thermodynamic effects. Spatiotemporal analysis indicates a coupled thermo-hydrodynamic route for the interfacial instability. The observed instability is initiated by thermodynamic self-excitation driven by droplet impingement, under-expanded jet expansion, and contact condensation within the ventilation influence region. These disturbances are convected downstream through a Kelvin–Helmholtz-type shear-layer process. The upper–lower asymmetry of the cavity fluctuations is consistent with gravity-related selection, which preferentially amplifies long-wave perturbations on the upper interface through a Rayleigh–Taylor-type route, and damps fluctuations on the lower interface. These findings extend classical cavitation theory into regimes dominated by rapid phase change, providing new insights into thermo-hydrodynamic coupling in multiphase flows.

matches.abstract_zh: 了解颗粒负载界面上的传质对于设计用于控制释放和化学转化的颗粒稳定乳液至关重要。我们通过实验和理论模型表明，无论颗粒大小如何，颗粒层通常对传输动力学的影响可以忽略不计。只有在超出密堆积极限的极端表面覆盖情况下，颗粒层才会显着阻碍传输。这些发现解释了为什么扩散可以通过颗粒稳定的界面持续存在，并为基于乳液的系统中的受控传输铺平了道路。

matches.abstract_zh: 带相反电荷的液滴在强电场下的非接触相互作用涉及耦合电荷传输、气体电离和界面不稳定性，但极性选择性破裂起源的直接证据仍然有限。在这里，使用自主开发的显微碰撞平台和高速成像研究了空气和氦气中高导电带相反电荷的液滴的非接触破碎。通过改变液滴曲率、反转高压电极极性以及比较酸性和碱性电解质，我们表明空气中的破裂始终是从负极性液滴开始的。因此，极性偏好不受液滴几何形状、电极配置或液相离子迁移率的控制。在氦气中，负极侧的破裂变得较​​弱，并且在某些情况下，非接触破裂发生在两个极性侧。对于给定的液体电导率，氦气中断裂的临界标称电键数也高于空气中。我们认为这种行为与空气中气体电离介导的空间电荷效应有关：缓慢迁移的正离子在带负电的液滴附近积聚，扭曲局部电场并增加表面电荷密度，直到达到局部亚瑞利不稳定性。在氦气中，弱电子附着和更快的带电粒子传输减少了这种场不对称性。这些结果表明，气体电离在调节破碎极性和带相反电荷的液滴的动态结果中发挥着重要作用，为电喷雾、微反应器和电场控制的多相流提供指导。
matches.abstract_en: The non-contact interaction of oppositely charged droplets under strong electric fields involves coupled charge transport, gas ionization, and interfacial instability, yet direct evidence for the origin of polarity-selective breakup remains limited. Here, non-contact breakup of highly conducting oppositely charged droplets was investigated in air and helium using a self-developed microscopic collision platform and high-speed imaging. By varying droplet curvature, reversing the high-voltage-electrode polarity, and comparing acidic and alkaline electrolytes, we show that breakup in air consistently initiates from the negative-polarity droplet. The polarity preference is therefore not governed by droplet geometry, electrode configuration or liquid-phase ion mobility. In helium, the breakup at the negative side becomes weaker, and in some cases, non-contact breakup occurs at both polarity sides. For a given liquid conductivity, the critical nominal electric bond number for breakup is also higher in helium than in air. We suggest that this behavior is associated with gas ionization-mediated space-charge effects in air: Slowly migrating positive ions accumulate near the negatively charged droplet, distort the local electric field and increase the surface charge density until a local sub-Rayleigh instability is reached. In helium, weak electron attachment and faster charged-particle transport reduce this field asymmetry. These results indicate that gas ionization plays an important role in regulating breakup polarity and the dynamic outcome of oppositely charged droplets, providing guidance for electrosprays, microreactors, and electric field-controlled multiphase flows.

matches.abstract_zh: 表面张力经常使用悬滴法测量，而环境湿度通常是事后才考虑的。通过仔细校准的实验和详细的数值模拟，我们表明蒸发冷却可将液滴温度降低高达 9.5 K，从而使测量的表面张力提高超过 1 mN/m。蒸发驱动和马兰戈尼引起的流动也会使水滴变形，但影响很小。被动湿度控制完全消除了这些伪影，并揭示了 1,2-己二醇水溶液混合物表面张力的浅层最小值。
matches.abstract_en: Surface tension is frequently measured with the pendant drop method, while the ambient humidity is usually an afterthought. With carefully calibrated experiments and detailed numerical simulations, we show that evaporative cooling lowers the drop temperature by up to 9.5 K which in turn raises the measured surface tension by more than 1 mN/m. Evaporation-driven and Marangoni-induced flows additionally deform the drop, but only marginally. A passive humidity control removes these artifacts entirely and reveals the shallow minimum in the surface tension of aqueous 1,2-hexanediol mixtures.

matches.title: Impact of relative humidity and PIV seeding on the electro-aerodynamic performance of needle-to-ring ionic fans
matches.title_zh: 相对湿度和 PIV 播种对针环离子风机电动气动性能的影响
matches.abstract_zh: 电流体动力 (EHD) 风扇是传统热管理的可行固态替代方案，可满足现代电子产品对小型化、静音和无振动冷却的需求。虽然粒子图像测速 (PIV) 广泛用于空气动力学表征，但标准 PIV 假设在 EHD 流下失效。由于示踪粒子、感应电场和环境条件之间复杂的相互作用，经典的示踪流体耦合假设失效。本研究通过实验量化了相对湿度（36%、50% 和 80%）和 PIV 播种材料（DEHS 液滴和熏香烟雾）对针环 EHD 风扇（直径 22 mm，工作范围 4-14 kV）运行特性的耦合影响。实验在受控环境室中进行，以评估放电电流稳定性、电流-电压关系以及由此产生的流场。研究结果证实，虽然在所有湿度水平下都保持线性电晕放电状态（汤森关系），但湿度的增加会抑制放电电流。值得注意的是，较高的湿度条件会产生较高的出口速度，这一趋势归因于接近击穿时冷凝增强的局部场效应。更重要的是，播种材料的选择成为测量偏差的主要来源。电介质 DEHS 液滴会抑制电离并扭曲流动拓扑，导致峰值轴向速度降低 36%，并在 14 kV 下使体积流量低估 17%。相比之下，电兼容的香烟雾保留了高速离子射流核心。这些发现表明，播种选择和环境条件是控制 EHD 流动行为的主动变量，对诊断方法和离子风设备的部署具有直接影响。
matches.abstract_en: Electrohydrodynamic (EHD) fans represent a viable solid-state alternative to conventional thermal management, addressing the demand for miniaturized, silent, and vibration-free cooling in modern electronics. While Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) is widely utilized for aerodynamic characterization, standard PIV assumptions break down under EHD flows. Classical tracer fluid coupling assumptions are invalidated due to the complex interactions between tracer particles, the induced electric field, and ambient conditions. This study experimentally quantifies the coupled effects of relative humidity (36%, 50%, and 80%) and PIV seeding materials (DEHS droplets and incense smoke) on the operational characteristics of a needle-to-ring EHD fan (22 mm diameter, 4–14 kV operating range). Experiments were conducted in a controlled environmental chamber to evaluate discharge current stability, current–voltage relationships, and the resulting flow fields. The findings confirm that while the linear corona discharge regime (Townsend relationship) is preserved across all humidity levels, increasing humidity suppresses the discharge current. Notably, higher humidity conditions yield higher outlet velocities, a trend attributed to condensation-enhanced local field effects near breakdown. More importantly, the choice of seeding material emerges as a primary source of measurement bias. Dielectric DEHS droplets suppress ionization and distort the flow topology, inducing a 36% reduction in peak axial velocity and a 17% underestimation of the volumetric flow rate at 14 kV. In contrast, electrically compatible incense smoke preserves the high-velocity ionic jet core. These findings establish that seeding selection and environmental conditions are active variables governing EHD flow behavior, with direct implications for diagnostic methodology and the deployment of ionic wind devices.

matches.abstract_en: Trapping and releasing deformable drops in confined chambers are central to many microfluidic applications, from single-cell assays to droplet microreactors. Combining three-dimensional boundary-integral simulations with flow-cell experiments, we show how gravity, viscous forcing, drop deformability, and chamber geometry determine whether a drop escapes, becomes trapped, or breaks up near a well corner. The results also identify practical strategies for controlled drop removal after trapping.

matches.title: Cell-type-specific surfaceome profiling of 100-500 isolated cells using a droplet-based Magnetic Affinity Purification System

matches.authors: Amanda C. Lorentzian, Juliet M. Bartleson, Terence Ho, Hao Xu, Christopher B. Bullock, Zhichang Yang, Alan G. Gutierrez, Meena Choi, Tommy K. Cheung, Christopher M. Rose, Hua Zhang, William T. Yewdell, Ying Zhu
matches.abstract_zh: 细胞表面蛋白是生物标志物和治疗靶点的重要来源。然而，由于现有技术固有的敏感性限制，组织和细胞类型特异性表面组的表征仍然很差，特别是在人类疾病的背景下。在这里，我们推出 nanoMAPS（纳米级磁力亲和纯化系统），这是一种小型化蛋白质组样品制备方法，可对少至 100-500 个细胞进行表面组分析（比现有技术低约 100,000 倍）。通过在单个微升级液滴内进行基于磁珠的亲和纯化，nanoMAPS 显着提高了表面蛋白的回收率并减少了细胞内蛋白的非特异性吸收。将 nanoMAPS 应用到原代人类免疫细胞和小鼠浆细胞群中，能够可靠地识别已建立的细胞类型特异性表面标记以及选择性富集于疾病相关免疫细胞亚群中的其他蛋白质。总之，这些结果使 nanoMAPS 成为一个广泛适用的平台，可将表面蛋白质组学技术扩展到直接从患病组织中分离的稀有原代细胞。表面蛋白是生物标志物和治疗靶点的关键来源，但在疾病相关细胞中的特征仍然很少。在这里，作者开发了 nanoMAPS，一种超灵敏的蛋白质组学方法，用于分析数百个原代细胞的表面蛋白质并识别潜在的生物标志物。
matches.abstract_en: Cell surface proteins represent an important source of biomarkers and therapeutic targets. However, due to the inherent sensitivity limitations of existing technologies, tissue and cell-type-specific surfaceomes remain poorly characterized, especially in the context of human diseases. Here, we present nanoMAPS (nanoscale Magnetic Affinity Purification System), a miniaturized proteomic sample preparation method for surfaceome profiling of as few as 100-500 cells (~100,000-fold lower than existing technologies). By performing magnetic bead-based affinity purification within a single microliter-scale droplet, nanoMAPS significantly improves the recovery of surface proteins and reduces non-specific absorption of intracellular proteins. Application of nanoMAPS to primary human immune cells and mouse plasma cell populations enables robust identification of established cell-type-specific surface markers as well as other proteins selectively enriched in disease-associated immune cell subpopulations. Together, these results establish nanoMAPS as a broadly applicable platform for extending surface proteomics technology to rare primary cells isolated directly from diseased tissues. Surface proteins are a key source of biomarkers and therapeutic targets, but remain poorly characterized in disease-relevant cells. Here, authors developed nanoMAPS, an ultrasensitive proteomic method to profile surface proteins from hundreds of primary cells and identify potential biomarkers.

matches.title: Fate of secondary droplets produced by high-speed raindrops interacting with a liquid pool

matches.authors: Kuo, Han-Hsiang, Hao, Xuanting
matches.abstract_zh: 下落的液滴与液池之间相互作用产生的二次液滴在工程应用和自然界的地球物理过程中发挥着重要作用。本研究使用直接数值模拟来研究雨滴与液池相互作用产生的二次液滴的动力学。雨滴参数具有实际速度、有效直径和表面张力值，范围为典型空气-水界面值的 1 至 2 倍。数值配置包括单个雨滴和两个雨滴，其间隔距离为雨滴直径的两倍到四倍。发现二次液滴尺寸分布与液滴半径成比例，另外还依赖于表面张力和雨滴直径。当根据这种新的缩放定律进行归一化时，从具有不同参数值的模拟中获得的液滴尺寸分布会塌陷到一条曲线上。对撞击形态的分析揭示了雨滴相互作用的不同阶段，并确定了中心液膜的形成和破裂。对二次液滴的空间和时间分析表明，雨滴相互作用会影响空腔捕获的液滴的百分比以及它们与水池重新融合的持续时间。这些行为是由不同尺寸的二次液滴的诞生时间差异和与腔内气流相关的空气动力强迫的综合影响引起的。
matches.abstract_en: Secondary droplets produced by interactions between falling fluid drops and a liquid pool play a significant role in engineering applications and geophysical processes in nature. This study uses direct numerical simulations to investigate the dynamics of secondary droplets generated by raindrop–liquid pool interactions. The raindrop parameters feature realistic speed , effective diameters – , and surface tension values ranging from to twice the typical air–water interface value. The numerical configurations include both a single raindrop and two raindrops separated by distances between two and four times the raindrop diameter. The secondary droplet size distribution is found to scale with the droplet radius as , with additional dependencies on surface tension and raindrop diameter. When normalised according to this new scaling law, the droplet size distribution obtained from simulations with different parameter values collapses onto a single curve. Analysis of the impact morphology reveals distinct stages of raindrop interactions, and identifies the formation and break-up of a central liquid film. Spatial and temporal analyses of the secondary droplets show that raindrop interaction can influence both the percentage of droplets captured by the cavity and the duration over which they re-merge with the pool. These behaviours arise from the combined effects of differences in the birth times of secondary droplets of various sizes and aerodynamic forcing associated with the cavity airflow.

matches.authors: Máté Pénzes, Máté Winternitz, Ádám I. Horváth, Svetlana Mastitskaya, Usman Awan, Tamás Szimler, Camille Glaser, Carlos Kikuti, Marie Juillé, Leila Heidsieck, Anna Á. matches.abstract_en: In acute myocardial infarction and acute kidney injury, capillary no-reflow denotes that capillary blood flow is still blocked despite successful arterial reperfusion. This is associated with substantially increased mortality and reinfarction risk; nevertheless, no targeted therapy exists so far1,2. Because capillary no-reflow is driven by smooth muscle myosin-mediated hypercontraction of capillary pericytes, we developed R(+)2501, a myosin-specific and capillary-selective vasodilator. In reperfused animal models of acute myocardial infarction and acute kidney injury, direct in vivo imaging showed that R(+)2501 rapidly restored capillary flow, an effect sustained even after rapid drug clearance. Ex vivo experiments confirmed reversal of pericyte constriction directly. Restoration of capillary blood flow, together with clearance of trapped neutrophils, linked resolution of capillary no-reflow to attenuation of an early driver of reperfusion injury. R(+)2501 enhanced capillary perfusion while preserving coronary autoregulation and systemic haemodynamics, and markedly improved survival during acute reperfusion. We further found that acute myocardial infarction induced renal capillary no-reflow, which was reversed by R(+)2501, suggesting that capillary no-reflow contributes to the pathophysiology of cardiorenal syndrome type I. These findings establish pericyte-targeted smooth muscle myosin inhibition as a therapeutic strategy to restore microvascular perfusion and halt the ischaemic cascade across organs, while defining a specific physiological role for capillaries and pericytes in circulatory regulation. R(+)2501 reverses capillary no-reflow by relaxing pericytes, restoring microvascular perfusion and improving survival in animal models of myocardial infarction and acute kidney injury.

matches.title: Cavitation bubble-induced shear flow and stress within grooved structures
matches.title_zh: 凹槽结构内空化气泡引起的剪切流和应力
matches.authors: Li, Shi-Min, Zhang, A-Man, Xie, Da-Hao, An, Hongjie, Zeng, Qingyun
matches.abstract_zh: 使用三维可压缩流体体积 (VoF) 解算器结合每秒一百万帧 (fps) 的超高速摄影，系统地研究了凹槽结构内喷射空化气泡引起的剪切流。结构化表面包括二十个平行的微通道，局部网格细化至凹槽底部附近解析了边界层内的线性切向速度分布。模拟准确地再现了两种代表性配置的实验观察结果，即在凹槽上方和突起上方引发的气泡。一般来说，从远端气泡表面形成的微射流冲击下部气泡界面，随后沿着和穿过凹槽通道扩散，产生强剪切流。时空壁应力分布表明，最大剪切应力出现在射流撞击瞬间附近，而随后的演化进一步受到子气泡破碎和重新膨胀的调节。对于在凹槽上方引发的气泡，微射流产生单次冲击，而对于在突起上方引发的气泡，射流变得倾斜：它首先撞击突起，扩散到凹槽内捕获的气泡中，最后以一定角度刺穿下气泡表面。系统地研究了三个几何参数，即水平偏移、垂直间隔距离和凹槽宽度的影响，揭示了它们对气泡变形、射流方向、破碎和涡流动力学的耦合影响。由于凹槽内的快速射流扩散和流动重新聚焦，在特定的几何条件下获得了大约 的峰值壁剪切应力。这些结果提供了对喷射空化气泡与微结构表面相互作用产生的三维不稳定壁剪切产生的基本见解。
matches.abstract_en: The shear flow induced by a jetting cavitation bubble within grooved structures is systematically investigated using a three-dimensional compressible volume-of-fluid (VoF) solver combined with ultra-high-speed photography of one million frames per second (fps). The structured surface comprises twenty parallel micro-channels, and local mesh refinement down to near the groove bottom resolves the linear tangential velocity profile within the boundary layer. The simulations accurately reproduce experimental observations for two representative configurations, namely bubbles initiated above the groove and above the protrusion. In general, a microjet formed from the distal bubble surface impacts the lower bubble interface and subsequently spreads both along and across the groove channel, generating strong shear flow. Spatio-temporal wall-stress distributions indicate that the maximum shear stress occurs near the instant of jet impact, while the subsequent evolution is further modulated by daughter-bubble fragmentation and re-expansion. For a bubble initiated above the groove, the microjet produces a single impact, whereas for a bubble initiated above the protrusion, the jet becomes oblique: it first strikes the protrusion, spreads into the trapped bubble inside the groove and finally pierces the lower bubble surface at an angle. The influences of three geometric parameters, namely the horizontal offset , vertical stand-off distance and groove width , are systematically examined, revealing their coupled effects on bubble deformation, jet orientation, fragmentation and the vortex dynamics. A peak wall-shear stress of approximately is obtained under specific geometric conditions due to rapid jet spreading and flow refocusing within the groove. These results provide fundamental insight into the three-dimensional, unsteady wall-shear generation produced by jetting cavitation bubbles interacting with micro-structured surfaces.

matches.title: Fast and slow surfactants in turbulence-driven bubble breakup
matches.title_zh: 湍流驱动的气泡破裂中的快速和慢速表面活性剂
matches.authors: Wu, Zhan, Aurégan, Tristan, Deike, Luc
matches.abstract_zh: 当一个大的气腔在湍流中破裂时，它会经历非常大的变形和新界面形成的级联事件，包括各种尺度的细长丝和气泡，其形成速率由湍流和毛细管过程控制。我们通过实验研究了表面活性剂和盐对大气腔破碎的影响，并观察到在某些情况下产生的气泡数量增加了五倍。我们表征了这种瞬态配置中连续破裂所产生的气泡尺寸分布。对于大于 Hinze 尺度（定义为表面张力和湍流应力之间的平衡）的气泡，我们观察到所有测试的解决方案的气泡尺寸分布保持不变。然而，对于下面的气泡，我们观察到添加表面活性剂或盐后产生的气泡数量增加，并且气泡尺寸分布随之变陡。仅当表面活性剂的吸附时间尺度与湍流产生新界面的速率相比足够快时，后一种效应才可见。
matches.abstract_en: When a large air cavity breaks in a turbulent flow, it goes through very large deformations and cascading events of new interface formation, including elongated filaments and bubbles over a wide range of scales, with their rate of formation controlled by turbulence and capillary processes. We experimentally investigate the effects of surfactants and salt on the fragmentation of a large air cavity, and observe a fivefold increase of the number of bubbles being produced in some cases. We characterise the bubble size distribution resulting from successive breakups in such a transient configuration. For bubbles larger than the Hinze scale (defined as the balance between surface tension and turbulence stresses), we observe that bubble size distributions remain unchanged for all solutions tested. For bubbles below , however, we observe an increase of the number of bubbles produced and an associated steepening of the bubble size distribution upon the addition of surfactant or salt. This later effect is only visible for surfactants with an adsorption time scale that is fast enough compared with the rate at which new interfaces are being generated by turbulence.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary、interface、surface tension；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Diffuse-interface model for N -phase flows with liquid-solid phase change
matches.title_zh: 液固相变 N 相流的扩散界面模型
matches.authors: Jiangxu Huang, Chengjie Zhan, Zhenhua Chai, Changsheng Huang, and Xi Liu
matches.abstract_zh: 当几种不混溶的流体共存并在凝固时改变体积时，冻结变得更加复杂。我们开发了一种还原一致的扩散界面模型，将 N 相流的相场和焓公式与液固相变耦合起来。该模型捕获了凝固引起的膨胀和收缩，同时考虑了流体流动、传热和不断变化的界面之间的相互作用。模拟揭示了界面相互作用和热扩散率如何对比复合液滴和充满杂质的系统中的冻结锋面形状和凝固形态。
matches.abstract_en: Freezing becomes more complex when several immiscible fluids coexist and change volume as they solidify. We develop a reduction-consistent diffuse-interface model that couples phase-field and enthalpy formulations for N-phase flows with liquid-solid phase change. The model captures solidification-induced expansion and shrinkage while accounting for the interplay between fluid flow, heat transfer, and evolving interfaces. Simulations reveal how interfacial interactions and thermal diffusivity contrasts shape freezing fronts and solidified morphologies in compound droplets and impurity-laden systems.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets、phase change、freezing、solidification、interfacial、interface、heat transfer；降权方法：simulations、phase-field、model；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Post-breakthrough evolution of viscous fingering in micromodel porous media
matches.title_zh: 微模型多孔介质中粘性指进的突破后演化
matches.authors: Primkulov, Bauyrzhan K., Shamsi, Zahra, Qiu, Yu, Jia, Ruofei, Juanes, Ruben
matches.abstract_zh: 当多孔介质中粘性较小的流体取代粘性较大的流体时，界面变得不稳定，形成粘性手指。虽然粘性指进已得到深入研究，但之前的工作主要集中在突破前的动力学上，即注入流体到达任何出口边界之前。在这里，我们通过实验和孔隙网络模拟研究径向微模型中的突破后行为。突破后位移对于实际应用至关重要，因为它决定了最终回收的防御液量。我们表明，位移模式要么“冻结”，要么继续增长，具体取决于毛细管数量和粘度比。孔隙网络模型预测突破时生长速率急剧下降，并出现几何控制的交叉，低于该交叉时位移模式被阻止。这些结果强调了区域尺寸、孔隙几何形状、流体性质和注入速率在调节突破后动力学中的作用，并为优化驱替效率提供了框架。
matches.abstract_en: When a less viscous fluid displaces a more viscous one in a porous medium, the interface becomes unstable, forming viscous fingers. While viscous fingering has been studied in depth, previous work has focused on the pre-breakthrough dynamics – that is, before the injected fluid reaches any outlet boundary. Here, we investigate post-breakthrough behaviour in a radial micromodel through experiments and pore-network simulations. Post-breakthrough displacement is key for practical applications, as it governs how much of the defending fluid is ultimately recovered. We show that the displacement pattern either ‘freezes’ or continues to grow, depending on the capillary number and viscosity ratio . A pore-network model predicts a sharp drop in growth rate at breakthrough and a geometry-controlled cross-over below which the displacement pattern is arrested. These results highlight the role of domain size, pore geometry, fluid properties and injection rate in regulating the post-breakthrough dynamics and provide a framework for optimising displacement efficiency.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop、capillary、interface；方法：experiments；降权方法：simulations、model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Time-resolved 3D reconstruction of an early-stage condensing microdroplet using digital holographic microscopy
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: Early-stage condensation droplets set initial conditions for subsequent growth, coalescence, and surface re-exposure, yet their time-resolved three-dimensional morphology at the microscale remains difficult to measure using conventional two-dimensional imaging techniques. Here, digital holographic microscopy (DHM) was used to reconstruct time-resolved height fields of an individual condensing microdroplet on a silane-coated glass surface, with lateral and temporal resolutions of 0.83 $${\upmu }$$m and 66 ms, respectively. The reconstructed phase fields were converted into droplet height maps, from which maximum height, footprint-equivalent diameter, integrated volume, and projected-boundary descriptors were quantified. For the representative droplet analyzed in this study, early growth departed from uniform spherical-cap-like enlargement. Vertical growth was more pronounced than lateral footprint expansion during an early growth interval, while projected-boundary analysis showed that the initially less regular footprint became more circular as growth proceeded. At three selected growth stages, threshold-aligned spherical-cap cross-estimates underestimated the DHM-measured maximum height by 10.47–17.29% and the projected-footprint area by 9.00–27.74%, while overestimating the integrated volume by 9.84–28.53%. These observations indicate that the early lateral development of the analyzed droplet did not occur through uniform self-similar expansion, but through non-uniform morphological evolution involving coupled height growth, footprint development, volume accumulation, and boundary regularization. Together, the coupled temporal measurements and direct geometric comparison demonstrate that DHM can quantify non-uniform three-dimensional morphological evolution and assess the limitations of simplified droplet geometries during early-stage condensation.

matches.title: Patterning surface textured plates with a viscoplastic fluid
matches.authors: Vanessa R. Kern, Marcel Moura, Pål E. S. Olsen, and Andreas Carlson

matches.abstract_en: Viscoplastic fluids can retain complex shapes after deposition, but controlling these shapes through interfacial instabilities remains challenging. Experiments with simultaneous side and bottom imaging in a lifted Hele-Shaw cell shows that submillimetric substrate structures can direct the fingering dynamics and determine the symmetry and morphology of the deposited fluid. The adhesive force decay as the plate is lifting is an interplay between capillary, yield-stress, and viscous forces, where a dynamic permeability links the preferred invasion directions to the anisotropy introduced by the substrate texture.

matches.title: The ‘step stall’ phenomenon of a supersonic Coanda jet
matches.title_zh: 超音速康达喷气机的“阶跃失速”现象
matches.authors: Zhao, Xinhai, Wang, Wanbo, Huang, Yong, Li, Chang, Wang, Yi
matches.abstract_zh: 本研究对步骤对超音速柯恩达喷气机脱离特性的影响进行了实验研究。通过系统地改变柯恩达表面半径、射流出口高度和台阶高度来进行参数分析。使用高速纹影和阴影图可视化捕获流动形态，同时使用压力传感器精确测量射流分离的临界喷嘴压力比 ( )。对于没有台阶的基线配置，通过平衡离心力和径向压力梯度的宏观力学模型来预测脱离（表示为 d ），确认了与几何比的幂律关系。台阶的引入揭示了一种新颖的“台阶失速”现象：虽然增加台阶高度最初会增强附着力，并通过简化波浪结构和抑制分离气泡来提高 d，但进一步增加超过临界最佳值会导致性能急剧下降。该最佳台阶高度可最大化分离 ，与归一化柯恩达半径呈线性关系。这种现象的解释是，当台阶高度过高导致射流核心无法被曲面有效“抓住”时，壁与射流相互作用无效。这些发现为优化先进流量控制应用中的柯恩达效应提供了重要的见解和实用的设计指南。
matches.abstract_en: This study presents an experimental investigation into the influence of a step on the detachment characteristics of a supersonic Coanda jet. A parametric analysis was conducted by systematically varying the Coanda surface radius, jet outlet height and step height. Flow morphology was captured using high-speed schlieren and shadowgraph visualisation, while the critical nozzle pressure ratio ( ) for jet detachment was precisely measured with pressure transducers. For the baseline configuration without a step, the detachment (denoted d ) was predicted by a macroscopic mechanical model balancing centrifugal force and the radial pressure gradient, confirming a power-law relationship with the geometric ratio. The introduction of a step revealed a novel ‘step stall’ phenomenon: while increasing the step height initially enhances attachment and raises d by simplifying wave structures and suppressing separation bubbles, a further increase beyond a critical optimal value causes a sharp drop in performance. This optimal step height, which maximises the detachment , is shown to have a linear relationship with the normalised Coanda radius. The phenomenon is explained by the ineffective wall–jet interaction when an excessive step height prevents the jet’s core from being effectively ‘grabbed’ by the curved surface. These findings provide critical insights and practical design guidelines for optimising the Coanda effect in advanced flow control applications.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop；方法：experimental、high-speed；降权方法：model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Transfer efficiency of electrostatically charged droplets sprayed on planar and curved surfaces
matches.title_zh: 喷涂在平面和曲面上的静电液滴的传输效率
matches.abstract_zh: 在静电喷涂中，最大限度地提高传输效率 (TE) 非常重要，传输效率定义为粘附到待喷漆部件上的喷涂液体的比例。在这项研究中，甘油（33 vol%）-水混合物被雾化，并由气流以 2-9 m/s 的速度流向圆柱体（6.5 cm、3.5 cm 和 1.5 cm 直径）、球体（6.5 cm 直径）和圆盘（10 cm 直径），并通过测量目标的重量增加并除以喷射液体的重量来确定 TE。在喷嘴施加和不施加 40 kV 电势的情况下进行了测试。开发了液滴传输的随机模型，其中目标周围的流动流线源自电势流解。假设液滴带电至瑞利极限且电场为一维。计算液滴上的静电力和阻力来预测它们的轨迹。研究发现传输效率随着气流速度和目标尺寸的增加而增加。 TE 的计算值与实验测量值非常吻合。惯性斯托克斯数是液滴弛豫时间与流动惯性时间的比值，表征了作用在液滴上的力。高 Sti 的液滴（即直径大且风速高的液滴）更有可能落在目标表面上。对喷嘴施加 40 kV 电压可显着提高低风速 (2 m/s) 下的 TE，其中 TE 提高约 40%。在高风速 (9 m/s) 下，静电场对 TE 的影响很小。静电斯托克斯数定义为静电时标与惯性时标之比。 $${\text{S}\text{t}}_{e}$$ 的值较小意味着静电力强烈影响液滴轨迹，因此通过迫使低速气流将小液滴输送到目标上来最有效地改善 TE。
matches.abstract_en: In electrostatic spray painting it is important to maximize transfer efficiency (TE), defined as the fraction of liquid sprayed that adheres to the part being painted. In this study a glycerin (33 vol%)-water mixture was atomized and carried by an air stream with velocities of 2–9 m/s towards cylinders (6.5 cm, 3.5 cm, and 1.5 cm diameters), spheres (6.5 cm diameter) and disks (10 cm diameter) and the TE determined by measuring the weight increase of the target and dividing by the weight of the liquid sprayed. Tests were done both with and without a 40 kV potential applied to the spray nozzle A stochastic model of droplet transport was developed in which flow streamlines around the targets were derived from potential flow solutions. Droplets were assumed to be charged to the Rayleigh limit and the electric field to be one-dimensional. Electrostatic and drag forces on droplets were calculated to predict their trajectories. Transfer efficiency was found to increase with airstream velocity and target size. Calculated values of TE agreed well with those measured in experiments. The inertial Stokes number, which is the ratio of the droplet relaxation time to the inertial time for the flow, characterizes the forces acting on droplets. Droplets with high Sti, which were those with large diameter and high air velocity, were more likely to land on the target surface. Applying a 40 kV potential to the spray nozzle significantly increased TE at low air velocities (2 m/s), where TE increased by approximately 40%. At high air velocities (9 m/s) the electrostatic field had little effect on TE. An electrostatic Stokes number was defined as the ratio of an electrostatic time scale to the inertial time scale. Small values of $${\text{S}\text{t}}_{e}$$ mean that electrostatic forces strongly influence droplet trajectory and are therefore most effective in improving TE by forcing small droplets transported by low velocity airflow onto the target.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets；方法：experiments；降权方法：model；期刊：Experiments in Fluids

matches.title: Experimental investigations on the flow characteristics of a permeable forward-facing step
matches.title_zh: 透水前向台阶流动特性实验研究
matches.abstract_zh: 采用粒子图像测速技术研究了可渗透前向台阶（PFFS）的流动特性，雷诺数为$$\text {Re}_h=3000$$、6000和9000，台阶孔隙率为$$\varphi =0$$、0.36、0.56和0.75。研究了孔隙率对流动特性的影响。随着 $$\varphi $$ 从 0.36 增加到 0.75，台阶前的再循环区域面积减小，这归因于渗透台阶的泄压作用。随着 $$\varphi $$ 从 0.36 增加到 0.75，$$\text {Re}_h=3000$$ 时，再附着长度和台阶上方再循环面积增加，而 $$\text {Re}_h=6000$$ 和 9000 时则呈现减小趋势。交换强度随着 $$\text {Re}_h$$ 的增加而增加。此外，对于三个$$\text {Re}_h$$，随着$$\varphi $$从0.36增加到0.75，阶跃之前的雷诺应力和湍流动能减小。对于$$\text {Re}_h=3000$$，在$$\varphi =0.36$$处，角涡演化至台阶的上游区域，展向涡由台阶上方的分离剪切层产生，并以集中涡度向下游移动。当$$\varphi $$增大到0.75时，角涡主要分布在台阶之前，翼展涡在其演化过程中由于界面处流体交换加剧而很容易消散。此外，流体的吹动在多孔界面的孔隙处诱发了具有正涡度的涡流结构。该研究有助于理解多孔介质对前向阶梯流的调制效应，并可用于工程应用中壁挂式结构的流动控制。
matches.abstract_en: The flow characteristics of a permeable forward-facing step (PFFS) are investigated with particle image velocimetry, and the Reynolds number is $$\text {Re}_h=3000$$, 6000 and 9000, and the porosity of the step is $$\varphi =0$$, 0.36, 0.56 and 0.75. The influences of the porosity on the flow characteristics are examined. The recirculation region area before the step is decreased as $$\varphi $$ increases from 0.36 to 0.75, which is attributed to the pressure-relief effect of the permeable step. As $$\varphi $$ increases from 0.36 to 0.75, the reattachment length and the recirculation area above the step are increased for $$\text {Re}_h=3000$$, while they exhibit a decreasing trend for $$\text {Re}_h=6000$$ and 9000. Fluid exchange at upper porous interface is dominated by the blowing of fluid, the higher porosity enhances the fluid exchange intensity, and the fluid exchange intensity is increased as $$\text {Re}_h$$ increases. Moreover, for the three $$\text {Re}_h$$, the Reynolds stresses and turbulent kinetic energy before the step are decreased as $$\varphi $$ increases from 0.36 to 0.75. For $$\text {Re}_h=3000$$, at $$\varphi =0.36$$, the corner vortex evolves to the upstream region of the step, and the spanwise vortex is generated from the separated shear layer above the step, and it moves downstream with concentrated vorticity. As $$\varphi $$ increases to 0.75, the corner vortex is mainly distributed before the step, and the spanwise vortex is easily dissipated during its evolution due to the intensified fluid exchange at the interface. In addition, the blowing of fluid induces the vortical structures with positive vorticity at the pores of the porous interface. This study is helpful for understanding the modulation effects of the porous media on the forward-facing step flow, and it may be utilized for flow control of the wall-mounted structures in engineering applications.

matches.title: Shear-free, inhomogeneous turbulence in a stably stratified fluid. Part 2. A wave–turbulence decomposition
matches.title_zh: 稳定分层流体中的无剪切、不均匀湍流。第 2 部分：波-湍流分解
matches.authors: Hass, Ryan, Lele, Sanjiva
matches.abstract_zh: 在 Hass & Lele (2026 J. Fluid Mech. 1037, A20) 中，我们研究了由上方的净零动量源层和下方的稳定密度界面界定的无剪切湍流层的统计结构（自相似性）和夹带率，并发现与振荡网格湍流实验一致。然而，稳定分层支持的界面波使得近界面区域的方差量化变得模糊。在本文中，我们提出了基于线性方程本征模的脉动场分解。低弗劳德数模拟的波数-频谱提供了线性模型合适的证据。使用分解，对波湍流统计数据进行详细分析，包括动能和势能的预算。发现了一种与 Hannoun & List (1988 J. Fluid Mech. 189, 211–234)、Fernando & Hunt (1997 J. Fluid Mech. 347, 197–234) 和 McGrath 等人提出的内部破波夹带机制一致的能量转换途径。 (1997 J.流体力学。347, 235–261)。局部定义的混合或通量系数与（局部）湍流弗劳德数成比例，其方式与传输完全为零的均匀湍流模拟相同。最后，我们将空间非均匀模拟与强分层湍流理论联系起来，证明该理论所需的参数范围原则上可以用于足够的能量强迫，但在我们的模拟中并未实现。
matches.abstract_en: In Hass & Lele (2026 J. Fluid Mech. 1037, A20), we looked at the statistical structure (self-similarity) and entrainment rate of a shear-free turbulent layer bounded by a net zero momentum source layer above and a stable density interface below and found agreement with oscillating grid turbulence experiments. However, interfacial waves supported by the stable stratification make quantification of variances in the near-interfacial region ambiguous. In the present paper we propose a decomposition of the fluctuating fields based on eigenmodes of the linearized equations. Evidence that a linear model is appropriate is provided by the wavenumber–frequency spectra for low Froude number simulations. Using the decomposition, a detailed analysis of the wave–turbulence statistics, including budgets of kinetic and potential energy, is conducted. An energy conversion pathway is uncovered consistent with the internal wave-breaking entrainment mechanism proposed by Hannoun & List (1988 J. Fluid Mech. 189, 211–234), Fernando & Hunt (1997 J. Fluid Mech. 347, 197–234), and McGrath et al. (1997 J. Fluid Mech. 347, 235–261). A locally defined mixing or flux coefficient scales with the (local) turbulent Froude number in the same way as in homogeneous turbulence simulations where transport is identically zero. Finally, we connect our spatially inhomogeneous simulations to the strongly stratified turbulence theory demonstrating that the parameter regime required by the theory is, in principle, accessible for sufficiently energetic forcing, but is not realized in our simulations.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interfacial、interface；方法：experiments；降权方法：simulations、model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Hydrodynamics of laminar jet apparatuses for gas–liquid mass transfer experiments
matches.title_zh: 用于气液传质实验的层流喷射装置的流体动力学
matches.authors: Großmann, Oliver, Schönecker, Clarissa, Jirasek, Fabian, Hasse, Hans
matches.abstract_zh: 层流喷射装置（LJAs）用于研究气液传质，从而为技术分离和反应设备的设计提供见解。层流射流的流体动力学决定了此类装置的操作窗口，因此必须理解层流射流的流体动力学才能正确评估实验结果。尽管存在大量关于自由液体射流的文献，但直接针对 LJA 及其运行条件的定量分析仍然很少。目前的工作解决了这一差距。我们使用计算流体动力学 (CFD) 模拟研究与 LJA 运行相关的所有流体动力学方面：射流表面的形状（即气液界面）、射流内的速度分布（包括从喷嘴到自由射流的过渡）和射流破碎。该研究针对不同流动条件下的方边孔板喷嘴进行，并使用无量纲数进行分析。 CFD 模拟考虑了重力和表面张力，并包含整个相关域（进料管线、喷嘴、液体射流和周围气相）。使用 LJA 进行的补充实验（测量射流形状）验证了模拟结果。研究结果为 LJA 的合理设计提供了定量指导，并为取代实验评估中的临时假设提供了基础。
matches.abstract_en: Laminar jet apparatuses (LJAs) are employed to study gas–liquid mass transfer and thereby provide insights into the design of technical separation and reaction equipment. The hydrodynamics of the laminar jet determines the operating window of such apparatuses and must therefore be understood for the proper evaluation of experimental results. Although substantial literature exists on free liquid jets, quantitative analyses directly tailored to LJAs and their operating conditions remain scarce. The present work addresses this gap. We investigate all hydrodynamic aspects relevant to the operation of LJAs using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations: the shape of the jet surface (i.e. the gas–liquid interface), the velocity profile within the jet (including the transition from the nozzle to the free jet) and jet breakup. The study is conducted for a square-edged orifice plate nozzle under various flow conditions and analysed using dimensionless numbers. The CFD simulations account for gravity and surface tension and comprise the entire relevant domain (feed line, nozzle, liquid jet and surrounding gas phase). Complementary experiments using a LJA, in which the jet shape was measured, validate the simulation results. The findings provide quantitative guidance for rational design of LJAs and offer a foundation for replacing ad hoc assumptions in the evaluation of the experiments.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interface、surface tension、mass transfer；方法：experimental、experiments；降权方法：simulation、simulations、computational；期刊：Flow

matches.title: Self-similar effective-to-apparent contact line length ratio in droplet friction on textured surfaces
matches.title_zh: 纹理表面上液滴摩擦的自相似有效与表观接触线长度比
matches.abstract_zh: 有效促进液滴钉扎的三相接触线的长度是润湿中最重要的参数之一。然而，有效接触线的定义、量化和利用仍不清楚，因此预测超疏水表面上Cassie-Baxter状态的液滴的摩擦力仍然具有挑战性，通常采用拟合常数k。这里，我们定义一个参数，称为有效与表观接触线长度比x，即有助于液滴钉扎的有效接触线长度与滑动接触线表观长度的比率，来表达拟合常数k。通过定制同时测量液滴粘附力、接触线动力学和液滴形状的装置，建立了基于微柱尺寸和表面固有润湿性的接触线长度比的表达式。然后，建立了预测液滴摩擦的模型，并通过本研究和先前研究中报告的实验数据进行了证实。通过同时测量液滴粘附力和接触线动力学，本研究引入了一个称为有效与表观接触线长度比的参数。该参数产生一个预测液滴摩擦力的模型，无论微观结构尺寸、固有润湿性和液滴体积的变化如何。
matches.abstract_en: The length of a three-phase contact line that effectively contributes to droplet pinning is one of the most important parameters in wetting. However, the definition, quantification, and utilization of the effective contact line remain unclear, thereby predicting the friction of droplets in the Cassie-Baxter state on superhydrophobic surfaces remains challenging and a fitting constant k is typically adopted. Here, we define a parameter termed effective-to-apparent contact line length ratio x, that is, the ratio of the effective contact line length that contributes to droplet pinning to the apparent length of the sliding contact line, to express the fitting constant k. By customizing a setup that simultaneously measures the droplet adhesion forces, contact line dynamics, and droplet shapes, the expression of contact line length ratio based on micropillar dimensions and surface intrinsic wettability is established. Then, a model predicting droplet friction is established and corroborated by the experimental data reported in this and prior studies. By simultaneously measuring the droplet adhesion force and contact line dynamics, this study introduces a parameter termed the effective-to-apparent contact line length ratio. This parameter leads to a model predicting droplet friction forces regardless of the variations in microstructure dimension, intrinsic wettability, and droplet volume.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、wetting、contact line；方法：experimental；降权方法：model；期刊：Nature Portfolio: Fluid dynamics

matches.title: Salt mediated actuation of membranized coacervate droplets for regulation of enzymatic reactions
matches.title_zh: 盐介导的膜化凝聚液滴的驱动用于调节酶反应
matches.abstract_zh: 运输调节是控制活细胞内生物网络的重要设计元素。它在凝聚微滴中的实施，其中反应动力学被调节，将使得适应性细胞样区室的设计成为可能。然而，膜的缺乏限制了凝聚微滴作为人造细胞的潜力。在此，我们提出了一种简单的策略，通过添加强聚电解质介导的固体聚电解质复合物的界面形成来稳定凝聚微滴。盐的添加引发膜化凝聚层液滴内的网络膨胀，而盐的去除则引起消膨胀。通过交替盐流和水流可以实现盐介导的化学机械驱动的几个循环。驱动液滴保持松散交联的凝聚层内部，与非驱动液滴相比，允许更快的质量传输，从而使内部酶促反应的速率加倍。我们的工作引入了一种控制凝聚层反应动力学的替代机制，并扩展了人工细胞内原代谢调节的工具箱。为了使凝聚层更接近逼真的结构，运输调节至关重要，但实现起来具有挑战性。在这里，作者报告了使用盐添加来化学机械地驱动凝聚液滴并调节其中的运输以控制酶反应。
matches.abstract_en: Regulation of transport is an essential design element for controlling biological networks within living cells. Its implementation within coacervate microdroplets, where reaction kinetics are modulated, would enable the design of adaptive cell-like compartments. Yet, the lack of a membrane limits the potential of coacervate microdroplets as artificial cells. Herein, we present a simple strategy to stabilize coacervate microdroplets via interfacial formation of solid polyelectrolyte complexes mediated by addition of a strong polyelectrolyte. Salt addition triggers network swelling within the membranized coacervate droplets, while salt removal induces deswelling. Several cycles of salt-mediated chemomechanical actuation can be achieved by alternating salt and water flows. The actuating droplets maintain a loosely cross-linked coacervate interior, allowing faster mass transport compared to non-actuating droplets, thereby doubling the rate of enzymatic reactions hosted within. Our work introduces an alternate mechanism for controlling reaction kinetics in coacervates and expands the toolbox for protometabolic regulation within artificial cells. For coacervates to be closer to lifelike constructs, transport regulation is essential, but challenging to achieve. Here, the authors report the use of salt addition to chemomechanically actuate coacervate droplets and regulate transport within them to control enzymatic reactions.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets、interfacial；期刊：Nature Portfolio: Soft materials
