matches.title: A contaminant-concentration-dependent surface tension does not explain the absence of solutal Marangoni flow in evaporating droplets
matches.title_zh: 与污染物浓度相关的表面张力并不能解释蒸发液滴中不存在溶液马兰戈尼流
matches.authors: Javier Mart\'inez-Puig, Th\'eophile Gaichies, Javier Rodr\'iguez-Rodr\'iguez
matches.abstract_zh: 蒸发液滴的理论模型预测马兰戈尼流动的速度比实验观察到的要快几个数量级。虽然这种差异通常归因于表面污染，但污染物削弱马兰戈尼应力的根本机制仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们将粒子图像测速 (PIV) 实验与耦合流体动力学和溶质输运模型进行比较，以研究蒸发含有盐、甘油或乙醇的水滴的内部流动。通过分析固着液滴和悬垂液滴，我们证明流动完全由自然对流驱动，这与使用表面张力梯度的理论预测相反。值得注意的是，在某些情况下，发现实验表面速度与预测的表面张力梯度相反。我们进一步证明，常用的污染模型——无论是基于降低表面张力的表面活性剂还是基于表面流变学——都无法解释这种流动逆转，因为当表面速度与表面张力梯度相反时，它们需要表面活性剂逆流输送。我们的结果表明，需要重新考虑这些模型来解释蒸发液滴中不存在溶质马兰戈尼。
matches.abstract_en: Theoretical models of evaporating droplets predict Marangoni flows orders of magnitude faster than those observed experimentally. While this discrepancy is often attributed to surface contamination, the underlying mechanism by which contaminants weaken Marangoni stresses remains unclear. In this study, we compare particle image velocimetry (PIV) experiments with a coupled hydrodynamic and solute transport model to investigate the internal flow of evaporating aqueous droplets containing salt, glycerol, or ethanol. By analyzing both sessile and pendant droplets, we demonstrate that the flow is driven entirely by natural convection, in contrast to theoretical predictions that use surface-tension gradients. Remarkably, in some cases, the experimental surface velocity is found to be directed against the predicted surface-tension gradient. We further prove that commonly used contamination models---whether based on surfactants lowering the surface tension or on surface rheology---cannot account for this flow reversal, as they would require the surfactant to be transported against the flow when the surface velocity is opposed to the surface-tension gradient. Our results show that a reconsideration of these models is required to explain the absence of solutal Marangoni in evaporating droplets.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets、evaporating、Marangoni、Marangoni flow、Marangoni flows、Marangoni stresses、surface-tension gradient、surface tension；方法：experimental、experiments、PIV；降权方法：model、models；期刊：arXiv: Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Thermosolutal Marangoni instabilities in a weakly viscoelastic falling film with soluble surfactant
matches.title_zh: 具有可溶性表面活性剂的弱粘弹性降膜中的热溶质马兰戈尼不稳定性
matches.authors: Sanghasri Mukhopadhyay, Severine Millet, Bastien Di Pierro, Asim Mukhopadhyay
matches.abstract_zh: 我们研究了含有可溶性表面活性剂和弱粘弹性液体的加热降膜的线性稳定性和非线性演化。应力响应由短记忆沃尔特斯模型描述，而表面张力取决于温度和表面浓度。奥尔-索末菲分析及其长波极限决定了弹性记忆和两个马兰戈尼应力如何进入不稳定阈值。然后导出五场加权残差模型来描述有限幅度扰动。体积和表面传输方程是用兼容的通量编写的，这在周期域中保留了它们组合的预计表面活性剂库存。数值算例表明，溶质马兰戈尼应力抑制了扰动的增长并降低了非线性波的振幅。马兰戈尼热应力增加了最大增长率，尽管它对不稳定波数带宽度的影响不同。弹性记忆会改变起始响应和有限波长响应。非线性分布形成主要的驼峰和毛细管波纹，并伴随着体积浓度、表面浓度和界面温度的变化。这些结果描述了保留长波模型内热毛细管力、表面活性剂重新分布和弹性应力之间的竞争。较大的弹性参数被解释为截断本构方程的形式预测，而不是强弹性流的受控扩展。
matches.abstract_en: We examine the linear stability and nonlinear evolution of a heated falling film containing a soluble surfactant and a weakly viscoelastic liquid. The stress response is described by the short-memory Walters model, while surface tension depends on temperature and surface concentration. An Orr--Sommerfeld analysis and its long-wave limit determine how elastic memory and the two Marangoni stresses enter the instability threshold. A five-field weighted-residual model is then derived to describe finite-amplitude disturbances. The bulk and surface transport equations are written with compatible fluxes, which conserve their combined projected surfactant inventory in a periodic domain. The numerical examples show that solutal Marangoni stress suppresses disturbance growth and reduces the amplitude of the nonlinear waves. Thermal Marangoni stress increases the maximum growth rate, although its effect on the width of the unstable wavenumber band is different. Elastic memory changes both the onset and the finite-wavelength response. The nonlinear profiles develop a main hump and capillary ripples, accompanied by variations in bulk concentration, surface concentration, and interfacial temperature. These results describe the competition between thermocapillary forcing, surfactant redistribution and elastic stress within the retained long-wave model. The larger elastic parameters are interpreted as formal predictions of the truncated constitutive equations, rather than as a controlled extension to strongly elastic flow.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：Marangoni、Marangoni stress、Marangoni stresses、thermocapillary、capillary、interfacial、surface tension；降权方法：model；期刊：arXiv: Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Marangoni flow induced by crystallization in saline droplets
matches.title_zh: 盐水滴结晶诱导的马兰戈尼流
matches.authors: Th\'eophile Gaichies, Javier Mart\'inez-Puig, Javier Rodr\'iguez Rodr\'iguez
matches.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了固着液滴中氯化钠结晶引起的流动。我们测量结晶过程中的流速约为 1 $\mathrm{cm.s^{-1}}，比之前研究报告的流速高两个数量级。我们表明，这种差异是由于早期实验中的表面污染物造成的。数值模拟表明，在清洁情况下，流动由马兰戈尼应力驱动，而在污染情况下，流动由密度驱动。因此，液滴清洁度显着影响流动，进而决定晶体的生长速率。
matches.abstract_en: In this article, we study the flow induced by crystallization of sodium chloride in sessile droplets. We measure flow velocities on the order of 1 $\mathrm{cm.s^{-1}} during crystallization, two orders of magnitude higher than those reported in previous studies. We show that this discrepancy is due to surface contaminants in earlier experiments. Numerical simulations reveal that in the clean case, the flow is driven by Marangoni stresses, whereas it is density- driven in the contaminated case. Consequently, droplet cleanliness significantly influences the flow which, in turn, determines the growth rate of crystals.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、Marangoni、Marangoni flow、Marangoni stresses；方法：experiments；降权方法：numerical simulations、simulations；期刊：arXiv: Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Lateral self-propulsion of Marangoni droplets in stratified fluids
matches.title_zh: 分层流体中马兰戈尼液滴的横向自推进
matches.authors: Li, Xiaolai, Ribe, Neil M., Li, Yanshen, Li, Xiangwei, Guo, Wei, Wu, Changjin, Tan, Huanshu, Shum, Ho Cheung
matches.abstract_zh: 液体的稳定垂直分层显着影响浸入其中的刚性体和可变形体的动力学。最近的研究表明，表面张力梯度引起的浮力和马兰戈尼对流之间的相互作用导致浸入稳定浓度梯度（例如水中的乙醇）的液滴（例如硅油）周期性垂直弹跳。在这里，我们报告说，当液滴的半径足够大时，这种液滴还表现出横向自推进，这可能会或可能不会伴随弹跳。我们从实验和理论上研究了液滴半径和乙醇浓度梯度的大小如何影响自推进的开始以及远超出开始的稳定横向自推进速度。我们发现，当液滴马兰戈尼数超过临界值（ ）时，就会发生横向自推进，此时初始轴对称流场会发生自发对称破缺。该条件意味着横向自推进的临界液滴半径与溶质浓度梯度大小的幂成正比，这一结果与实验一致。远远超出起始点，自推进速度与理论马兰戈尼速度成比例，以获得无限扩散率。这些发现为生物系统建模和开发微型机器人等各种应用提供了见解。
matches.abstract_en: Stable vertical stratification of liquids significantly influences the dynamics of both rigid and deformable bodies immersed in them. Recent research has shown that the interplay between buoyancy and Marangoni convection induced by surface tension gradients gives rise to periodic vertical bouncing of droplets (e.g. of silicone oil) immersed in a stable concentration gradient (e.g. of ethanol in water). Here, we report that such droplets also exhibit lateral self-propulsion, which may or may not be accompanied by bouncing, when the radius of the droplet is large enough. We investigate experimentally and theoretically how the droplet radius and the magnitude of the ethanol concentration gradient influence the onset of self-propulsion and the steady lateral self-propulsion speed far beyond onset. We find that lateral self-propulsion occurs when the droplet Marangoni number exceeds a critical value ( ), at which point spontaneous symmetry breaking of the initially axisymmetric flow field occurs. The condition implies that the critical droplet radius for lateral self-propulsion scales as the power of the magnitude of the solute concentration gradient, a result that is consistent with experiment. Far beyond onset, the self-propulsion speed scales with the theoretical Marangoni velocity for infinite diffusivity. These findings offer insights for diverse applications such as modelling biological systems and developing microrobots.

matches.title: Diffusiophoresis of a non-polar fluid droplet laden with soluble ionic surfactants
matches.authors: Majhi, Subrata, Bhattacharyya, Somnath
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: We investigate the diffusiophoresis of a non-polarizable droplet laden with soluble ionic surfactant, in which the surface charge arises from the adsorption of surfactant at the fluid–fluid interface. Unlike previous studies which assume either a fixed surface charge or instantaneous equilibrium between the interface and the adjacent electrolyte, we formulate the interfacial transport based on the mass-balance framework, incorporating Langmuir adsorption–desorption kinetics and finite surface diffusivity. The coupled electrokinetic problem is solved using a perturbation approach with imposed ionic concentration as a perturbation parameter. Analytical expressions for the droplet mobility and interfacial velocity are derived based on the Debye–Hückel approximation as well as the thin layer consideration for the insoluble surfactant, which are found to agree with the numerical results in the corresponding limits. We demonstrate that consideration of a uniform, immobile surface charge leads to an unphysical singular mobility, whereas allowing the surface charge to evolve through interfacial surfactant redistribution yields continuous and physically consistent droplet diffusiophoresis. Increasing the desorption rate enhances surfactant redistribution and Marangoni stress, which weakens the negative mobility created by the electrophoresis part, reverses the direction of motion by enhancing the chemiphoretic contribution, and subsequently leads to a strong enhancement of positive mobility before eventual saturation in the transport-limited regime. The dependence of mobility on viscosity ratio and electrolyte composition further reveals how mixed electrolytes provide a robust means of tuning droplet motion. This study underscores the crucial role of adsorption–desorption dynamics and interfacial transport of soluble ionic surfactants in governing the diffusiophoresis of fluid particles, with implications for droplet manipulation in microfluidic system in imposed salinity gradients.

matches.title: On the role of water activity in the formation of a protein-rich coffee ring in an evaporating multicomponent drop
matches.authors: Martínez-Puig, Javier, D’Agostino, Gianluca, Oña, Ana, Rodríguez-Rodríguez, Javier
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: The coffee-ring effect is a universal feature of evaporating sessile droplets with a pinned contact line, wherein solutes or particles are advected to the droplet’s edge due to evaporation-driven flows. Here, we investigate model respiratory droplets primarily composed of water, salt and a type of the glycoprotein mucin. Using fluorescence microscopy, we observe the formation of a well-defined protein ring at the droplet edge as water evaporates. The growth and morphology of this ring exhibit a strong dependence on ambient relative humidity ( ), revealing a dynamics that existing models cannot capture. While existing models have successfully described the formation of the coffee ring in particle-laden droplets, they often assume that the evaporative flux, and thus the hydrodynamics, is decoupled from solute transport. This assumption breaks down in complex fluids, such as protein or polymeric solutions, where the solute can influence evaporation through changes in water activity. Specifically, we find that protein accumulation at the edge is governed by the feedback between local solute concentration and evaporation rate. To account for this, we develop a minimal theoretical model based on the lubrication approximation, incorporating the coupling between the hydrodynamics and solute transport through the evaporation rate. Our framework reproduces key features of the experimental observations and suggests a physical basis for the -dependent stability and infectivity of respiratory droplets containing viruses.

matches.title: Modelling droplet–particle interactions on solid surfaces by coupling the lattice Boltzmann and discrete element methods
matches.authors: Naga, Abhinav, Zhang, Xitong, Yang, Junyu, Kusumaatmaja, Halim
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: We develop a three-dimensional numerical scheme for investigating interfacial flows coupled with frictional solid particles. Our approach combines the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) to model the dynamics of a two-component fluid, and the discrete element method (DEM) to model normal reaction, sliding friction and rolling friction between solid particles and between particles and solid surfaces. Key to the coupling between the fluid and particle dynamics are the momentum exchange method to transfer hydrodynamic forces between the fluids and particles, a geometric boundary condition to tune particle wettability, and a capillary force model describing surface tension forces between particles and liquid–fluid interfaces. We rigorously validate the contact forces by investigating the dynamics of a particle bouncing off a solid surface and rolling down an inclined plane, the hydrodynamic force by the Segrè–Silberberg effect and the capillary force by particle detachment from a liquid–fluid interface. Motivated by the self-cleaning properties of lotus leaves, we apply the method to investigate how drops remove contaminant particles from surfaces. We successfully reproduce scenarios reported experimentally by Naga et al. (2021 a Soft Matt . 17(7), 1746–1755) by tuning the particle friction. Furthermore, the LBM–DEM approach allows us to systematically explore the effects of particle friction coefficients, drop size and speed. Our method opens opportunities to study numerous phenomena involving particle dynamics interacting with interfacial flows, including soil erosion, capillary-driven colloidal self-assembly and how raindrops transport microplastics in the environment. It also makes it possible to control parameters that are difficult to tune independently in experiments, including contact angles, surface tension and friction coefficients.

matches.abstract_zh: 台面（具有平顶的凸起区域）上的液滴蒸发发生在喷涂、微反应器和印刷电子制造中。在印刷电子制造中，通常需要保持固定接触线，而在宽而短的台面上沉积液滴提供了一种简单而有效的方法来实现这一点。我们将流动可视化实验与数学建模相结合，系统地表征高度远小于宽度的台面上的接触线运动。流动可视化显示，接触线在台面边缘钉扎了很长一段时间，较低的加热温度或较大的初始液体体积进一步延长了这种钉扎。为了解释这些趋势，我们构建了一种基于润滑理论的模型，该模型采用前体膜/分离压力方法来解释接触线运动，并采用单侧框架来描述蒸发。数值解表明，较高的加热温度会增强液滴边缘附近的蒸发，从而缩短钉扎时间，而较大的初始液体体积会导致更多的凸面界面和更强的向外流动，从而延长钉扎时间。我们的模型定性地解释了实验趋势，并提出了控制印刷电子制造中液滴钉扎的策略。
matches.abstract_en: Droplet evaporation on a mesa, a raised region with a flat top, occurs in spray coating, microreactors and printed-electronics fabrication. In printed-electronics fabrication, maintaining a pinned contact line is often desirable, and depositing droplets on wide and short mesas offers a simple and effective way to achieve this. We combine flow-visualisation experiments with mathematical modelling to systematically characterise contact-line motion on mesas having heights much smaller than their widths. Flow visualisation reveals that the contact line pins at the mesa edge for a significant amount of time, with lower heating temperatures or larger initial liquid volumes further prolonging this pinning. To interpret these trends, we construct a lubrication-theory-based model that employs a precursor-film/disjoining-pressure approach to account for contact-line motion and a one-sided framework to describe evaporation. Numerical solutions reveal that higher heating temperatures enhance evaporation near the droplet edge, leading to shorter pinning times, while larger initial liquid volumes induce more convex interfaces and stronger outward flows, which extend the pinning. Our model qualitatively explains the experimental trends and suggests strategies for controlling droplet pinning in printed-electronics fabrication.

matches.title: An inverse-square force between evaporating sessile droplets
matches.authors: Jiang, Zhi Wu, Wen, Zuo Han, Ding, Hang, Li, Er Qiang

matches.abstract_en: In this study, we present the discovery of an inverse-square force between evaporating sessile droplets. We find that one evaporating sessile droplet exerts a driving force on another, with the magnitude of the force decaying inversely proportional to the square of distance between their centres. The inverse-distance decay of the vapour concentration generated by the source droplet is a key ingredient leading to the inverse-square form of the force. A theoretical framework combining continuum hydrodynamics with an effective capillary line-force representation is developed to rationalize this force. The inverse-square form is robust over ranges of droplet size, composition and ambient humidity. Its broader applicability is further supported by our analysis of previously published kinematic data for pure-liquid sessile droplets and thermocapillary floating droplets.

matches.title: Characterization of the laminar–turbulent transition in helically coiled reactors: an experimental study using high-speed PIV and LDV
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: Helically coiled reactors (HCRs) are increasingly employed in industrial applications due to their enhanced heat and mass transfer characteristics, compact design and improved mixing performance compared to straight tube systems. Despite their widespread use, a significant gap remains in the literature regarding the transition from laminar to turbulent flow within such geometries. Most existing studies rely primarily on pressure drop measurements for flow characterization, while comprehensive velocity-based investigations remain scarce. In this work, a detailed qualitative and quantitative characterization of the laminar–turbulent transition in a helical reactor is presented. An experimental set-up was developed to perform high-speed particle image velocimetry (PIV) measurements across a wide range of Reynolds numbers (Re = 500…9500). Various markers are employed to identify and analyse the onset of turbulence: visual flow patterns represented through carpet plots and pseudo-3D visualizations, statistical quantities such as standard deviation and turbulence intensity and the root mean square (RMS) of vorticity as a Lyne vortex indicator. Additionally, spectral analyses are conducted using power spectral density (PSD) evaluation, along with the estimation of dissipation rates and Kolmogorov time $$\tau$$ and length scales $${\eta}_{\tau }$$ to assess the small-scale turbulent structures. Pseudo-3D visualizations reveal first turbulent structures at $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=2400$$ and a constant presence of additional vortex structures at $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=6000$$. Analysis of the standard deviation and turbulence intensity reveals a transition between $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=2400\dots 4800$$. The frequency analysis with PSD shows full turbulence at $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=7000$$. Vorticity analysis and dissipation rates support a transition area between $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=2400\dots 5000$$. These various ranges reveal that predicting exactly the transition point of course depends on the retained definition, with many different approaches documented in the literature. Keeping this in mind, it is still possible to give a lower boundary for the onset of transition around $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=2400$$ and an upper boundary to a fully turbulent flow within the whole cross section at $${\text{R}\text{e}}_{\text{c}\text{r}\text{i}\text{t}}=7000$$ for the considered geometry (curvature ratio $$\delta =0.847$$, inner tube diameter $${d}_{i}=10 \text{m}\text{m}$$). matches.title: Simultaneous measurement of 3D velocity and 2D temperature fields for unsteady thermocapillary convection in thin liquid films
matches.title_zh: 同时测量薄液膜中非稳态热毛细管对流的 3D 速度和 2D 温度场
matches.abstract_zh: 由表面张力梯度驱动的热毛细管对流控制着从薄液膜到熔融材料加工的各种长度尺度上的界面传输现象。在晶体生长技术中，高纯度块状单晶通常采用直拉法和浮区法制造，其中热毛细管不稳定性产生的热液波 (HTW) 会诱发缺陷。 HTW 动力学数字孪生的开发有可能实现流量控制和优化晶体生长。然而，这样的框架需要三维 (3D) 速度信息，而 HTW 的完整 3D 速度结构尚未通过实验得到解决。在这项研究中，我们使用断层立体粒子图像测速 (TSPIV) 结合自由表面温度的同步红外 (IR) 热成像技术，测量了薄液膜中完全发育的 HTW 的 3D 速度场。实验在充满硅油（普朗特数 16.1）的矩形容器中进行。 HTW 的特征，包括传播角、频率、相速度和空间波数，均被量化，并与之前的研究显示出良好的一致性。重要的是，体积测量揭示了三维辊组织及其与表面温度模式的直接对应关系，这是无法从以前的二维或点状测量中推断出来的。特别是，通过速度-温度耦合分析来识别自由表面附近的源流和吸流区域。这些结果为 HTW 的三维结构和热流耦合提供了新的物理见解，并支持使用基于红外的温度数据来构建热毛细管对流的数字孪生。
matches.abstract_en: Thermocapillary convection driven by surface-tension gradients governs interfacial transport phenomena across a wide range of length scales, from thin liquid films to molten material processing. In crystal growth technologies, high-purity bulk single crystals are typically fabricated using the Czochralski and floating-zone methods, where hydrothermal waves (HTWs) arising from thermocapillary instabilities can induce defects. The development of a digital twin for HTW dynamics has the potential to enable flow control and optimize crystal growth. However, such a framework requires three-dimensional (3D) velocity information, while the full 3D velocity structure of HTWs has not yet been experimentally resolved. In this study, we measure the 3D velocity field of a fully developed HTW in a thin liquid film using tomographic stereo particle image velocimetry (TSPIV), combined with simultaneous infrared (IR) thermography of the free-surface temperature. Experiments are conducted in a rectangular container filled with silicone oil (Prandtl number 16.1). Characteristic HTW features, including propagation angle, frequency, phase velocity, and spatial wavenumber, are quantified and show good agreement with previous studies. Importantly, the volumetric measurements reveal three-dimensional roll organization and its direct correspondence with surface temperature patterns, which cannot be inferred from previous two-dimensional or pointwise measurements. In particular, source and suction flow regions near the free surface are identified through coupled velocity–temperature analysis. These results provide new physical insight into the three-dimensional structure and thermal–flow coupling of HTWs and support the use of IR-based temperature data for constructing digital twins of thermocapillary convection.

matches.title_zh: 表面附着的活性液滴的形态动力学
matches.abstract_zh: 许多生物和合成系统都是定向主动运动部件的悬浮体。与被动悬架不同，定向顺序、主动流动以及与边界的相互作用之间的相互作用在主动悬架中产生了令人着迷的新现象。在这里，我们研究了活性流体表面附着的液滴（“活性液滴”）的典型示例，迄今为止仅在细液滴的理想化极限下对其进行了研究。我们发现，这种表面附着的主动液滴可以表现出多种稳定的稳态形状和内部流动，这些形状和内部流动比之前记录的要丰富得多，具体取决于边界条件和主动应力的强度。我们的分析揭示了预测甚至合理控制这些不同状态出现的条件的定量原理，从而产生了下一代活性材料的设计原理。活性物质系统，包括消耗能量产生运动的生物和合成成分，表现出受其与边界相互作用影响的复杂行为。这项研究表明，表面附着的活性液滴可以采用各种稳定的形状和内部流动，显着扩展了我们对其形态动力学的理解，并为先进活性材料的设计提供了见解。
matches.abstract_en: Many biological and synthetic systems are suspensions of oriented actively-moving components. Unlike in passive suspensions, the interplay between orientational order, active flows, and interactions with boundaries gives rise to fascinating new phenomena in such active suspensions. Here, we examine the paradigmatic example of a surface-attached drop of an active fluid (an “active drop”), which has so far only been studied in the idealized limit of thin drops. We find that such surface-attached active drops can exhibit a wide array of stable steady-state shapes and internal flows that are far richer than those documented previously, depending on boundary conditions and the strength of active stresses. Our analysis uncovers quantitative principles to predict and even rationally control the conditions under which these different states arise—yielding design principles for next-generation active materials. Active matter systems, which include biological and synthetic components that consume energy to generate motion, exhibit complex behaviors influenced by their interactions with boundaries. This study reveals that surface-attached active drops can adopt a diverse range of stable shapes and internal flows, significantly expanding our understanding of their morphodynamics and providing insights for the design of advanced active materials.

matches.title: Fast microjets from expanding and collapsing cavitation bubbles into a capillary
matches.title_zh: 将空化气泡膨胀和塌缩到毛细管中产生快速微射流
matches.authors: Da-Hao Xie, Jiapeng Dai, Junjie Zhou, Shi-Min Li, Xiying Niu, A-Man Zhang, Qingyun Zeng
matches.abstract_zh: 在毛细管出口附近破裂的空化气泡可以产生快速的微射流，该微射流渗透到通道中并促进流体交换。在这里，我们结合高速成像和轴对称可压缩流体体积模拟来研究长毛细管出口附近激光诱导的空化气泡。通过改变间隔距离，主要影响后来的射流动力学，包括冲击位置和蒸汽射流渗透到毛细管中。与气泡在接近零间隔距离的光滑刚性壁附近塌陷产生的针状射流相比，这里的波驱动射流发生在更宽的参数范围内，并且其速度和大小可以进行几何调整。这些结果建立了毛细管边界附近空化驱动喷射的物理框架，并提出了微流体和生物医学应用中控制受限微射流的策略。
matches.abstract_en: Cavitation bubbles collapsing near capillary exits can generate fast microjets that penetrate into the channel and promote fluid exchange. Here, we combine high-speed imaging and axisymmetric compressible volume-of-fluid simulations to study laser-induced cavitation bubbles near the exit of a long capillary. By varying the stand-off distance mainly affects the later jet dynamics, including the impact location and vapour-jet penetration into the capillary. Compared with the needle jet generated by a bubble collapsing near a smooth rigid wall at nearly zero stand-off distance, the wave-driven jet here occurs over a much wider parameter range and its velocity and size can be tuned geometrically. These results establish a physical framework for cavitation-driven jetting near capillary boundaries and suggest strategies for controlling confined microjets in microfluidics and biomedical applications.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary；方法：high-speed、high-speed imaging；降权方法：simulations；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Visualization of bubble dynamics in biomimetic leaf-inspired flow channels during alkaline water electrolysis
matches.title_zh: 碱性水电解过程中仿生叶流道中气泡动力学的可视化
matches.abstract_zh: 进行了可视化实验研究，以阐明碱性水电解过程中仿生叶子流道中的多尺度气泡动力学。使用高速成像，定量分析了分层通道和镍网电极上的气泡行为。结果揭示了通道之间的协同作用：主通道驱动流体循环和气泡排出，次通道输送大的聚结气泡，细化通道促进气泡生长和合并。随着电解液温度从40℃升高到80℃，平均气泡速度从0.50μm·s−1升高到0.84μm·s−1，而平均脱离时间从35s降低到8s。脱离直径收敛于 300 µm 附近。这些结果表明，升高的温度会降低粘度和表面张力，加速气泡的形成和均匀化分离。分层仿生流道增强了气体排出，为优化高效碱性电解槽中的传质和结构设计提供了定量见解。
matches.abstract_en: A visualized experimental study was conducted to elucidate multiscale bubble dynamics in a biomimetic leaf-inspired flow channel during alkaline water electrolysis. Using high-speed imaging, bubble behaviors across hierarchical channels and on the nickel mesh electrode were quantitatively analyzed. The results reveal a synergistic function among channels: the main channel drives fluid circulation and bubble discharge, the secondary channel transports large coalesced bubbles, and the refined channel promotes bubble growth and merging. As the electrolyte temperature increased from 40 to 80 °C, the average bubble velocity rose from 0.50 to 0.84 µm·s−1, while the mean detachment time decreased from 35 to 8 s. The detachment diameter converged near 300 µm. These results indicate that elevated temperatures reduce viscosity and surface tension, accelerating bubble evolution and homogenizing detachment. The hierarchical biomimetic flow channel enhances gas evacuation, providing quantitative insights for optimizing mass transfer and structural design in high-efficiency alkaline electrolyzers.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：surface tension、mass transfer；方法：experimental、high-speed、high-speed imaging；期刊：Experiments in Fluids

matches.abstract_zh: 载有可溶性表面活性剂的重力驱动薄膜在涂层技术和微流体系统中发挥着核心作用，其中降阶模型被广泛用于预测界面动力学。然而，一些加权残留配方会引入虚假的界面质量增长，违反表面活性剂总守恒定律。我们通过开发保守的加权残差模型解决了这种不一致问题，该模型始终耦合壁滑移、吸附-解吸和马兰戈尼效应，同时严格保留表面活性剂总质量。由此产生的框架提供了对不稳定开始、非线性波动力学和表面活性剂输运的物理一致的预测。
matches.abstract_en: Gravity-driven thin films laden with soluble surfactants play a central role in coating technologies and microfluidic systems, where reduced-order models are widely used to predict interfacial dynamics. Some weighted-residual formulations, however, introduce spurious interfacial mass growth, violating total surfactant conservation. We resolve this inconsistency by developing a conservative weighted-residual model that consistently couples wall slip, adsorption-desorption, and the Marangoni effect while rigorously preserving total surfactant mass. The resulting framework provides physically consistent predictions of instability onset, nonlinear wave dynamics, and surfactant transport.

matches.abstract_en: This theoretical report explores a double emulsion droplet in a two-directional shear creeping flow. The droplet consists of a spherical inner drop (fluid 3) enclosed by a spherical shell (fluid 2), all immersed in external fluid 1. Six parameters govern: the capillary number ( Ca ), two viscosity ratios ( λ 21 , λ 31 ), the radii ratio ( κ ), the surface tensions ratio ( Ω ) and the flow-type ( G ). Using Lamb’s solution, an analytical solution for the spherical case ( Ca = 0, Ω = ∞) was found. We explored small deformations with: λ 21 = O (1), λ 31 = O (1), G = O (1), and . If , the outer surface is oriented at = +45°, while the inner surface at = −45°. The reverse occurs for . If G = −1, no deformation is possible. For a highly viscous shell ( ), the deformation of the outer surface is independent of Ca and oriented at = 0° or = 90°, while the deformation of the inner surface depends on Ca and at = ±45°. The opposite occurs for highly viscous inner drop ( ). Two breakup mechanisms were identified: contact between inner and outer surfaces, and inner drop rupture. Finally, we considered the effective viscosity of a dilute emulsion, containing spherical double emulsion droplets. In a single drop ( κ → 0), Taylor’s expression is recovered. For a highly viscous or thin shell ( λ 21 → ∞, κ → 1), Einstein’s formula is obtained.

matches.title: Simultaneous investigation of flow and thermal fields during vortex-induced heat transfer enhancement from a thermally active bottom wall of a square duct
matches.title_zh: 同时研究方形管道热活性底壁涡流诱导传热过程中的流动场和热场
matches.abstract_zh: 优化紧凑型热管理系统中的对流换热需要更好地了解涡流动力学、限制和近壁传输在基于空气的内部强制对流中如何相互作用。本研究开发了一种非侵入式实验框架，将双色激光诱导磷光 (2cLIP) 与粒子图像测速 (PIV) 相结合，以在具有热活性底壁的受限方形管道流中同时获得高分辨率速度和温度场。在使用和不使用圆柱形和方形涡流发生器的情况下进行了实验，以研究涡流引起的混合和传热机制。耦合诊断可以通过二阶统计数据直接评估速度和温度波动之间的相关性。对于圆柱形涡流发生器，在雷诺数为 $$\text {Re}_{D_\text {h}}=883$$ 和 1100 时，平板上的平均传热增强约为 25% 和 13%，而底壁的输入功率为 $$P_\text {plate}=6.67$$ W。流向和壁面法向速度脉动的增加加剧了尾流混合，而壁面法向湍流则增强。热通量分量 $$\overline{v'T'}$$ 揭示了 $$0.5 \le (x/H_\text {duct}) \le 1.8$$ 内有一个连贯且不断增长的增强对流传输区域。对于圆柱形几何形状，这种结构在空间上更集中在涡流发生器的近尾流中，对管道核心的影响更大；对于方形几何形状，这种结构更分散地分布在下游，对管道核心的影响有限。
matches.abstract_en: Optimizing convective heat transfer in compact thermal management systems require improved understanding of how vortex dynamics, confinement, and near-wall transport interact in air-based internal forced convection. This study develops a non-intrusive experimental framework that combines two-color laser-induced phosphorescence (2cLIP) with particle image velocimetry (PIV) to obtain simultaneous, high-resolution velocity and temperature fields in a confined square-duct flow with a thermally active bottom wall. Experiments were performed with and without cylindrical and square vortex generators to investigate vortex-induced mixing and heat transfer mechanisms. The coupled diagnostics enable direct evaluation of correlations between velocity and temperature fluctuations through second-order statistics. For the cylindrical vortex generator, the average heat transfer enhancement over the flat plate was approximately 25% and 13% at a Reynolds number of $$\text {Re}_{D_\text {h}}=883$$ and 1100, for input power to the bottom wall at $$P_\text {plate}=6.67$$ W. Increased streamwise and wall-normal velocity fluctuations intensified wake mixing, while the wall-normal turbulent heat-flux component, $$\overline{v'T'}$$ revealed a coherent and growing region of enhanced convective transport within $$0.5 \le (x/H_\text {duct}) \le 1.8$$. This structure was more spatially concentrated in the near wake of the vortex generator with greater influence into the duct core for the cylindrical geometry, and more diffusely distributed downstream for the square geometry, with limited influence into the duct core.

matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: The two-colour laser-induced fluorescence (2c-LIF) method is capable of time-dependent, spatially resolved temperature and pH measurements, respectively. In the present study, temperature and pH are investigated in separate measurement series, using the same optical principle and dye system under different experimental conditions. Together with a still uninterrupted growth in the life science field—especially molecular biology and diagnostics—the adaptation of this method might play a key role in improving future assays. 2c-LIF is providing a new level of process verification within temperature-controlled microplate wells under realistic operating conditions, i.e. in automated laboratory workflows for both high-throughput and high-content. Specifically, within each microwell the confined liquid volumes and the imposed vertical temperature gradients lead to thermally induced flow structures that influence scalar transport and desired mixing of the liquid. Within this paper, a Fluorescein/Sulforhodamine 101 dye system in water enables combined spectroscopic and imaging-based thermometry in the temperature range 283–343 K under realistic conditions. Temperature sensitivities of 2–6%/K by using a spectrometer and 2–3.5%/K for an image-based measurement are achieved, yielding a statistical precision of approximately 0.23–0.50 K. Absorption-corrected dual-camera imaging is providing quantitative full-field temperature maps and also resolving the temporal evolution of thermally driven flow patterns during a heating ramp. In buffered solutions (pH 6–11), the fluorescence ratio exhibits a linear response between pH 6 and 9, allowing spatially resolved visualisation of biochemical mixing processes. Time-dependent isothermal droplet-injection experiments are conducted to quantify homogenisation dynamics in the absence of external mechanical stimuli. A normalised mixing index based on the coefficient of variation is introduced to characterise mixing times and to assess the relative contributions of advective and diffusive transport, which can be interpreted in terms of local Péclet numbers. Thus, it can be demonstrated that 2c-LIF is providing a quantitative diagnostic framework for investigating coupled heat and mass transfer in confined microplate systems and for analysing transport-dominated mixing processes in small-scale liquid volumes. matches.abstract_zh: 拉伸喷雾片层的蒸发动力学是密集喷雾蒸发的范例。我们考虑由密集堆积的具有不同挥发性的微米级液体液滴组成的薄片，最初与其蒸气平衡。我们确认，单个液滴的寿命比根据静态环境中蒸发的孤立液滴的通常 d 平方定律所预期的要长得多。通过与标量的混合时间类比，我们表明喷雾和稀释环境之间的边界是由其饱和蒸汽浓度场的动力学控制的，这解释了尽管液体分裂成细小液滴，但蒸发延迟仍然很大。
matches.abstract_en: The evaporation dynamics of a stretched spray lamellae is a paradigm for dense sprays evaporation. We consider lamellae made of densely packed micron-sized droplets of liquids with different volatilities, initially in equilibrium with their vapor. We confirm that the lifetime of an individual droplet is much larger than expected from the usual d-squared law for isolated droplets evaporating in a quiescent environment. By analogy with mixing times of scalars, we show that the boundary between the spray and the diluting environment is controlled by the dynamics of its saturating vapor concentration field, explaining the substantial evaporation delay despite the liquid’s division into fine droplets.

matches.authors: Trystan Surawy-Stepney, Benjamin J. Wallis, Anna E. Hogg, Ian Joughin, Stephen L. Cornford, Pierre Dutrieux

matches.abstract_en: Over the last few decades, ice keels have intermittently bumped against the bedrock underneath Pine Island Ice Shelf. In general, it is thought that this process, termed regrounding, could enhance buttressing and potentially slow glacier flow or arrest retreat. Here, we test this hypothesis for Pine Island Glacier. Using offset tracking applied to satellite radar data, we reveal an extensive history of regrounding on the central shelf since 2009. Combining Earth observation and ice sheet modelling, we assess the direct effects this might have had on ice dynamics and indirect effects via its influencing on calving behaviour. Our results show that regrounding caused little additional drag on the base of the ice shelf. Furthermore, it plausibly contributed to the promotion of calving between 2015 and 2020 which is, in turn, held largely responsible for the increase in flow rate of the glacier over the last decade. matches.abstract_zh: 通道和管道中的二流体毛细管流动是流体力学的一个基本问题，在物理、生物和微流体系统中广泛应用。这种流动的一个关键现象是长囊泡的产生，称为泰勒气泡。形成泰勒气泡的一种简单配置是并流，其中两种流体（一种粘性，另一种无粘性）同时注入管道或通道中，以规则的频率产生周期性的无粘性气泡夹断。通过考虑气泡注射喷嘴和发展中的泰勒气泡之间颈缩区域的润滑理论，我们对二维泰勒气泡的形成进行了数学研究，从而对注射驱动的夹断动力学及其频率的参数控制产生了分析见解。一个关键结果是证明了小毛细管数颈缩动力学的准静态极限理论。该理论基于将箍缩膜的外部近静态状态与将颈缩区与泰勒气泡周围的膜相匹配的表观动态接触线耦合。这种渐进结构在小毛细管数量的限制下变得更加精细，揭示了毛细管夹断动力学与扩散液滴的准静态状态之间的基本联系。该理论对无量纲夹断时间 进行了预测，其中代表粘性流体的通量和毛细管的尺寸。因此，这项研究从第一原理出发，对毛细管系统中气泡产生的流态产生了新的数学理解，并且迈出了将准静态分析应用于更复杂的轴对称和三维毛细管夹断示例的第一步。
matches.abstract_en: Two-fluid capillary flows in channels and pipes form a fundamental problem in fluid mechanics with widespread applications in physical, biological and microfluidic systems. A key phenomenon in such flows is the generation of long capsular bubbles, known as Taylor bubbles. A simple configuration that forms Taylor bubbles is coflow, where two fluids (one viscous, the other inviscid) are injected concurrently into a pipe or channel, producing a periodic pinch-off of inviscid bubbles at a regular frequency. By considering a lubrication theory for the necking region between the bubble injection nozzle and the developing Taylor bubble, we conduct a mathematical study of the formation of two-dimensional Taylor bubbles, yielding analytical insight into injection-driven pinch-off dynamics and the parametric control of its frequency. A key result is to demonstrate a quasi-static limiting theory of the necking dynamics for small capillary numbers. The theory is based on coupling an outer near-static regime of the pinching film with an apparent dynamic contact line that matches the necking zone to the film surrounding the Taylor bubble. This asymptotic structure, which becomes more refined in the limit of small capillary number, reveals a fundamental link between capillary pinch-off dynamics and the quasi-static regimes underlying spreading droplets. The theory yields a prediction for the dimensionless pinch-off time, , where represents the flux of viscous fluid and the size of the capillary. The study thereby yields new mathematical understanding of flow regimes that underlie bubble generation in capillary systems from first principles, and the first step towards application of quasi-static analysis to more complex axisymmetric and three-dimensional examples of capillary pinch-off.

Gravity and the Soret effects are taken into account. A mathematical model with nanoparticle concentration-dependent thermophysical properties of the nanofluid is formulated. The surface tension is assumed to be a linear function of the temperature; however, the equation of state displays non-monotonicity with nanoparticle concentration due to nanoparticle interfacial energetics. We carry out the linear stability analysis of the quiescent base state using normal modes and the obtained eigenvalue problem is solved numerically. The monotonic short-wave solutocapillary instability is found and analysed for different parameter sets. The limiting case of insoluble interfacial nanoparticle concentration is also investigated. Notably, we identify the onset of the monotonic short-wave thermocapillary instability owing to a strong coupling between the perturbations of interfacial nanoparticle concentration and temperature via the particle concentration-dependent thermal conductivity in general, and in particular, near the interface. The combined thermo-solutocapillary instability is also investigated. Finally, the simplified toy problem is formulated and solved analytically to demonstrate the role of thermal conductivity stratification and interfacial kinetics.

matches.abstract_en: Complex suspensions composed of solid particles dispersed in non-Newtonian liquid matrices are ubiquitous in environmental and industrial processes, where their nonlinear rheological response directly impacts the efficiency and predictability of momentum, heat and mass transfer. Here, we experimentally investigate the interplay between non-colloidal spherical particles and high-molecular-weight polymer chains in the canonical Taylor–Couette flow, a configuration where recent experiments have revealed the emergence of an elasto-inertial dissipation (EID) behaviour whose underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Using a polyacrylamide Boger fluid loaded with particles at varying concentrations, we perform systematic rheological measurements and long-duration shear experiments to quantify viscosity, elasticity and the degradation dynamics. Torque monitoring shows that particle addition accelerates polymer chain scission and reduces the asymptotic viscosity. Ramp-up protocols reveal torque-drop behaviour characteristic of EID, which can be qualitatively reproduced by a cumulative-shear degradation model derived from steady-shear data. However, the inability of this model to capture the strong dependence on particle volume fraction indicates that additional semi-dilute particle–polymer interaction mechanisms are at play. In particular, by relating average interparticle distance to the maximum polymer chain extension, we identify a critical particle volume fraction ( ) coinciding with the observed transition from elasto-inertial turbulence (EIT) to EID. These findings show, that while polymer degradation is a key contributor to dissipation, confinement of stretched chains between particles is a more likely mechanism for the suppression of EIT. This dual influence of degradation and particle–polymer interactions offers new insight into rheo-hydrodynamic transitions in complex suspensions and their implications for industrial applications.

matches.abstract_en: This study investigates the interaction between shock waves and hydrogen–oxygen cylindrical flames both experimentally and numerically. Experiments are conducted in a newly designed chemically reactive shock tube, where high-speed schlieren imaging captures the detailed flame propagation, deformation and wave dynamics. Following incident shock, flame evolution is primarily dominated by hydrodynamic instability: its upstream interface first flattens, then undergoes phase inversion and subsequently develops into a slender spike. The estimated Darrieus–Landau growth rate is more than an order of magnitude smaller than the Richtmyer–Meshkov instability (RMI)-induced growth rate, confirming that intrinsic flame instabilities play a negligible role and that early-stage evolution is governed predominantly by RMI. However, following reshock, combustion dominates flame evolution, with the upstream interface exhibiting turbulent-like combustion, promoting faster growth of flame length, width and area. High-fidelity simulations employing the Kéromnès mechanism are performed under identical experimental conditions, along with corresponding inert cases for comparison. Pronounced discrepancies are observed: locally, spike roll-up existing in inert cases is largely suppressed in reactive cases; globally, heat release-induced volume expansion drives rapid growth of flame length, width and area. It is found that combustion detaches vortex sheets from the flame interface, suppressing small-scale roll-up and producing abundant disordered small-scale vortical structures within the flame. Shock compression (increasing pressure and temperature) and flame deformation (increasing surface area) significantly enhance heat release, with each mechanism dominating at different stages. Two Damköhler numbers are introduced to characterize the competition between hydrodynamics and chemistry: the flow Damköhler number initially confirms a hydrodynamically dominated regime following the incident shock and decreases progressively as combustion–flow coupling strengthens after reshock; the diffusion Damköhler number throughout indicates that combustion remains reaction-kinetic-controlled. Both postshock and post-reshock thermodynamic states lie well within the non-explosive region, confirming that reshock-induced turbulent-like combustion is driven by combustion–flow coupling rather than homogeneous chain-branching explosion.

We conclusively show that the streamwise bag length ( ) is the most critical geometric length scale governing the breakup dynamics. The size distribution of bag-generated child droplets collapses onto a single-parameter gamma distribution with a shape factor . Further, node droplets and rim droplets are shown to be estimated from the inflated bag length using an inviscid breakup framework originally developed for Newtonian droplets when viscous effects are incorporated in the formulations.

matches.abstract_en: Water drops spontaneously become electrically charged when moving on different surfaces, such as plant leaves, insect wings, building walls, window glass and plastic1–9. This process, known as contact or sliding electrification, is analogous to tribocharging between solids10–13. The electric potential of water drops charged in this way can exceed 1 kV (refs. 14–16). A vital but as yet unanswered question is whether the charge in water drops causes corrosion. Here we analyse the effect of series of water drops hitting metal surfaces, which are protected by a non-conductive coating. Before hitting the coated metal, the drops acquire a charge spontaneously by sliding over an insulating surface. We demonstrated that these charged drops can cause the coating to break down electrically and lead to corrosion of the metal. As spontaneously charged water drops form naturally, this previously overlooked corrosion mechanism may contribute to the degradation of cultural heritage sites, buildings, ships, cars and other metal components. Our findings can improve anticorrosion strategies and emphasize the need for protective materials capable of resisting charge-induced damage from water drops. Experiments have shown that spontaneously charged water drops can damage coatings on metal surfaces, leading to corrosion of the metal.

matches.abstract_en: Abstract Understanding liquid behavior on the surface of rapidly rotating turbine blades is essential for clarifying drain formation in wet-steam turbines. However, direct experimental visualization of droplet impact and subsequent liquid transport under the combined conditions of ultra-high peripheral velocity and low ambient pressure has not been reported. In this study, we present high-speed visualization of droplet impact and liquid transport on an actual turbine bucket at peripheral velocities of 30–430 m/s under ambient pressures of 1–5 kPa. The results show that prompt splashing occurs even in this low-pressure regime, contrary to splash-suppression trends reported for lower-impact velocity and non-rotating conditions. Impinging droplets form thin films, ligaments, and droplet trains on the surface; despite their different morphologies, these liquid phases exhibit similar transport characteristics governed by the balance between centrifugal and Coriolis forces. At the bucket tip, accumulated liquid is stretched by centrifugal force and undergoes Rayleigh breakup, with the resulting droplet diameter decreasing systematically with increasing rotational speed. A minimal numerical model incorporating centrifugal, Coriolis, and effective interfacial resistance qualitatively reproduces the observed liquid transport trajectories on the actual bucket geometry. These combined experimental visualizations and numerical modeling provide a consistent physical description on rapidly rotating surfaces under low-pressure, ultra-high-speed conditions, and offer a basis for understanding drain-related loss mechanisms in wet-steam turbines. matches.abstract_zh: 冰川终止因其海平面上升速度快而引人注目，特别是在融水脉冲期间。终端 IV（T-IV；距今约 340,000 年）就是一个突出的例子，海平面每世纪上升约 5 m。由于海洋记录中的绝对年龄限制很少，T-IV 海平面快速上升的原因仍然难以捉摸。在这项工作中，我们提供了意大利北部的洞穴生物年表，并将其转换为北大西洋海洋记录。我们推断，T-IV 海平面的高上升率可能与反馈有关，即长期融水释放导致海洋热量储存增强，随后循环恢复时热量释放，导致冰盖进一步塌陷。该分析强调了海洋反馈在推动终止期间海平面异常上升速度方面的关键作用。精确年代的洞穴记录显示，在第四次终结（约34万年前）期间，大西洋环流的长期放缓导致了异常的海洋热量积聚和冰盖快速融化，当时海平面上升率超过了今天。
matches.abstract_en: Glacial terminations stand out for their high rates of sea-level rise, particularly during meltwater pulses. Termination IV (T-IV; ~340,000 years before present) is a prominent example, with sea level rising at up to ~5 m per century. Due to sparse absolute age constraints on marine records, the causes for the high rates of sea-level rise at T-IV remain elusive. In this work, we provide a speleothem chronology from northern Italy, which we transpose to North Atlantic marine records. We infer that the high T-IV sea-level rise rate likely relates to a feedback whereby protracted meltwater release caused enhanced ocean heat storage, followed by heat release upon circulation recovery, driving additional ice-sheet collapse. This analysis highlights the critical role of oceanic feedbacks in driving exceptional rates of sea-level rise during terminations. Precisely dated cave records show that a prolonged slowdown in Atlantic ocean circulation drove exceptional ocean heat buildup and rapid ice-sheet melting during Termination IV (~340,000 years ago), when sea-level rise rates exceeded those of today.

matches.abstract_zh: 了解颗粒表面流的流变学仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是当颗粒之间发生惯性和内聚相互作用以触发复杂的状态转变时。本研究通过系统的转鼓实验研究干燥和粘性颗粒材料的稳定流动动力学，重点关注旋转速度、转鼓与颗粒尺寸之比和粘聚水平的影响。进一步建立了比例定律，以捕获这些因素的综合影响，并提供干燥和粘性状态下流动行为的统一描述。结果表明，对于干颗粒流，归一化流动层厚度（代表颗粒直径的流动层厚度）和静止角tan 0 均随弗劳德数的增加而增大，临界过渡角tan 0 ≈ 0.58标志着级联的开始。间隙液体的存在引起毛细管内聚力，导致具有凸自由表面和更高的 0 和δ 0 的塞状流动。一种新的无量纲控制参数，源自结合毛细管时间尺度的量纲分析，成功地将几乎所有实验数据折叠到表现出清晰幂律行为的单一主曲线上，捕捉惯性、尺寸和内聚力的综合效应。此外，μ ( I ) 框架内的流变学解释（其中代表有效摩擦系数，I 表示惯性数）揭示了干燥和粘性情况下的速率依赖性摩擦强化，粘性流表现出由颗粒间毛细管内聚力引起的一致较高的阻力。
matches.abstract_en: Understanding the rheology of granular surface flows remains a significant challenge, particularly when inertial and cohesive interactions occur between particles to trigger complex regime transitions. This study investigates the steady flow dynamics of dry and cohesive granular materials through systematic rotating drum experiments, focusing on the effects of rotation speed, drum-to-particle size ratio and cohesion level. Scaling laws were further established to capture the combined effects of these factors and provide a unified description of flow behaviour across both dry and cohesive regimes. Results show that, for dry granular flows, both the normalised flowing layer thickness where is flowing layer thickness and represents the particle diameter and dynamic angle of repose tan 0 increase with Froude number, with a critical transition angle of tan 0 ≈ 0.58 marking the onset of cascading. The presence of interstitial liquid induces capillary cohesion, leading to a plug-like flow with a convex free surface and higher 0 and δ 0 . A new dimensionless governing parameter, derived from dimensional analysis incorporating a capillary time scale, successfully collapses nearly all experimental data onto single master curves that exhibit clear power-law behaviour, capturing the combined effects of inertia, size and cohesion. Furthermore, rheological interpretation within the μ ( I ) framework, where represents the effective friction coefficient and I denotes the inertial number reveals rate-dependent frictional strengthening for both dry and cohesive cases, with cohesive flows exhibiting consistently higher resistance induced by interparticle capillary cohesion.

matches.authors: Parmentier, Justine, Terrapon, Vincent Emmanuel, Gilet, Tristan

matches.abstract_en: Stalagmites in karstic caves preserve valuable palaeoclimate records through calcium-rich layered deposits, presenting curvature variations both across and within individual stalagmites. Stalagmites always remain covered by a thin water film fed by a discrete inflow of drops, which bring in new ions in solution for the stalagmites to grow. However, the gravity-induced drainage of this film and its response to the underlying stalagmite shape and the discrete drop inflow remain poorly characterised in existing growth models. To address these limitations, we develop a theoretical framework that captures the combined effects of shape curvature and discrete drop inflow on thin film drainage dynamics, starting from Reynolds lubrication theory expressed in curvilinear coordinates. From there, we show that the limiting cases of thickness-dominated and inclination-dominated drainage translate into distinct scaling laws for both the front propagation position and stationary film thickness. We further illustrate these regimes and assess the corresponding scaling laws by numerically solving the governing equations. Finally, experimental measurements conducted in both cave and laboratory settings confirm the predicted stationary film thickness. Our findings provide insights into the influence of substrate shape and inflow dynamics on thin film drainage, with implications for stalagmite growth modelling and other gravity-driven surface flows.

matches.title: A radiation two-phase flow model for simulating plasma–liquid interactions
matches.authors: Qian, Ke-Jian, Li, Zhu-Jun, Tao, Tao, Zhang, De-Hua, Yan, Rui, Ding, Hang

matches.abstract_en: In laser-produced plasma (LPP) extreme ultraviolet (EUV) sources, deformation of a tin droplet into an optimal target shape is determined by its interaction with a pre-pulse laser-generated plasma. This interaction is mediated by a transient ablation pressure, whose complex spatio-temporal evolution remains experimentally inaccessible. Existing modelling approaches are limited: empirical pressure–impulse models neglect dynamic plasma feedback, while advanced radiation hydrodynamics codes often fail to resolve late-time droplet hydrodynamics. To bridge this gap, we propose a radiation two-phase flow model based on a diffuse interface approach. The model integrates radiation hydrodynamics for the plasma with the Euler equations for a weakly compressible liquid, extending a five-equation diffuse interface formulation to incorporate radiation transport, thermal conduction, ionisation and surface tension. This formulation enforces pressure and velocity equilibrium across the diffuse interface region, with closure models constructed to ensure correct jump conditions at interfaces and asymptotically recover the pure-phase equations in bulk regions. Then we apply the model to simulate a benchmark pre-pulse scenario, where a tin droplet is irradiated by a laser pulse. Our axisymmetric simulations capture the rapid plasma expansion and subsequent inertial flattening of the droplet into a thin, curved sheet over microsecond time scales. Notably, the model reproduces experimentally observed features such as an axial jet – rarely replicated in prior simulations. Quantitative agreement with experimental data for sheet dimensions and velocity validates the approach. The proposed model self-consistently couples laser–plasma physics with compressible droplet dynamics, providing a powerful tool for studying plasma–liquid interactions in LPP-EUV source optimisation.

matches.abstract_zh: 由剪切流驱动的液滴变形和运动是自然界中普遍存在的现象，并支撑着各种技术应用。我们在润滑理论的框架内研究了稳定剪切流中二维液滴的变形、运动和接触线动力学。对于具有滞后作用的固定液滴，我们确定了一个临界剪切速率，超过该剪切速率上游侧变得不稳定并且形成薄膜。在后期，薄膜通过自相似毛细管过渡结构连接到块体液滴。对于具有滞后现象的移动液滴，其动力学行为可分为三个区域：在低剪切区域，稳态液滴速度随剪切次数线性增加；在中间剪切区域，液滴速度表现出对 的非单调依赖性；在高剪切区域，稳态液滴轮廓可以清楚地分为夹带膜、凹坑和毛细管脊。此外，在高剪切力下的液滴演化过程中，出现了类Landau-Levich-Derjaguin（LLD-like）薄膜，并表现出与经典LLD定律不同的缩放定律。这些结果为理解剪切驱动的液滴动力学提供了统一的理论和数值框架，并可能为类似的三维系统提供见解。
matches.abstract_en: Drop deformation and motion driven by shear flows are widespread phenomena in nature and underpin a variety of technological applications. We investigate the deformation, motion and contact-line dynamics of two-dimensional drops in steady shear flows within the framework of lubrication theory. For pinned drops with hysteresis, we identify a critical shear rate, beyond which the upstream side becomes unstable and a thinning film develops. At late stage, the thinning film connects to the bulk drop through a self-similar capillary transition structure. For moving drops with hysteresis, the dynamical behaviours can be classified into three regions: in the low-shear region, the steady-state drop velocity increases linearly with the shear number ; in the intermediate-shear region, the drop velocity exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on ; in the high-shear region, the steady-state drop profile can be clearly divided into the entrained film, dimple and capillary ridge. Moreover, during the drop evolution under high shear, a Landau–Levich–Derjaguin-like (LLD-like) film emerges and exhibits a scaling law that differs from the classical LLD law. These results provide a unified theoretical and numerical framework for understanding shear-driven drop dynamics and may offer insights into analogous three-dimensional systems.

matches.title: Instability of microbial droplets growing on viscous substrates
matches.title_zh: 在粘性基质上生长的微生物液滴的不稳定性
matches.authors: Gomez Herrera, Vicente, Weady, Scott
matches.abstract_zh: 我们开发并分析了在三维粘性流体表面生长的扁平微生物液滴的模型。该模型描述了流体表面生长引起的应力、由于养分消耗引起的体积密度变化以及由此产生的流体流动。我们将这个自由边界问题重新表述为仅在微生物领域定义的积分微分方程组。从这个公式中，我们确定了与径向膨胀圆盘相对应的轴对称解，并分析了其形态稳定性。我们发现增长力使轴对称解稳定，而浮力则使其不稳定。我们将这些发现与实验观察联系起来。
matches.abstract_en: We develop and analyse a model for a flat microbial droplet growing on the surface of a three-dimensional viscous fluid. The model describes growth-induced stresses at the fluid surface, density variations in the bulk due to nutrient consumption and the resulting fluid flows that arise. We reformulate this free-boundary problem as a system of integro-differential equations defined solely on the microbial domain. From this formulation, we identify an axisymmetric solution corresponding to a radially expanding disk and analyse its morphological stability. We find that growth forces stabilise the axisymmetric solution, while buoyancy forces destabilise it. We connect these findings to experimental observations.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets；方法：experimental；降权方法：model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.abstract_en: Our experiments bridge classic raindrop shape theory and the behavior of contaminated drops in atmospheric and industrial aerosols. With two cameras, we reconstruct the three-dimensional shape, orientation, and oscillation of levitated nanofluid drops. Low nanoparticle loading can destabilize the interface whereas higher loading stabilizes it. Surfactant shifts the stability thresholds by sequestering particles.

matches.title: Condensation front mechanism of partial cavitation in an axisymmetric Venturi

matches.abstract_zh: 我们表明，三维文丘里管内部分空化中的凝结前沿（也称为气泡激波或凝结激波）的不可压缩大涡模拟与实验非常吻合。凝结锋面与传统的冲击波有着根本的不同。由于空化的蒸发和凝结而导致的密度变化，而不是流体的压缩性，决定了其形成和传播。因此，模拟凝结前沿不需要可压缩求解器。这些发现为部分空化的脱落机制提供了新的认识。
matches.abstract_en: We show that the incompressible Large eddy simulations of the condensation fronts (also referred to as bubbly shocks or condensation shocks) in partial cavitation within a three-dimensional Venturi agree well with the experiments. The condensation front is fundamentally different from traditional shock waves. The density variations due to evaporation and condensation of cavitation, rather than fluid compressibility, govern its formation and propagation. Hence, a compressible solver is unnecessary for simulating condensation fronts. These findings offer a new understanding of the shedding mechanism of partial cavitation.

matches.title: On the control of transients in mechanical displacement ventilation
matches.authors: Toy, Daniel, Woods, Andrew W.
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: We investigate transient ventilation flows following variations in the heat load and ventilation rate in a building with upward mechanical displacement ventilation. In steady state, thermal plumes that rise from localised heat sources interact with the upward ventilation flow to produce a two-layer stratification. Through new laboratory experiments, we examine the transient responses to changes in the strength of the heat source or modifications to the ventilation volume flux. When only one of these variables is altered, the evolution of the system is similar to the behaviour observed in the experiments of Bower et al. (2008) J. fluid Mech. 614, 15–37, proceeding through either an intruding or a filling flow. The evolution pathway then depends on , the ratio between the evolving buoyancy of the plume, , at the interface between the warm upper and cool lower layers and the buoyancy of the upper layer, . When , the plume is dense and intrudes at the interface; when , the plume is buoyant, rises to the ceiling and forms a new stratified layer. Changes to the heat source immediately affect the plume buoyancy, while changes to the ventilation lead to a more gradual evolution of the system. This difference in time scales results in a range of transient flows that can switch between filling and intruding modes for different values of . We develop a model for these transient flows that is consistent with our experimental observations. The insights from our modelling of these transients are key for developing control strategies which maintain thermal comfort in buildings subject to frequent changes in heat load.

matches.title: Variable time step (VTS) based PTV-LIF measurements of stratified jet transitions: from plunging flows and dense bottom jets to internal hydraulic jumps
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：<urlopen error [SSL: UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING] EOF occurred in violation of protocol (_ssl.c:1081)>
matches.abstract_en: Stratified flows driven by density differences exhibit diverse dynamic regimes, yet transitions between plunging flows, internal hydraulic jumps, and gravity plumes remain poorly characterized, particularly in confined geometries. This study addresses this gap by introducing a Variable Time Step (VTS) enhanced Particle Tracking Velocimetry-Laser Induced Fluorescence (PTV-LIF) methodology to investigate saline bottom jets in a narrow sloping channel. Isopropanol was employed as a refractive index matching agent to eliminate optical distortions, enabling simultaneous measurement of velocity and density fields using a single high-speed camera. The VTS method effectively reduced quantization errors inherent in traditional fixed-time-step algorithms, significantly improving measurement accuracy of flow and density fields. By systematically varying ambient water depths, clear transitions from plunging flows through submerged jumps and internal hydraulic jumps to gravity plumes were observed and classified for the first time. Results confirmed that flow regimes varied significantly with ambient fluid depth. Both subaerial and subaqueous hydraulic jump heights were well described by existing theoretical frameworks, though significant differences in jump lengths were observed, likely due to turbulent shear at the stratified interface. These findings extend existing regime maps and provide new experimental evidence elucidating the critical role of confinement and buoyancy in controlling stratified flow transitions, with important implications for understanding dense discharge behavior in submarine outfalls, sediment-laden river plumes, and ocean current dynamics.

matches.title: Velocity of focused liquid jets induced by impact across rigid and soft substrates
matches.authors: Kikuchi, Ishin, Watanabe, Hiroya, Yokoyama, Yuto, Kusuno, Hiroaki, Tagawa, Yoshiyuki
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：<urlopen error [SSL: UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING] EOF occurred in violation of protocol (_ssl.c:1081)>
matches.abstract_en: When a liquid-filled test tube impacts a substrate, the concave gas–liquid interface inside the tube deforms and emits a focused liquid jet. This configuration, known as Pokrovski’s experiment, is investigated here with a focus on how substrate elasticity affects the jet velocity. By varying the substrate elastic modulus from to MPa, we show that the jet velocity decreases as the substrate becomes softer. The results are organised using the Cauchy number , which represents the ratio of the inertia of the container–liquid system to the elastic restoring force of the substrate. The dimensionless jet velocity remains nearly constant for , whereas it decreases for . To explain this reduction, we introduce the concept of partial impulse. When the impact interval, during which the container and substrate remain in contact, exceeds the focusing interval, during which the interface forms a jet, the jet is formed before the total impulse has been delivered. Thus only the impulse accumulated within the effective time window for jet formation contributes to the interface motion. By modelling the contact force and integrating it over this effective impulse window, we quantitatively reproduce the experimental trend. This partial-impulse framework provides a unified description of impact-induced focused jetting across both rigid and soft substrates.

matches.title: Interfacial dynamics and energy cascade in immiscible Rayleigh–Taylor turbulence
matches.authors: Zhao, Dongxiao, Huang, Xiaoxue, Li, Gaojin
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: We investigate interfacial dynamics and multiscale energy transfer in immiscible Rayleigh–Taylor turbulence using numerical simulations with varying surface-tension coefficients . Capillarity is shown to control characteristic length scales, interfacial area, and global energy and enstrophy budgets. The flow exhibits self-similar evolution with respect to surface tension, with the maximum kinetic energy scaling as and the flow duration as . A scale-by-scale budget shows that surface tension removes kinetic energy at large scales while injecting it at small scales, with the crossover occurring near the Hinze scale. We further recast and verify a local kinematic relationship between surface-tension power and interface stretching, up to conservative transport, , where is the surface-tension force, is the velocity, is the heavy-fluid volume fraction, and is the interface stretch rate. This relation links kinetic energy transfer to the scalar-variance cascade, and shows that energy transfer to the interface is governed by local strain. Statistics of individual bubbles and droplets reveal vertically elongated filaments with diameters of approximately three capillary scales, yielding a linear volume–area relation. Their vertical velocities scale with the square root of equivalent diameter, consistent with drag–buoyancy balance. These findings, particularly the direct link between surface-tension power and resolved interface stretching, provide a rigorous physical framework for developing subgrid-scale closures for large-eddy simulations of immiscible turbulent flows.

matches.abstract_en: Capillary attachment is a fundamental phenomenon in microengineering, yet the lack of comprehensive theories makes it difficult to predict a pendant drop’s particle-lifting capability. We investigate the critical roles of stability in this process, specifically addressing how to maximize lifting capacity. Our work establishes the theoretical framework required to successfully lift particles in practical applications.

matches.title: Synchrotron X-ray multi-projection imaging (XMPI) for high-resolution 4D characterization of multiphase flows
matches.title_zh: 用于多相流高分辨率 4D 表征的同步加速器 X 射线多投影成像 (XMPI)
matches.abstract_zh: 颗粒、气泡或液滴悬浮在流体中的多相流控制着生物学、医学、材料加工和地球物理学的关键过程。然而，在不透明系统中观察它们的微观动力学仍然是一个基本挑战。我们提出了同步加速器 X 射线多投影成像 (XMPI)，这是一种无需旋转样品即可对明显不透明悬浮液流中的微粒进行四维（3D + 时间）跟踪的新颖方法。通过在同步加速器设施中使用分束 X 射线捕获多个角度的同步投影，我们可以解析血液等不透明流体中的瞬时粒子位置和轨迹。我们通过稀释条件下的单个粒子跟踪测速 (3D PTV) 以及稠密悬浮液中的多投影图像测速来展示 XMPI 的潜力。该方法为粒子解析计算流体动力学模型提供了其他方式无法获得的实验验证，并允许观察惯性聚焦效应以及与悬浮液流变学和生物医学流动相关的微观结构动力学。这项工作为一系列科学和工业应用中复杂多相流的高分辨率、时间分辨 4D 成像铺平了道路。将 XMPI 与最新的 AI 支持的 4D 重建算法相结合，为高速、无旋转显微断层扫描开辟了新的时空前沿。图文摘要
matches.abstract_en: Multiphase flows where particles, bubbles, or droplets are suspended in a fluid govern critical processes in biology, medicine, materials processing, and geophysics. However, observing their microscale dynamics in opaque systems has remained a fundamental challenge. We present Synchrotron X-ray Multi-Projection Imaging (XMPI), a novel approach enabling four-dimensional (3D + time) tracking of microparticles in visibly opaque suspension flows without requiring sample rotation. By capturing simultaneous projections from multiple angles using beam-split X-rays at synchrotron facilities, we resolve instantaneous particle positions and trajectories in opaque fluids such as blood. We demonstrate the potential of XMPI through individual particle tracking velocimetry (3D PTV) in dilute conditions, as well as multi-projection image velocimetry in dense suspensions. The methodology provides otherwise inaccessible experimental validation for particle-resolved computational fluid dynamics models and allows, e.g., observation of inertial focusing effects and microstructural dynamics relevant to suspension rheology and biomedical flows. This work paves the way for high-resolution, time-resolved 4D imaging of complex multiphase flows across a range of scientific and industrial applications. Combining XMPI with recent AI-supported 4D reconstruction algorithms opens a new spatiotemporal frontier for high-speed, rotation-free microtomography. Graphical abstract

matches.title: Deformation and instability of sessile soap bubbles in an electric field
matches.title_zh: 电场中固着肥皂泡的变形和不稳定性
matches.authors: Hongsik Kim and Sunghwan Jung
matches.abstract_zh: 将一个肥皂泡放入电场中，它会伸展成一个更高、更光滑的圆顶。将磁场向上转动，经过临界点后，顶部会尖锐化成尖锥体，并喷射出细细的射流。从侧面对气泡进行成像，我们在一个实验中遵循整个序列，并发现了两件事。一旦电场根据气泡尺寸和表面张力重新调整，不同尺寸的气泡就会沿着相同的曲线变形，因此电场力和毛细管力之间的平衡决定了形状。而且锥体比泰勒的经典值要锐利得多，因为它是在薄膜仍然冲向喷射流而不是处于平衡状态时选择的。
matches.abstract_en: Put a soap bubble in an electric field and it stretches into a taller, smooth dome. Turn the field up and, past a critical point, the top sharpens into a pointed cone that fires off a thin jet. Imaging the bubble from the side, we follow this whole sequence in one experiment and find two things. Bubbles of different sizes deform along the same curve once the field is rescaled by bubble size and surface tension, so one balance between electric and capillary forces sets the shape. And the cone is far sharper than Taylor’s classic value, because it is selected while the film is still rushing toward the jet rather than resting in equilibrium.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary、surface tension；方法：experiment；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Pressure drop-flow rate nonlinearity in bubble trains through a capillary bundle
matches.title_zh: 通过毛细管束的气泡列中的压降-流速非线性
matches.authors: Paolo Botticini, Davide Picchi, Santanu Sinha, and Alex Hansen
matches.abstract_zh: 我们通过结合低毛细管数下的薄膜流体动力学来表征毛细管中细长气泡列的非线性压降-流量关系。我们表明，毛细管束中孔隙尺度的统计异质性会导致单相极限的系统偏差，并受到孔径分布和流动参数的控制。我们确定了指数范围从 2/3 到 1 的次线性区域之间的交叉，连接了 Bretherton 和 Darcy 极限，并且与多孔介质中不混溶两相流的报告值定性一致。
matches.abstract_en: We characterize the nonlinear pressure drop–flow rate relation of elongated bubble trains in capillary tubes by incorporating thin-film hydrodynamics at low capillary numbers. We show that pore-scale statistical heterogeneity in capillary bundles induces systematic deviations from the single-phase limit, controlled by both the pore-size distribution and flow parameters. We identify a crossover between sublinear regimes with exponents ranging from 2/3 to 1, connecting the Bretherton and Darcy limits and in qualitative agreement with values reported for immiscible two-phase flow in porous media.

matches.title: Gyroid porous inserts as a novel flow control to mitigate tip vortex cavitation
matches.title_zh: 螺旋多孔插入物作为一种新颖的流量控制，可减轻尖端涡流空化
matches.abstract_zh: 升力面尖端产生的尖端涡流对流体动力学提出了重大挑战，在航空航天和液压应用中引起诱导阻力、噪声和空化侵蚀风险。在各种缓解策略中，多孔尖端的探索结果好坏参半，显示出扩散集中涡度的效果有限。在这项研究中，我们引入了一种基于陀螺仪的多孔尖端作为一种新型的被动流量控制装置，用于减轻尖端涡流。陀螺仪是一个三周期最小表面，形成光滑且曲折的多孔 3D 网络。基于陀螺仪的多孔插入物连接到椭圆形 NACA 16-020 水翼尖端 (Re ≈ 9 × 105)，取代了 3%、5% 和 9% 的跨度。激光多普勒测速（LDV）测量表明，增加陀螺仪部分会显着降低最大切向速度，同时扩大涡核半径。涡旋环流保持不变，表明扩散机制将集中涡量传播到更大的核心。在 12° 入射角时，9% 的陀螺仪插入件将峰值切向速度降低了 3.2 倍，同时涡核半径增加了六倍。因此，涡流中心的最小压力系数从 $$-1.4$$ 增加到 $$-0.1$$，显着降低了空化风险。流动可视化证实在所有测试条件下完全抑制尖端涡流空化。针对跳闸和自然边界层转变，验证了陀螺仪的有效性。至关重要的是，对于跨度高达 5% 的陀螺仪插入件，流体动力性能基本上不受影响，升力和阻力系数保持在实验不确定性范围内。阻塞渗透性测试表明，观察到的影响源于结构渗透性而不是表面粗糙度。这些发现表明陀螺仪插件是一种很有前途的被动流量控制，可用于减轻船用螺旋桨、水翼和涡轮机械中的空化，以及飞机机翼和风力涡轮机中的噪声控制，同时保持运行效率。
matches.abstract_en: Tip vortices generated at the tip of lifting surfaces pose significant challenges in fluid dynamics, causing induced drag, noise, and cavitation erosion risk across aerospace and hydraulic applications. Among the various mitigation strategies, porous tips have been explored with mixed results, showing limited effectiveness in diffusing concentrated vorticity. In this study, we introduce a gyroid-based porous tip as a novel passive flow control device for tip vortex mitigation. A gyroid is a triply periodic minimal surface that forms a smooth and tortuous porous 3D network. A gyroid-based porous insert was attached to an elliptical NACA 16-020 hydrofoil tip (Re ≈ 9 × 105), replacing 3%, 5%, and 9% of the span. Laser Doppler Velocimetry (LDV) measurements revealed that increasing the gyroid portion dramatically reduces maximum tangential velocity while enlarging the vortex core radius. The vortex circulation remains unchanged, indicating a diffusion mechanism that spreads concentrated vorticity over a larger core. At 12° incidence, the 9% gyroid insert reduced peak tangential velocity by a factor of 3.2 alongside a sixfold increase in vortex core radius. Consequently, the minimum pressure coefficient at the vortex center increased from $$-1.4$$ to $$-0.1$$, reducing significantly the risk of cavitation. Flow visualization confirmed complete suppression of tip vortex cavitation across all tested conditions. The gyroid effectiveness was verified for both tripped and natural boundary layer transitions. Critically, hydrodynamic performance remained essentially unaffected for gyroid inserts spanning up to 5%, with lift and drag coefficients maintained within experimental uncertainty. Tests with blocked permeability demonstrate that the observed effects stem from structural permeability rather than surface roughness. These findings establish gyroid inserts as a promising passive flow control for cavitation mitigation in marine propellers, hydrofoils, and turbomachinery, as well as noise control in aircraft wings and wind turbines, while preserving operational efficiency.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：diffusion；方法：experimental

matches.title: Numerical study on rheology of emulsions and bubbly suspensions with elastoviscoplastic matrix fluids in simple shear
matches.title_zh: 弹粘塑性基质流体乳液和气泡悬浮液在简单剪切下的流变学数值研究
matches.authors: Kazi Tassawar Iqbal, Daulet Izbassarov, Luca Brandt, and Outi Tammisola
matches.abstract_zh: 将第二相分散在整个载液中会显着改变系统的整体流变性，这是工业过程中普遍存在的包含弹粘塑性 (EVP) 载液的多相系统的传输和混合的关键考虑因素。这项工作研究了载液的弹性和屈服应力对简单剪切下稀至半稀浓度的液滴和气泡悬浮液的整体流变学的作用。对应力预算以及分散相的空间和尺寸分布的分析阐明了载液的 EVP 流变学与影响整体流变学的分散相动力学之间的相互作用。
matches.abstract_en: Dispersing a second phase throughout a carrier fluid significantly alters the system’s bulk rheology, a critical consideration for the transport and mixing of multiphase systems comprising elastoviscoplastic (EVP) carrier fluids ubiquitous in industrial processes. This work investigates the role of elasticity and yield stress of the carrier fluid on the bulk rheology of droplet- and bubble-laden suspensions at dilute to semi-dilute concentrations under simple shear. Analysis of the stress budget and the spatial and size distribution of the dispersed phase elucidates the interplay between the carrier fluid’s EVP rheology and dispersed phase dynamics that influence the bulk rheology.

matches.title: Hysteresis in the freeze-thaw cycle of emulsions and suspensions
matches.title_zh: 乳液和悬浮液冻融循环中的滞后现象
matches.authors: Wilfried Raffi, Jochem G. Meijer, and Detlef Lohse
matches.abstract_zh: 冻融循环驱动物体和移动的固液界面之间复杂的相互作用。利用水包油乳液和聚苯乙烯颗粒悬浮液的实验模型系统，我们揭示了滞后现象的发生：在一个冻融循环后，固体颗粒从其初始位置漂移，而可变形油滴在很大程度上返回到其初始位置，并具有可逆的形状变化。我们的理论模型捕捉了这些趋势，突出了冻融动力学的复杂性。
matches.abstract_en: Freeze–thaw cycles drive complex interactions between objects and moving solid–liquid interfaces. Using experimental model systems of oil-in-water emulsions and polystyrene particle suspensions, we reveal the occurence of hysteresis: Solid particles drift from their initial positions after one freeze-thaw cycle, while deformable oil droplets largely return to their initial positions with reversible shape changes. Our theoretical model captures these trends, highlighting the complexity of freeze–thaw dynamics.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets；方法：experimental、model
