matches.title: An apparent slip model for non-Newtonian liquid-infused microchannels
matches.title_zh: 非牛顿液体注入微通道的表观滑移模型
matches.authors: Chandran, K. Nandakumar, Nair, Adarsh R., Ha, Man Yeong, Kumar, Ranjith S.
matches.abstract_zh: 近年来，注入润滑剂的超疏水微流体表面因其减少阻力的潜力而引起了人们的广泛关注。由于需要检查非牛顿流变学如何影响此类系统中的流体动力阻力，因此开发了一种表观滑移分析模型，用于非牛顿初级流体在非牛顿次级注入流体上的压力驱动流动。为了便于分析处理，将非牛顿液体注入微通道中的泊肃叶流建模为两个相邻的、不混溶的幂律流体在恒定压力梯度下在无限平行板之间共同流动。通过在平坦界面处强制速度和切向剪应力的连续性，获得了速度分布和界面滑移速度的封闭式表达式。事实上，代表性案例的辅助两相全场模拟与界面剪切应力和滑移速度的分析预测一致。对经典有效滑移长度的定量分析表明，它受滑移层厚度、注入流体流变性和界面表观粘度比的控制。进一步获得了相对于经典无滑移通道的滑移流量比和压降比的广义表达式。在当前的双层模型中，对于固定的界面表观粘度比和滑移层厚度，涉及剪切稀化初级和次级流体的组合产生更好的滑移增强和减阻趋势。这些结果提供了一个简化的分析框架，用于解释非牛顿液体注入微通道中依赖于流变学的表观滑移行为。
matches.abstract_en: In recent years, lubricant-infused superhydrophobic microfluidic surfaces have attracted significant attention for their potential to reduce drag. Motivated by the need to examine how non-Newtonian rheology influences hydrodynamic resistance in such systems, an analytical model for apparent slip is developed for pressure-driven flow of a non-Newtonian primary fluid over a non-Newtonian secondary infused fluid. For analytical tractability, Poiseuille flow in a non-Newtonian liquid-infused microchannel is modelled as two adjacent, immiscible power-law fluids co-flowing between infinite parallel plates under a constant pressure gradient. By enforcing continuity of velocity and tangential shear stress at the flat interface, closed-form expressions are obtained for the velocity distribution and interfacial slip velocity. Indeed, auxiliary two-phase full-field simulations for representative cases are consistent with the analytical predictions of interfacial shear stress and slip velocity. A quantitative analysis of the classical effective slip length reveals that it is governed by the slip-layer thickness, the infused fluid rheology and the interfacial apparent viscosity ratio. Generalised expressions are further obtained for the slip flow-rate ratio and the pressure-drop ratio relative to the classical no-slip channel. Within the present two-layer model, for fixed interfacial apparent viscosity ratio and slip-layer thickness, combinations involving shear-thinning primary and secondary fluids yield better slip-enhancement and drag-reduction trends. These results provide a reduced analytical framework for interpreting rheology-dependent apparent slip behaviour in non-Newtonian liquid-infused microchannels.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop、interfacial、interface；降权方法：simulations、model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Drag augmentation of a sphere in high-speed multi-phase flow
matches.title_zh: 高速多相流中球体的阻力增大
matches.abstract_zh: 通过实验研究了超音速条件下气/液两相流对球体阻力的影响。为了模拟穿过类似云的环境的飞行，Mach-4 Ludwieg 管的自由流中注入了单分散液体癸二酸二乙酯 (DEHS) 液滴，直径范围为 7 至 $$16\,\upmu \text {m}$$。使用自由飞行方法进行阻力测量。这些球体被冲动地释放到自由流中，然后不受阻碍地对所经历的力量做出反应。高速双远心可视化系统用于记录球体轨迹，然后从中导出阻力加速度。与等效的清洁流相比，基于颗粒负载流有效密度增加的阻力增加的初步理论估计产量增加了 0.1% 左右。然而，实验测量表明阻力增量高出一个数量级以上，高达约 4%。为了解释这些意外的大幅增加，对球弓激波下游的粒子轨迹进行了模拟。这些表明大多数液滴以超音速撞击球体表面，这表明冲击撞击和/或水锤效应可能导致观察到的阻力增加。
matches.abstract_en: The impact of a gas/liquid two-phase flow on the drag of a sphere at supersonic conditions is investigated experimentally. To simulate flight through a cloud-like environment, the freestream of a Mach-4 Ludwieg tube is seeded with monodisperse liquid Di-Ethyl-Hexyl-Sebacate (DEHS) droplets with diameters ranging from 7 to $$16\,\upmu \text {m}$$. Drag measurements are performed using a free-flight methodology. The spheres are released impulsively into the freestream and thereafter allowed to respond to the experienced forces unhindered. A high-speed bi-telecentric visualization system is used to record the sphere trajectories, from which drag accelerations are then derived. Initial theoretical estimates of drag augmentation based on the increased effective density of the particle-laden flow yield increases of the order of 0.1% compared to an equivalent clean flow. The experimental measurements, however, indicate a drag increment of more than an order of magnitude higher, up to approximately 4%. In an attempt to explain these unexpectedly large increases, simulations of the particle trajectories downstream of the sphere bow shock are conducted. These indicate that the majority of the droplets are impacting the sphere surface supersonically, suggesting that shock impingement and/or the water-hammer effect may be contributing to the observed drag increase.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets；方法：experimental、high-speed；降权方法：simulations；期刊：Experiments in Fluids

matches.title: Feedthrough between two successive cylindrical water–air interfaces in divergent geometry
matches.authors: Niu, Shuzhen, Yang, Pengfei, Meng, Baoqing, Liang, Yu
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: This study experimentally and theoretically investigates the feedthrough between two successive cylindrical water–air interfaces under divergent expansion. Three initial conditions are examined: interfaces initially in-phase and anti-phase, and an initially unperturbed outer interface. Amplitude measurements reveal that the feedthrough depends on the initial perturbation phase difference, thereby altering the instability evolution of both interfaces. A linear theory is developed for cylindrical fluid layers, accounting for surface tension and cylindrically divergent (outward-expanding) geometry, and agrees well with experiments in the near-unity Atwood number regime. Dimensionless feedthrough efficiency factors derived from the linear theory demonstrate that the interface coupling is determined by the radius ratio of two interfaces, interface acceleration, and perturbation wavenumbers. Notably, under extremely high acceleration (as a theoretical limit of our model), the feedthrough is predicted to stabilise both interfaces. This trend, if it persists under compressible conditions, could have implications for inertial confinement fusion. These results provide critical guidance for instability manipulation in both radially convergent and radially divergent geometries.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interface、surface tension；方法：experiments；降权方法：model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Solid adsorption: the missing mechanism for surfactant contact lines – a phase-field approach
matches.title_zh: 固体吸附：表面活性剂接触线缺失的机制——相场方法
matches.authors: Kunchi Kannan, Parvathy, Iqbal, Kazi Tassawar, Díaz, Diego, Mateman, Ilse, Mirjalili, Shahab, Amberg, Gustav, Bagheri, Shervin, Tammisola, Outi
matches.abstract_zh: 我们为两相流中的可溶性表面活性剂开发了热力学一致的相场模型，结合了界面和固体表面吸附。该模型是通过符合热力学第二定律的变分原理推导出来的，从而修改了自由能和边界条件，捕获表面活性剂传输、吸附和润湿动力学。这项工作的一个关键贡献是在固体壁上包含表面活性剂吸附，这导致与实验观察结果定性一致：与预测亲水表面变得更加亲水和疏水表面变得更加疏水的先前数值研究不同，我们的模型显示了所有接触角上亲水性增加的转变 - 与实验趋势一致。我们的结果表明，固体吸附提供了负载表面活性剂的接触线动力学预测建模所需的缺失机制。
matches.abstract_en: We develop a thermodynamically consistent phase-field model for soluble surfactants in two-phase flows, incorporating both interfacial and solid surface adsorption. The model is derived via variational principles consistent with the second law of thermodynamics, resulting in modified free energies and boundary conditions that capture surfactant transport, adsorption and wetting dynamics. A key contribution of this work is the inclusion of surfactant adsorption on solid walls, which leads to qualitative agreement with experimental observations: unlike prior numerical studies that predicted hydrophilic surfaces becoming more hydrophilic and hydrophobic surfaces more hydrophobic, our model shows a shift towards increased hydrophilicity across all contact angles – consistent with experimental trends. Our results establish that solid adsorption provides the missing mechanism required for predictive modelling of surfactant-laden contact line dynamics.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interfacial、wetting、contact line；方法：experimental；降权方法：phase-field、model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Impact dynamics of droplet containing particle suspensions on deep liquid pool
matches.title_zh: 含颗粒悬浮液滴对深液池的冲击动力学
matches.authors: Boqian Yan and Xiaoyu Tang
matches.abstract_zh: 虽然牛顿流体对液滴对液池的影响进行了深入研究，但颗粒悬浮液引入了复杂的非牛顿动力学。这项工作通过实验确定了玉米淀粉悬浮液滴的五种不同的冲击状态，揭示了简单流体中不存在的独特现象，例如“包裹气泡”和冲击引起的干扰。通过能量平衡分析，作者证明这些行为是由池腔动力学和悬浮液流变学之间的直接竞争决定的。由此产生的过渡边界为 3D 打印等工程应用提供了实用指导。
matches.abstract_en: While droplet impact on liquid pools is well studied for Newtonian fluids, particle suspensions introduce complex non-Newtonian dynamics. This work experimentally identifies five distinct impact regimes for cornstarch suspension droplets, revealing unique phenomena like “wrapped bubbles” and impact-induced jamming that are absent in simple fluids. Through an energy balance analysis, the authors demonstrate that these behaviors are dictated by a direct competition between pool cavity dynamics and suspension rheology. The resulting transition boundaries offer practical guidance for engineering applications like 3D printing.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Electrostatics slows down the breakup of liquid bridges on solid surfaces
matches.title_zh: 静电减缓固体表面液桥的破裂
matches.authors: Salar Jabbary Farrokhi, Aaron D. Ratschow, and Steffen Hardt
matches.abstract_zh: 近年来，以前被忽视的静电效应的重要性为动态润湿领域开辟了新的视角。虽然已经在滑动液滴中研究了自发充电，但在这里，我们表明它可以极大地影响毛细管润湿不稳定性。润湿表面的液桥的毛细管破裂会导致静电充电，从而减慢破裂动力学并导致卫星液滴的自发运动。我们的结果强调了静电在除滑滴之外的去湿过程中的核心重要性。
matches.abstract_en: In recent years, the importance of previously overlooked electrostatic effects has opened a new perspective in the field of dynamic wetting. While spontaneous charging has been investigated in sliding drops, here, we show that it can substantially affect capillary wetting instabilities. The capillary breakup of a liquid bridge wetting a surface causes electrostatic charging that slows down the breakup dynamics and leads to spontaneous motion of satellite drops. Our results highlight the central importance of electrostatics in dewetting processes beyond sliding drops.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drops、capillary、wetting；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: An absorption-based sensor system for accurate in situ examination of liquid film formation upon spray–wall interaction at elevated temperatures
matches.title_zh: 基于吸收的传感器系统，用于准确原位检查高温下喷雾壁相互作用时液膜的形成
matches.abstract_zh: 液膜对多种工艺的性能有着至关重要的影响。目前，这些类型的薄膜的原位检查受到可用非侵入式测量技术的限制的阻碍，特别是在鲁棒性和工作距离方面。差分吸收能够在简化的实验室配置中对各种薄膜参数进行非侵入式测量，但由于薄膜界面处的杂散反射严重干扰测量的信号污染，因此很少在实际工艺条件下应用。当润湿表面粗糙时，它们的影响尤其明显，就像许多技术表面的情况一样。为了克服这种敏感性并实现精确测量，提出了一种基于成像的测量系统，该系统可以识别薄膜界面处的反射并从信号中过滤掉反射。该概念通过蒙特卡罗模拟得到验证，并通过使用它来表征将水注入流动台时形成的薄膜进行实验证明，该流动台旨在促进选择性催化还原 (SCR) 背景下的实验。与利用区域积分探测器的既定传感器概念相比，新开发的系统提供了对薄膜温度和厚度有意义的估计。
matches.abstract_en: Thin liquid films critically influence the performance of a wide range of processes. In situ examination of these types of films is currently hindered by the limitations of available non-intrusive measurement techniques, particularly with respect to robustness and working distance. Differential absorption enables non-intrusive measurements of various film parameters in simplified laboratory configurations, but has rarely been applied under realistic process conditions due to signal contamination by spurious reflections at the film interface that severely perturb measurements. Their influence is particularly pronounced when the wetted surface is rough, as is the case for many technical surfaces. To overcome this susceptibility and enable accurate measurements, an imaging-based measurement system is proposed that allows reflections at the film interface to be identified and filtered from the signal. The concept is validated using Monte Carlo simulations and demonstrated experimentally by using it to characterize a film that forms when water is injected into a flow bench designed to facilitate experiments in the context of selective catalytic reduction (SCR). In contrast to the established sensor concept that utilizes an area-integrating detector, the newly developed system provides meaningful estimates for film temperature and thickness.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：liquid film、interface；方法：experiments；降权方法：simulations；期刊：Experiments in Fluids

matches.title: Controlling droplet breakup and routing in microfluidic T-Junctions via wettability contrast
matches.title_zh: 通过润湿性对比控制微流体 T 形接头中的液滴破碎和路径
matches.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们使用基于二元 Shan-Chen 模型的三维多元格玻尔兹曼方法研究了不对称润湿条件如何影响微流体 T 形接头中的液滴动力学。该模型已根据理论和基准案例进行了验证，包括杨-拉普拉斯定律和经典对称液滴破碎。通过一系列模拟，我们探索了接触角对比、液滴长度、毛细管数、通道几何形状和粘度比对分裂和非分裂状态边缘的影响。结果表明，空间润湿性不对称性显着改变了液滴的演化，从而促进受控的重定向或抑制破碎。增加上下接触角差会促进液滴转向更易润湿的一侧，而较高的毛细管数量和较长的液滴往往会经历更多的破碎。此外，诸如纵横比和侧面与主通道宽度比等几何参数调节表面力和水动力之间的竞争，从而严重影响液滴的最终状态。粘度比以两种方式影响液滴动力学：影响内部再循环和界面应力抵抗。这项工作旨在通过利用润湿性工程和几何设计，为被动液滴控制提供基于物理的框架，为芯片实验室设备和多相流系统提供实用的见解。未来的工作将结合非牛顿效应和动态润湿，以将适用性扩展到更复杂的流态。
matches.abstract_en: In this study, we investigate how the asymmetric wetting conditions affect the droplet dynamics in microfluidic T-junctions using a three-dimensional multicomponent lattice Boltzmann method based on the two-component Shan–Chen model. The model has been validated against theoretical and benchmark cases, including the Young–Laplace law and classical symmetric droplet breakup. Through a series of simulations, we have explored the effects of contact angle contrast, droplet length, capillary number, channel geometry, and viscosity ratio on the margins that split breakup and non-breakup regimes. The results demonstrate that spatial wettability asymmetry significantly alters droplet evolution, which promotes controlled redirection or suppression of breakup. Increasing the upper-lower contact angle difference promotes droplet steering toward the more wettable side, whereas higher capillary numbers and longer droplets tend to experience more breakup. Additionally, geometric parameters such as aspect ratio and side-to-main channel width ratio regulate the competition between surface and hydrodynamic forces, critically influencing droplet final state. The viscosity ratio affects the droplet dynamics in two ways: impacting internal recirculation and interfacial stress resistance. This work aims to provide a physics-based framework for passive droplet control by utilizing wettability engineering and geometrical design to offer practical insights for lab-on-a-chip devices and multiphase flow systems. Future work will incorporate non-Newtonian effects and dynamic wetting to extend applicability to more complex flow regimes.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、multicomponent、capillary、interfacial、wetting；降权方法：simulations、lattice Boltzmann、model；期刊：Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: On acoustic–gravity wave triad resonance over an elastic half-space
matches.title_zh: 弹性半空间上的声重力波三元组共振
matches.authors: Kadri, Usama
matches.abstract_zh: 自由表面重力波和声重力运动之间的非线性相互作用提供了弱可压缩流体中能量交换的机制，并且长期以来一直与微震和低频水下声有关。虽然弹性固体地球响应已被纳入微震建模中，但声重力波共振三元组的现有公式几乎完全是针对刚性海底开发的，这引入了浅水截止，其中声重力成员变得消失并且不能发生共振。在这里，我们将共振三元组框架扩展到弹性半空间上的可压缩流体。海底弹性改变了声重力本征结构和色散关系，允许在刚性底部假设下无法访问的区域中传播或界面引导的声重力模式，从而消除频率（或深度）的刚性截止。利用小压缩性参数的多尺度展开，我们推导出耦合到单个弹性声重力模式的两个反向传播重力波的调制方程。一个关键特征是由弹性边界算子的参数依赖性引起的可解性条件中的界面项，它改变了模态归一化以及由此产生的耦合和失谐系数。扩大的容许参数空间还使得实验室规模的声重力三元组共振的实现变得更加可行，从而能够对三元组机制进行受控研究。
matches.abstract_en: Nonlinear interactions between free-surface gravity waves and acoustic–gravity motions provide a mechanism for energy exchange in weakly compressible fluids and have long been discussed in connection with microseisms and low-frequency underwater sound. While elastic solid-Earth response has been incorporated in microseism modelling, existing formulations of acoustic–gravity wave resonant triads are almost exclusively developed for a rigid seabed, which introduces a shallow-water cutoff where the acoustic–gravity member becomes evanescent and resonance cannot occur. Here, we extend the resonant-triad framework to a compressible fluid over an elastic half-space. Seabed elasticity modifies the acoustic–gravity eigenstructure and dispersion relation, admitting propagating or interface-guided acoustic–gravity modes in regimes inaccessible under rigid-bottom assumptions and thereby removing the rigid cutoff in frequency (or depth). Using a multiple-scale expansion in the small compressibility parameter, we derive modulation equations for two counter-propagating gravity waves coupled to a single elastic acoustic–gravity mode. A key feature is an interfacial term in the solvability condition arising from the parameter dependence of the elastic boundary operator, which alters the modal normalisation and the resulting coupling and detuning coefficients. The enlarged admissible parameter space also makes laboratory-scale realisations of acoustic–gravity triad resonance substantially more feasible, enabling controlled investigation of the triad mechanism.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interfacial、interface；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Shear-free, inhomogeneous turbulence in a stably stratified fluid
matches.title_zh: 稳定分层流体中的无剪切、不均匀湍流
matches.authors: Hass, Ryan, Lele, Sanjiva
matches.abstract_zh: 高分辨率大涡模拟是在存在初始锐密度界面的情况下对局部受迫、无剪切湍流进行的。这些模拟让人想起振荡网格湍流实验，该实验用于隔离湍流扩散和背景剪切夹带的影响。通过模拟这种流动，我们避免了实验中常见的挑战，例如由于侧壁效应以及分层剂和强迫区域不可避免的相互作用而导致的二次流污染。为了解决后一个问题，我们在强迫层的控制方程中添加了一个加热项（势能汇），从而防止热通量通过源区域。这种修改在混合层中建立了连续的分层，这在实验中通常被认为可以忽略不计。尽管存在这种差异，我们仍然能够对总体夹带率进行有意义的比较，总体夹带率随着具有湍流理查森数的幂律而变化。两个指数 和 是根据理查森数和所使用的夹带率的定义来测量的。得出的定义与大多数实验一致，我们认为如果能够测量相关量，这是更好的选择。我们还验证了均匀流体中湍流速度和长度尺度的自相似标度，并根据局部弗劳德数提出了分层情况的“内部”和“外部”标度。详细的缩放结果对于湍流模型验证很有用。
matches.abstract_en: High-resolution large eddy simulations are conducted of locally forced, shear-free turbulence in the presence of an initially sharp density interface. The simulations are reminiscent of oscillating grid turbulence experiments used to isolate the effect of turbulent diffusion and entrainment from background shear. By simulating such a flow we avoid common challenges of the experiments such as secondary-flow contamination due to sidewall effects and the inevitable interaction of the stratifying agent and forcing region. To address the latter concern, we add a heating term (potential energy sink) to the governing equations in the forcing layer, thereby preventing a heat flux through the source region. This modification sets up a continuous stratification in the mixed layer that is often assumed to be negligible in experiments. Despite this difference, we are able to make meaningful comparisons in terms of the overall entrainment rate, which varies as a power law with a turbulent Richardson number. Two exponents, and , are measured depending on the definition of the Richardson number and entrainment rate used. The definition leading to is consistent with most experiments, and we argue it is the superior choice if one is able to measure the relevant quantities. We also verify the self-similar scaling of turbulence velocity and length scales in the homogeneous fluid and propose ‘inner’ and ‘outer’ scalings for the stratified cases based on a local Froude number. The detailed scaling results are useful for turbulence model validation.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interface；方法：experiments；降权方法：simulations、model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Wavemaker and endogeneity of gravitationally stretched weakly viscoelastic jets
matches.title_zh: 引力拉伸弱粘弹性射流的造波机和内生性
matches.authors: Moreno-Boza, Daniel
matches.abstract_zh: 由重力产生的高度拉伸的毛细管射流是液滴生成、微丝形成和拉伸流变概念的核心。对于牛顿流体，重力拉伸射流从稳定喷射到自激振荡的转变可以通过一维细长射流方程准确预测，该方程保留精确的界面曲率并允许全局特征值分析（Rubio-Rubio et al. 2013, J. Fluid Mech., vol. 729, pp. 471–483）。另外，受 Oldroyd-B/Giesekus 本构定律控制的弱粘弹性射流表现出弹性毛细管状态和串珠动力学，这些动态可以被一维自由表面模型很好地捕获（Ardekani 等人，2010 J. Fluid Mech.，第 665 卷，第 46-56 页）。在这里，我们研究了 Oldroyd-B 极限下重力拉伸粘弹性射流的一维全曲率模型的全局线性稳定性。我们首先对牛顿极限进行基准测试，再现边缘光谱和基流剖面，然后通过跟踪流变参数空间中的主要全局 Hopf 特征对来量化弹性如何改变临界喷射-滴落边界。对于实验相关的中等弹性（以统一德博拉数为特征），聚合物张力会改变临界韦伯数和选定的振荡频率，而内生性（即不受扰动的流动动力学对选定的全局特征值的局部贡献）揭示了边缘性是由毛细管/运动学贡献和附加弹性应力反馈路径之间的平衡产生的。为了解释和预测起始机制，我们从直接伴随本征函数计算造波器和感受性/结构敏感场，表明粘弹性扩大了下游的敏感区域，而伴随仍然强烈局部化在入口附近，从而将近喷嘴区域识别为主要感受性位置。
matches.abstract_en: Highly stretched capillary jets produced by gravity are central to drop generation, micro-thread formation and extensional-rheometry concepts. For Newtonian fluids, the transition from steady jetting to self-excited oscillations in a gravitationally stretched jet is predicted accurately by one-dimensional slender-jet equations that retain the exact interfacial curvature and admit a global eigenvalue analysis (Rubio-Rubio et al. 2013, J. Fluid Mech. , vol. 729, pp. 471–483). Separately, weakly viscoelastic jets governed by Oldroyd-B/Giesekus constitutive laws exhibit elastocapillary regimes and beads-on-a-string dynamics that are well captured by one-dimensional free-surface models (Ardekani et al. 2010 J. Fluid Mech. , vol. 665, pp. 46–56). Here, we study the global linear stability of a one-dimensional full-curvature model for gravitationally stretched viscoelastic jets in the Oldroyd-B limit. We first benchmark the Newtonian limit, reproducing marginal spectra and base-flow profiles, and then quantify how elasticity shifts the critical jetting–dripping boundary by tracking the leading global Hopf eigenpair across the rheological parametric space. For experimentally relevant moderate elasticity, characterised by order-unity Deborah numbers, polymeric tension modifies both the critical Weber number and the selected oscillation frequency, and endogeneity, i.e. the local contribution of the unperturbed flow dynamics to the selected global eigenvalue, reveals that marginality results from a balance between capillary/kinematic contributions and an additional elastic-stress feedback pathway. To interpret and predict the onset mechanism, we compute wavemakers and receptivity/structural-sensitivity fields from direct–adjoint eigenfunctions, showing that viscoelasticity broadens the sensitivity region downstream while the adjoint remains strongly localised near the inlet, thereby identifying the near-nozzle region as the dominant receptive location.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop、capillary、interfacial；降权方法：model、models；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Pattern formation in rectilinear flows of noncolloidal suspensions
matches.title_zh: 非胶体悬浮液直线流动中的模式形成
matches.authors: Parham Poureslami, Ranit Mukherjee, and Sungyon Lee
matches.abstract_zh: 当非胶体悬浮液置换 Hele-Shaw 池内的空气时，就会发生颗粒诱导粘性指进 (PIVF)，从而导致在前进界面处形成颗粒簇或“羽流”。尽管过去十年进行了广泛的研究，但羽流和界面变形之间的耦合仍未得到检验。在本文中，我们通过推导连接毛细管现象、局部颗粒浓度和界面速度之间相互作用的比例定律来解决这种耦合问题。我们还发现了直线几何结构所特有的 PIVF 新机制，其中粒子羽流相互作用并合并，从而增强了悬浮液内部的混合。
matches.abstract_en: Particle-induced viscous fingering (PIVF) occurs when a non-colloidal suspension displaces air inside a Hele-Shaw cell, which leads to the formation of particle clusters, or “plumes” at the advancing interface. Despite extensive studies in the last decade, the coupling between plumes and interfacial deformations remains unexamined. In this paper, we address this coupling by deriving scaling laws that connect the interplay between capillarity, local particle concentrations, and interfacial speed. We also uncover new regimes of PIVF that are unique to rectilinear geometry, in which particle plumes interact and coalesce, resulting in enhanced mixing inside the suspension.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interfacial、interface；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Statistical orientation and distribution of columnar ice crystals in turbulent flows
matches.title_zh: 湍流中柱状冰晶的统计取向和分布
matches.authors: Alain Pumir, Muhammad Zubair Sheikh, Kristian Gustavsson, Emmanuel Lévêque, Bernhard Mehlig, and Aurore Naso
matches.abstract_zh: 当它们穿过湍流云时，在足够低的温度下形成的细长冰晶会受到空气湍流运动的影响。这种晶体通常小于流动的柯尔莫哥洛夫长度尺度，倾向于垂直于重力排列，并且在较小程度上平行于涡度排列。由于流动采样不均匀，湍流会增加晶体的沉降速度。
matches.abstract_en: As they settle through turbulent clouds, elongated ice crystals, which form at low enough temperature, are affected by the turbulent motion of air. Such crystals, which are typically smaller than the Kolmogorov length scale of the flow, tend to align perpendicular to gravity, and to a lesser extent, parallel to vorticity. Turbulence is shown to increase the settling velocity of the crystals due to their inhomogeneous sampling of the flow.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：ice；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: The yield limit for a single bubble trapped in a damaged viscoplastic fluid
matches.title_zh: 受损粘塑性流体中单个气泡的屈服极限
matches.authors: Hadizadeh, Anita, Frigaard, Ian A.
matches.abstract_zh: 屈服应力流体中上升的气泡在流体的记忆中留下了路径。这些反过来又影响随后释放的气泡的轨迹。定性地讲，该效应表现为受损的通路，此处建模为周围粘塑性流体内的低粘度牛顿流体。正如通过计算和实验观察到的那样，二次气泡被吸引到这些路径上。在这里，我们探讨了受损路径对被困气泡释放的影响，由临界屈服数捕获。我们表明，与受损路径的接近度会增加，但最终超出临界距离后，不会产生任何影响。我们探讨了形状和表面张力对上述邻近结果的影响。
matches.abstract_en: Bubbles rising in yield-stress fluids leave behind pathways in the memory of the fluid. These in turn influence the trajectories of subsequent bubbles released. Qualitatively, the effect manifests as a damaged pathway, modelled here as a low-viscosity Newtonian fluid within the surrounding viscoplastic fluid. Secondary bubbles are attracted towards these pathways, as is observed computationally and experimentally. Here we explore the effect of a damaged path on the release of a trapped bubble, captured by the critical yield number . We show that proximity to a damaged path increases , but eventually beyond a critical distance there is no influence on . We explore the effects of shape and surface tension on the aforementioned proximity results.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：surface tension；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Convective heat transfer in the thin film of an elongated bubble in the absence of phase change
matches.title_zh: 在没有相变的情况下细长气泡薄膜中的对流传热
matches.authors: Paolo Botticini, Davide Picchi, and Pietro Poesio
matches.abstract_zh: 微通道中的细长气泡为增强对流换热提供了一种有前景但仍缺乏量化的途径。我们开发了一个一维模型，捕捉气泡周围薄膜中的平流、扩散、粘性耗散和壁热通量之间的相互作用。结果揭示了努塞尔数的比例定律，将薄膜流动动力学直接与传热效率联系起来。
matches.abstract_en: Elongated bubbles in microchannels offer a promising yet still poorly quantified route to enhance convective heat transfer. We develop a one-dimensional model capturing the interplay between advection, diffusion, viscous dissipation, and wall heat flux in the thin film around the bubble. The results reveal scaling laws for the Nusselt number, linking thin-film flow dynamics directly to heat transfer efficiency.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：phase change、thin film、heat transfer；降权方法：model；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Deformation and stability of a gas bubble in a biaxial straining flow
matches.title_zh: 双轴应变流中气泡的变形和稳定性
matches.authors: Aliénor Rivière, David Fabre, Jacques Magnaudet, and François Gallaire
matches.abstract_zh: 我们研究了双轴应变流中不可压缩气泡的线性动力学，其特征是在存在有限惯性效应的情况下有两个拉伸方向和一个压缩方向。与粘性效应和毛细管效应相比，当改变 Ohnesorge 数时，系统经历鞍结分叉并表现出截然不同的平衡形状。线性稳定性分析揭示了系统丰富的动态特性。研究发现，双轴流中的气泡比单轴流中的气泡更加稳定，这可以解释为什么尽管双轴区域更为常见，但湍流破裂主要发生在单轴区域。
matches.abstract_en: We study the linear dynamics of an incompressible gas bubble in a biaxial straining flow, characterized by two stretching and one compressing directions, in the presence of finite inertial effects. The system undergoes a saddle-node bifurcation and exhibits strongly different equilibrium shapes when varying the Ohnesorge number comparing viscous and capillary effects. Linear stability analysis reveals the rich dynamics of the system. Bubbles are found to be significantly more stable in biaxial than in uniaxial flows, which may explain why turbulent breakup mainly occurs in uniaxial regions despite biaxial regions being more common.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: On the generation of free-surface waves by instabilities in quadratic shear flows
matches.authors: Muppirala, Harishankar, Patibandla, Ramana, Roy, Anubhab
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：<urlopen error [SSL: UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING] EOF occurred in violation of protocol (_ssl.c:1081)>
matches.abstract_en: This paper investigates the generation of free-surface waves in a liquid layer driven by linear instabilities in Couette–Poiseuille (quadratic) shear flows. The base velocity profiles are characterized by a curvature parameter, and two-dimensional viscous and inviscid perturbations are analysed across a wide parameter space of curvature, wavenumber and Reynolds number, for fixed Froude and Bond numbers. In the inviscid limit, analytical solutions of the Rayleigh equation reveal that velocity profiles ranging from half-parabolic to linear flows remain stable against the rippling instability, with long-wave growth occurring only under strong interfacial forcing, whereas weaker forcing produces well-defined stability boundaries. For the viscous problem, Orr–Sommerfeld computations and asymptotic analyses reveal that a slight convex curvature of the shear flow suppresses long-wave instabilities, while a slight concave curvature suppresses short-wave instabilities, so even small deviations from a linear profile produce qualitatively different behaviours. Furthermore, we observe that strongly forced long waves are more unstable at large than the inviscid value they latch on to as . Growth-rate maps highlight smooth transitions between long-wave and rippling modes and reveal a shear instability near the linear profile at high Reynolds numbers. Based on energy transfers and eigenfunction structures, five distinct instability types are identified: shear, rippling, long-wave interfacial, short-wave interfacial and a composite mode that combines features of shear, rippling and long-wave interfacial instabilities at large Reynolds numbers.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：interfacial；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: A solution for the quasi-one-dimensional linearised Euler equations with wall friction
matches.title_zh: 具有壁面摩擦力的准一维线性化欧拉方程的解
matches.authors: Hu, Xiao, Morgans, Aimee, Yeddula, Saikumar R.
matches.abstract_zh: 对由声波和/或熵波强制的壁摩擦的喷嘴的非稳态响应进行了建模。该方法基于准一维线性化欧拉方程。该方程由三个变量组成，即无量纲质量、停滞温度和熵涨落，它们是系统在零频率和没有壁摩擦的情况下的不变量。使用马格努斯展开法求解所得的一阶微分方程组，其中扰动参数是归一化频率和范宁摩擦系数。在这项工作中，首次使用由壁摩擦引起的流动非等熵性的度量作为膨胀参数。该求解方法适用于亚音速和超音速流动情况下具有壁面摩擦的收敛-扩散喷嘴，与数值预测吻合良好。进一步探讨了具有壁摩擦和稳定传热的喷嘴流动。据观察，喷嘴的声学和熵传递函数强烈依赖于频率、壁摩擦和传热。壁摩擦通过平均流量的变化以及声学、速度和熵波动之间的耦合来影响非稳态响应。
matches.abstract_en: The unsteady response of nozzles with wall friction forced by acoustic and/or entropy waves is modelled. The approach is based on the quasi-one-dimensional linearised Euler equations. The equations are cast in terms of three variables, namely the dimensionless mass, stagnation temperature and entropy fluctuations, which are invariants of the system at zero frequency and in the absence of wall friction. The resulting first-order system of differential equations is solved using the Magnus-expansion method, where the perturbation parameters are the normalised frequencies and Fanning friction factors. In this work, a measure of the flow non-isentropicity caused by wall friction is used for the first time as an expansion parameter. The solution method is applied to a converging–diverging nozzle with wall friction for both subsonic and supersonic flow cases, showing good agreement with numerical predictions. The nozzle flow with both wall friction and steady heat transfer is further explored. It is observed that the acoustic and entropy transfer functions of the nozzle strongly depend on the frequency, wall friction and heat transfer. Wall friction affects the unsteady response through changes in the mean flow and through coupling between acoustic, velocity and entropy fluctuations.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：heat transfer；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Convective flow in coalesced droplets under temperature difference for uniform distribution of microspheres in vertical contact-separation
matches.title_zh: 温差作用下聚并液滴内的对流流动
matches.authors: Shinji Bono, Shintaro Okai, Mary-Johanna Weir Weiss, Boris Stoeber, Satoshi Konishi
matches.abstract_zh: 作者利用聚并液滴两端的温差诱导内部对流，以改善垂直接触-分离过程中微球的均匀分布。该工作关注温度梯度、液滴聚并形态与内部输运之间的关系。
matches.reason: 温差驱动、液滴聚并与内部环流结合，可能涉及热毛细贡献。应用目标偏微球分布，因此优先级低于前九篇，但仍与马兰戈尼和液滴内流方向接近。

matches.title: Curvature-dependent area preserving immersed boundary method for binary immiscible fluids
matches.title_zh: 二元不混溶流体的曲率相关面积保持浸入边界法
matches.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种浸没边界方法（IBM），该方法具有曲率相关、面积保持的校正算法，适用于二元不混溶不可压缩流体流动。 IBM 最初被提出来解决复杂几何形状中的生物流体动力学问题，后来研究人员将其用于多相流体流动，因为它能够直接、简单地表示复杂的界面。在该方法中，需要两种类型的网格：用于计算流体流动的欧拉公式和用于浸没边界运动的拉格朗日表示。如果使用传统方法，由于数值离散误差，会出现面积损失或面积增加。在所提出的校正方法中，拉格朗日界面点的位置沿着法线方向与局部曲率成比例地调整。各种流动条件下液滴变形的数值例子表明，该算法能够在界面发生大变形时离散地保留初始面积。
matches.abstract_en: We propose an immersed boundary method (IBM) with a curvature-dependent, area-preserving correction algorithm for binary immiscible incompressible fluid flows. The IBM was first proposed to solve biofluid dynamics in complex geometries, and researchers later used it for multiphase fluid flows due to its direct and simple representation of complex interfaces. In this method, two types of grids are needed: an Eulerian formulation for the computation of fluid flow and a Lagrangian representation for the movement of the immersed boundary. If the conventional method is used, area loss or area increases occur due to numerical discretization errors. In the proposed correction method, the positions of the Lagrangian interface points are adjusted along the normal direction in proportion to the local curvature. Numerical examples of droplet deformation under various flow conditions show that the proposed algorithm can discretely preserve the initial area while the interface undergoes large deformation.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、interface；期刊：Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Kinetic modelling of droplet ripening in a single-component liquid–vapour system
matches.title_zh: 单组分液-汽系统中液滴成熟的动力学模型
matches.authors: Li, Shaokang, Li, Zuoxu, Gibelli, Livio, Zhang, Yonghao
matches.abstract_zh: 液滴成熟传统上是通过宏观界面理论来建模的，该理论本质上忽略了液-汽系统的固有微观结构，特别是有限扩散界面和相邻的克努森层。解决这些结构至关重要，因为它们控制着界面传输动力学优于体扩散的区域中的传质速率，特别是在微米和纳米液滴相互作用中。为了阐明潜在的基本物理机制，我们使用 Enskog-Vlasov 动力学模型研究了单组分液-汽系统中的液滴成熟。这种方法自然地捕获了漫反射界面和克努森层的完整空间结构。我们首先关注两滴相互作用，根据界面分子通量的内在不平衡推导理论增长率。数值模拟定量地验证了这一预测，证实了液滴半径变化率与热力学驱动力呈线性关系。然而，在成熟的后期阶段出现了与这种线性行为的明显偏差。我们将这种破坏归因于扩散界面的重叠，这降低了液体密度并引起热力学不稳定。最后，我们对三滴系统的模拟证实了所提出的理论模型的普适性。这些发现提供了对成熟的微观理解，并有助于将纳米级动力学与宏观粗化理论联系起来。
matches.abstract_en: Droplet ripening is conventionally modelled by macroscopic interfacial theories, which inherently neglect the intrinsic microscopic structures of the liquid–vapour system, specifically the finite diffuse interface and the adjacent Knudsen layer. Resolving these structures is critical, as they govern mass transfer rates in regimes where interfacial transport kinetics dominate over bulk diffusion, particularly in micro- and nanodroplet interactions. To elucidate the underlying fundamental physical mechanisms, we investigate droplet ripening in a single-component liquid–vapour system using the Enskog–Vlasov kinetic model. This approach naturally captures the full spatial structure of both the diffuse interface and the Knudsen layer. We first focus on two-droplet interactions, deriving a theoretical growth rate based on the intrinsic imbalance of molecular fluxes at the interface. Numerical simulations quantitatively validate this prediction, confirming that the droplet-radius change rate scales linearly with the thermodynamic driving force. However, a distinct deviation from this linear behaviour emerges in the late stage of ripening. We attribute this breakdown to the overlap of diffuse interfaces, which reduces the liquid density and induces thermodynamic destabilisation. Finally, our simulations of three-droplet systems confirm the universality of the proposed theoretical model. These findings provide a microscopic understanding of ripening and help bridge nanoscale dynamics with macroscopic coarsening theories.

matches.title: Fluid dynamics of a liquid mirror space telescope
matches.title_zh: 液镜空间望远镜的流体动力学
matches.authors: Israel Gabay, Omer Luria, Edward Balaban, Amir D. Gat, and Moran Bercovici
matches.abstract_zh: 大口径望远镜目前受到运载火箭的限制。流体望远镜（FLUTE）概念试图通过使用液体镜来克服这个问题，液体镜在微重力下会自然松弛成精确的球形。然而，必要的望远镜操作使液体受到扰乱该界面的体力。本研究通过解决固定在圆形域中的薄液膜的非自伴问题，为此类液体动力学提供了经过实验验证的分析模型。使用该模型模拟数十年的运行，我们发现，虽然边缘干扰不断增加，但内部 80% 的孔径在 20 多年内仍保持光学精度。
matches.abstract_en: Large-aperture telescopes are currently limited by launch vehicle constraints. The Fluidic Telescope (FLUTE) concept seeks to overcome this by using liquid mirrors which, in microgravity, naturally relax into a precise spherical shape. However, necessary telescope maneuvers subject the liquid to body forces that perturb this interface. This study provides an experimentally validated analytical model for such liquid dynamics by solving for the non-self-adjoint problem of a thin liquid film pinned in a circular domain. Using the model to simulate decades of operation, we show that while edge disturbances build up, the inner 80% of the aperture remains optically precise for over 20 years.

matches.title: CLIP: A CUDA-Accelerated lattice boltzmann framework for interfacial phenomena with application to liquid jet simulations
matches.title_zh: CLIP：用于界面现象的 CUDA 加速晶格玻尔兹曼框架及其在液体射流模拟中的应用
matches.abstract_zh: 这项工作介绍了 CLIP，这是一种 CUDA 加速的相场晶格玻尔兹曼框架，用于模拟二维和三维域中具有高密度和粘度比的不混溶两相流。通过利用 GPU 并行性，该框架可显着提高计算速度，从而能够在标准桌面硬件上高效执行大规模模拟，而无需高性能计算集群。它采用加权多重松弛时间 (WMRT) 碰撞算子来增强数值稳定性并改善具有挑战性的多相条件下的界面跟踪。该模型通过一系列基准案例进行了验证，包括毛细波动力学、稳态跌落测试、两相泊肃叶流、剪切驱动界面变形和瑞利-泰勒不稳定性。它进一步应用于模拟液体喷射破碎，捕捉从滴落到喷射状态的转变，并确定大约 2.2 的临界韦伯数。结果与实验观察结果非常吻合，提供了对破碎长度、液滴尺寸分布和流态转变的详细见解。凭借其效率、准确性和可扩展性，所提出的框架可作为研究多相流物理中复杂界面现象的强大且易于使用的工具。
matches.abstract_en: This work introduces CLIP, a CUDA-accelerated phase-field lattice Boltzmann framework for simulating immiscible two-phase flows with high density and viscosity ratios in both two- and three-dimensional domains. By leveraging GPU parallelism, the framework delivers substantial computational speedups, enabling large-scale simulations to be performed efficiently on standard desktop hardware without the need for high-performance computing clusters. It employs the Weighted Multi-Relaxation Time (WMRT) collision operator to enhance numerical stability and improve interface tracking under challenging multiphase conditions. The model is validated through a series of benchmark cases, including capillary wave dynamics, stationary drop tests, two-phase Poiseuille flow, shear-driven interface deformation, and Rayleigh–Taylor instability. It is further applied to simulate liquid jet breakup, capturing the transition from dripping to jetting regimes and identifying a critical Weber number of approximately 2.2. The results closely match experimental observations, offering detailed insights into breakup length, drop size distributions, and flow regime transitions. With its efficiency, accuracy, and scalability, the proposed framework serves as a powerful and accessible tool for investigating complex interfacial phenomena in multiphase flow physics.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop、capillary、interfacial、interface；方法：experimental；降权方法：simulations、computational、lattice Boltzmann、phase-field、model；期刊：Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Mode transitions of droplet generation in electric field-mediated microflows
matches.title_zh: 电场介导的微流中液滴生成的模式转变
matches.authors: Yi Cai, Jiachen Zhao, Runze Sun, Zhongzheng Wang, Emilie Sauret, and Yixing Gou
matches.abstract_zh: 电场驱动的液滴生成为克服传统被动微流控方法的有限可控性提供了一种主动策略；然而，不同电特性组合下控制模式转换的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了一个耦合晶格玻尔兹曼有限差分数值框架来研究不同电场强度、介电常数比和电导率比下 T 形微通道中电流体动力学液滴的形成。我们确定了四种液滴生成模式，并通过分析界面电荷分布和电场力揭示了它们的转变机制。
matches.abstract_en: Electric field–driven droplet generation provides an active strategy for overcoming the limited controllability of conventional passive microfluidic methods; however, the mechanisms governing mode transitions under different combinations of electrical properties remain unclear. Here, we develop a coupled lattice Boltzmann–finite difference numerical framework to investigate electrohydrodynamic droplet formation in T-shaped microchannels under varying electric field strengths, permittivity ratios and conductivity ratios. We identify four droplet generation modes and reveal their transition mechanisms by analyzing interfacial charge distributions and electric-field forces.

matches.title: Natural convection in heterogeneous porous stratum
matches.title_zh: 非均质多孔地层中的自然对流
matches.authors: Tianpei Cheng, Haijian Yang, Mei Zhang, and Ke Xu
matches.abstract_zh: 多孔介质中的瑞利-达西对流 (RDC) 控制着许多地质系统中的质量和传热。我们发现渗透率异质性从根本上重塑了 RDC。渗透率相关长度与决定对流模式的内在流动结构尺度相互作用。高分辨率模拟揭示了取决于瑞利数 (Ra) 的三种不同的异质性状况： (i) 在低 Ra 下，稳定的对流单元受到限制； (ii) 在中间 Ra 微羽驱动的运输得到增强； (iii) 在高 Ra 下，异质性变得可以忽略不计或由边界层控制。这为预测对流混合和标量输运提供了理论支持。
matches.abstract_en: Rayleigh–Darcy convection (RDC) in porous media controls mass and heat transfer in many geological systems. We show that permeability heterogeneity fundamentally reshapes RDC. The permeability correlation length interacts with intrinsic flow-structure scales that determine the convection pattern. High-resolution simulations reveal three distinct heterogeneity regimes depending on Rayleigh number (Ra): (i) At low Ra stable convection cells are constrained; (ii) At intermediate Ra microplume-driven transport is enhanced; and (iii) At high Ra heterogeneity becomes negligible or boundary-layer-controlled. This provides theoretical support for predicting convective mixing and scalar transport.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：heat transfer；降权方法：simulations；期刊：Physical Review Fluids

matches.title: Lattice Boltzmann model for non-ideal compressible fluid dynamics
matches.title_zh: 非理想可压缩流体动力学的格子玻尔兹曼模型
matches.authors: Hosseini, Seyed Ali, Feinberg, Milo, Karlin, Ilya
matches.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的动力学模型及其晶格玻尔兹曼实现，用于模拟可压缩的非理想流体流动。该方法采用第一邻格并引入通过准平衡吸引子构造的一组一致的校正项，确保正定和伽利略不变的纳维-斯托克斯耗散率。这种结构避免了对扩展模板或临时正则化的需要，同时在广泛的流动状态下保持数值稳定性和热力学一致性。由此产生的模型准确地再现了欧拉和纳维-斯托克斯流体动力学极限。作为严格的验证，我们首次在格子玻尔兹曼框架内展示了马赫数高达 1.47 的冲击-下降相互作用的定量精确模拟。因此，所提出的方法将格子玻尔兹曼方法的适用性扩展到具有最小动力学模板的高速、非理想可压缩流。
matches.abstract_en: We present a new kinetic model and its lattice Boltzmann realisation for the simulation of compressible, non-ideal fluid flows. The method employs first-neighbour lattices and introduces a consistent set of correction terms constructed via quasi-equilibrium attractors, ensuring positive-definite and Galilean-invariant Navier–Stokes dissipation rates. This construction circumvents the need for extended stencils or ad hoc regularisation, while maintaining numerical stability and thermodynamic consistency across a broad range of flow regimes. The resulting model accurately reproduces both the Euler and Navier–Stokes hydrodynamic limits. As a stringent validation, we demonstrate, for the first time within a lattice Boltzmann framework, quantitatively accurate simulations of shock–drop interactions at Mach numbers up to 1.47. The proposed approach thus extends the applicability of lattice Boltzmann methods to high-speed, non-ideal compressible flows with a minimal kinetic stencil.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：drop；方法：high-speed；降权方法：simulation、simulations、lattice Boltzmann、model；期刊：Journal of Fluid Mechanics

matches.title: Gauss principle in incompressible flow: a unified variational perspective on pressure and projection
matches.title_zh: 不可压缩流动中的高斯原理：关于压力和投影的统一变分视角
matches.authors: Duraisamy, Karthik
matches.abstract_zh: 继最近的工作（Gonzalez & Taha 2022 J. Fluid Mech.，第 941 卷，A58；Peters & Ormiston 2025 AIAA J.，第 63 卷，第 6-20 页）之后，本手稿阐明了高斯-阿佩尔原理在不可压缩、无粘流中的决定因素以及它如何与经典投影方法联系起来。在固定时间，冻结速度并仅改变材料加速度会导致受加速度水平约束的二次方最小化。一阶条件产生了反应压力的泊松-诺依曼问题，其梯度消除了临时残差的非螺线管和壁法向内容，正是众所周知的勒雷-霍奇投影。因此，Gauss-Appell 强制执行瞬时运动学约束并立即恢复欧拉。一旦指定了外加物理场，例如通过外部体力，反作用压力将被唯一确定（最多可达附加常数），作为强制不可压缩性和壁不可渗透性的拉格朗日乘数；它对无散度、壁切线运动不起作用。这是不可压缩流中压力的公认解释。该原理的直接、固定时间应用确定了已经指定的速度场的反作用压力，并且本身不选择循环或停滞点，因为这些是速度状态的属性，而不是瞬时加速度校正。将压力形式分解为外加分量和反作用分量允许表示自由，这并不意味着约束力的物理非唯一性。正交性约定（例如狄利克雷正交性）可以作为附加建模选择来修复表示自由度。这种变分观点还产生了一个简单的计算诊断：最小化的阿佩尔方程等于反作用压力梯度的范数，该范数对于约束兼容的更新消失并随着发散和壁通量不匹配的大小而增长。
matches.abstract_en: Following recent work (Gonzalez & Taha 2022 J. Fluid Mech. , vol. 941 , A58; Peters & Ormiston 2025 AIAA J. , vol. 63 , pp. 6–20), this manuscript clarifies what the Gauss–Appell principle determines in incompressible, inviscid flow and how it connects to classical projection methods. At a fixed time, freezing the velocity and varying only the material acceleration leads to minimisation of a quadratic subject to acceleration-level constraints. First-order conditions yield a Poisson–Neumann problem for a reaction pressure whose gradient removes the non-solenoidal and wall-normal content of the provisional residual, precisely the well-known Leray–Hodge projection. Thus, Gauss–Appell enforces the instantaneous kinematic constraints and recovers Euler at the instant. Once the impressed physics is specified, for instance via external body forces, the reaction pressure is uniquely determined (up to an additive constant) as the Lagrange multiplier enforcing incompressibility and wall impermeability; it does no work on divergence-free, wall-tangent motions. This is the well-established interpretation of pressure in incompressible flow. The direct, fixed-time application of this principle determines the reaction pressure for an already-specified velocity field and does not, by itself, select circulation or stagnation points, because these are properties of the velocity state, not the instantaneous acceleration correction. The formal decomposition of the pressure into impressed and reaction components admits representational freedom that does not imply physical non-uniqueness of the constraint force. Orthogonality conventions such as Dirichlet orthogonality can fix the representational freedom as an additional modelling choice. This variational viewpoint also yields a simple computational diagnostic: the minimised Appellian equals a norm of the reaction-pressure gradient which vanishes for constraint-compatible updates and grows with the magnitude of divergence and wall-flux mismatch.

matches.title: Mathematical and computer models of the process of liquid filling a capillary in the system “experimental closed tank + capillary”
matches.title_zh: “实验密闭罐+毛细管”系统中液体充填毛细管过程的数学和计算机模型
matches.abstract_zh: 提出了一种关于液体填充壁上有毛细管的实验密闭罐（ECT）的过程的假设，其外观可能是ECT壁和焊缝的制造缺陷。该假设考虑了 ECT 壁材料的润湿性、毛细管效应 (CE)、液体蒸发和 ECT 体积与环境之间的压力差以及该过程的持续时间。考虑向 ECT 体积供应液体的三种选择。它们对应于 ECT 制造中的技术操作：清洗、液压测试和校准。基于纳维-斯托克斯方程，开发了 ECT 和毛细管中的传热传质以及液体动力学的物理数学模型 (PMM)。获得的PMM用于构建相应的计算机模型（CM）。以ECT清洗为例，对液体充填毛细管的过程进行了数值模拟。充满液体的毛细管体积随时间的变化确定，包括温度、压力、ECT 入口处粘性不可压缩液体的质量流量、ECT 壁的润湿性和暴露时间间隔。针对不同的洗涤过程持续时间评估毛细管体积填充值。
matches.abstract_en: A hypothesis is proposed about the process of liquid filling the experimental closed tank (ECT) with a capillary in its wall, the appearance of which may be of manufacturing defects in the ECT walls and welded seams. The hypothesis allows for the wettability properties of the ECT wall material, the capillary effect (CE), liquid evaporation and the pressure difference between the ECT volume and the environment, as well as the duration of the process. Three options for supplying liquid to the ECT volume are considered. They correspond to the technological operations in the ECT manufacture: washing, hydraulic testing, and calibration. A physical–mathematical model (PMM) of heat and mass transfer and liquid dynamics in the ECT and a capillary is developed on the basis of the Navier–Stokes equations. The obtained PMM is used to construct a corresponding computer model (CM). On the example of the ECT washing, a numerical simulation of the process of liquid filling the capillary is carried out. The changes in the capillary volume being filled with liquid are determined with respect to time, including temperature, pressure, mass flow rate of viscous incompressible liquid at the ECT entrance, wettability of the ECT walls and the exposure time interval. The capillary volume filling value is assessed for different duration of the washing process.

matches.title: Polydisperse collision kernels in droplet-laden turbulence with implications for rain formation

matches.authors: Lukas A. Codispoti, Daniel W. Meyer, and Patrick Jenny
matches.abstract_zh: 湍流加速了暖云中液滴的生长，但可靠的碰撞核模型仍然难以捉摸；并且通常不考虑重力沉降之外的多分散性的影响。我们提供了 St ∈ [002_2] 上双分散碰撞核的综合图，并证明当前模型系统地过度预测了跨物种聚类。我们提出了一种紧凑的参数化方法，可以捕获雷诺数上的多分散碰撞，并表明在高耗散的地块中液滴的生长明显加速——支持湍流间歇性作为跨越暖雨瓶颈的可行途径。
matches.abstract_en: Turbulence accelerates droplet growth in warm clouds, but reliable collision-kernel models remain elusive; and the effect of polydispersity beyond gravitational settling is often not accounted for. We provide a comprehensive map of the bidisperse collision kernel across St ∈ [002_2] and demonstrate that current models systematically overpredict cross-species clustering. We propose a compact parameterization that captures polydisperse collisions across Reynolds numbers, and show that droplet growth is markedly accelerated in highly dissipative parcels—supporting turbulent intermittency as a viable pathway past the warm-rain bottleneck.

matches.title: Natural and mixed convection in a vertical rectangular duct under solar radiation
matches.title_zh: 太阳辐射下垂直矩形管道内的自然对流和混合对流
matches.abstract_zh: 该论文研究了暴露在太阳辐射下的垂直矩形管道中的自然对流和混合对流。所考虑的物理问题描述了从侧面照射的充满水的玻璃室中的流动和传热过程。由于水的吸收特性，近红外辐照度引发比尔-朗伯定律描述的不均匀体积热源。基于布辛涅斯克近似的纳维-斯托克斯方程和能量方程，建立了矩形管道中发达粘性流的数学问题。获得一系列新的精确解析解，其中包括考虑热源影响的项。评估了管道纵横比对温度场和速度场的影响。虽然自然对流总是可逆的，但在自由对流和强制对流相结合的情况下，导出了出现流动逆转的条件。确定流体动力和热特性，例如范宁摩擦系数、本体液体温度和壁上的努塞尔数。侧壁的影响随着长宽比的增加而减小，当管道足够窄时，流动的热特性接近于平面平行通道的相应值。
matches.abstract_en: The paper deals with natural and mixed convection in a vertical rectangular duct exposed to solar radiation. The physical problem under consideration describes flow and heat transfer processes in a water-filled glazing chamber irradiated from the side. Due to the absorption properties of water, the near-infrared irradiance initiates a non-uniform volumetric heat source described by the Beer-Lambert law. Based on the Navier-Stokes equations with Boussinesq approximation and the energy equation, a mathematical problem for well-developed viscous flows in a rectangular duct is formulated. New exact analytical solutions in series are obtained, which include terms accounting for the effect of the heat source. The influence of the duct aspect ratio on the temperature and velocity fields is evaluated. While natural convection flow is always reversible, in the case of combined free and forced convection, a condition for the appearance of flow reversal is derived. Hydrodynamic and thermal characteristics such as Fanning friction factor, bulk liquid temperature, and Nusselt numbers at the walls are determined. The influence of the lateral walls diminishes with the increase of the aspect ratio, and when the duct is sufficiently narrow, the thermal characteristics of the flow approach the corresponding values for a plane-parallel channel.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：heat transfer；期刊：Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Capillary Leidenfrost effect
matches.title_zh: 毛细管莱顿弗罗斯特效应
matches.abstract_zh: 莱顿弗罗斯特效应，最著名的是在液滴下方形成绝缘蒸汽层，延迟沸腾，为液滴操纵和减阻提供了巨大的潜力。然而，由于涉及复杂的液体动力学，调节传统的莱顿弗罗斯特效应仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种称为毛细管莱顿弗罗斯特效应的行为，它可以实现由液体蒸发驱动的稳定且持续的固体悬浮。它发生在低于其液滴对应物的莱顿弗罗斯特点的温度阈值，但不需要专门的表面制造技术。我们的结构由周期性排列的毛细管组成，可稳定液体界面，增强热传导并提供液体储存能力。毛细管莱顿弗罗斯特效应在广泛使用的天然材料和金属中很常见。我们的实验证明了长距离、持续的自推进和实际规模的负载输送的可行性。这种机制促进了从非接触式运输和减阻到恶劣环境下的长距离输送的潜在应用。如果表面足够热，液滴会形成一层绝缘蒸汽层，使其悬浮在表面上方，这就是所谓的莱顿弗罗斯特效应。现在，充满液体的毛细管的固体结构被证明可以在更低的温度下显示出这种悬浮效应。
matches.abstract_en: The Leidenfrost effect, best known as the formation of an insulating vapour layer beneath a liquid droplet that delays boiling, offers great potential for droplet manipulation and drag reduction. However, regulating the conventional Leidenfrost effect remains challenging due to the complex liquid dynamics involved. Here we report a behaviour that we term the capillary Leidenfrost effect, which enables stable and sustained solid levitation driven by liquid evaporation. It occurs at a temperature threshold that is below the Leidenfrost point of its droplet counterpart, yet without the need for specialized surface manufacturing techniques. Our structure is composed of periodically arranged capillaries that stabilize the liquid interface, enhance heat conduction and provide liquid storage capacities. The capillary Leidenfrost effect is generic in widely accessible natural materials and metals. Our experiments demonstrate the feasibility of long-distance, sustained self-propulsion and load delivery on a practical scale. This mechanism facilitates potential applications from contactless transportation and drag reduction to extended-distance delivery in harsh environments. If a surface is hot enough, a liquid droplet can develop an insulating vapour layer that makes it levitate above the surface, which is known as the Leidenfrost effect. A solid structure of liquid-filled capillaries is now shown to display this levitating effect at much lower temperatures.

matches.title: Microbubble elevator induced buoyancy oscillations of reacting droplets
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: Autonomous droplet oscillations are intriguing and provide a strong inspiration for the development of active soft matter. However, they are often limited by their reliance on external gradients and slow transport. Here, we demonstrate a propulsion mechanism driven by confined interfacial reactions: the hydrogen microbubble elevator. We show that hydrogen evolution within a liquid organic hydrogen carrier (LOHC) droplet and the resulting bubble pinch off modulate the droplet’s effective density, inducing periodic rising and sinking cycles in a stratified fluid. These droplets reach peak velocities of up to 25 mm/s over 2.5 cm trajectories - three orders of magnitude faster than typical Marangoni-driven bouncing - and sustain robust oscillatory motion for up to 25 minutes. The oscillation period and amplitude are programmable through the reaction kinetics, with motion persisting until the bubble-to-droplet size ratio exceeds a critical threshold. With a force balance model, we can quantitatively explain the experimental results and the interplay between gas evolution rates and hydrodynamic forces. Active soft matter systems, which convert free energy into mechanical work, face challenges in sustaining motion due to reliance on external gradients and slow transport mechanisms. This study introduces a propulsion mechanism using hydrogen microbubble elevators within reacting liquid organic hydrogen carrier droplets, achieving rapid and programmable buoyancy oscillations, significantly enhancing the distance and duration of autonomous droplet motion compared to traditional methods.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、Marangoni、interfacial；方法：experimental；降权方法：model；期刊：Nature Portfolio: Fluid dynamics

matches.title: Droplet removal by capillary lifting
matches.title_zh: 通过毛细管提升去除液滴
matches.abstract_zh: 从固体表面去除液滴对于清洁、涂层和石油回收至关重要。虽然二元流体系统中的去湿已被广泛研究，但涉及不混溶工作液体的三元系统中的去湿控制机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们表明，上升的工作液体可以通过毛细管将液滴提升到从固体表面延伸到空气界面的桥中，从而导致完全、部分或不去除液滴。我们的理论模型预测并且实验证实，可以通过控制液滴与固体的接触角以及系统中起作用的界面张力来调节液滴去除的有效性。值得注意的是，与使用表面活性剂降低界面张力的常见表面清洁策略相比，可以通过使用具有高界面张力的工作液体来增强去湿。我们的研究结果提出了液滴操纵的新途径，特别是在考虑到资源减少和更可持续的环境影响时。从固体表面有效去除液滴对于清洁、涂层和石油回收应用至关重要。在这里，作者表明，不混溶的工作液体可以毛细管将液滴提升到桥中，其去湿效率可以通过液滴接触角和界面张力进行调节，为基于表面活性剂的方法提供了可持续的替代方案，并为资源高效的液滴操纵开辟了新的可能性。
matches.abstract_en: The removal of liquid droplets from solid surfaces is central to cleaning, coatings and oil recovery. While dewetting in binary fluid systems has been widely studied, the mechanisms governing dewetting in ternary systems involving an immiscible working liquid remain poorly understood. Here we show that a rising working liquid can capillary lift droplets into bridges extending from the solid surface to the air interface, leading to full, partial, or no droplet removal. Our theoretical model predicts, and experiments confirm, that the effectiveness of droplet removal can be tuned by manipulating the droplet contact angle with the solid and the interfacial tensions at play in the system. Significantly, dewetting can be enhanced by employing working liquids with high interfacial tension, in contrast to common surface cleaning strategies where surfactants are used to reduce interfacial tension. Our findings suggest new avenues for droplet manipulation, especially if concerned with reduced resources and a more sustainable environmental impact. Efficient removal of liquid droplets from solid surfaces is crucial for applications in cleaning, coating, and oil recovery. Here, the authors show that immiscible working liquids can capillary lift droplets into bridges whose dewetting efficiency can be tuned via droplet contact angles and interfacial tensions, offering a sustainable alternative to surfactant-based methods and opening new possibilities for resource-efficient droplet manipulation.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、capillary、interfacial、interface；方法：experiments；降权方法：model；期刊：Nature Portfolio: Fluid dynamics

matches.title: Hydrodynamical pathways in the phase change of real fluids
matches.title_zh: 真实流体相变中的流体动力学路径
matches.abstract_zh: 确定液-汽转变的初始条件、形成的气泡数量、它们的时空尺度以及惯性的作用仍然是一个重大挑战，这反映出相变的早期阶段是多么难以捉摸。在这里，我们提出了一个理论框架，结合了大偏差理论、多相脉动流体力学和真实流体热力学来计算亚稳态液体中最可能的成核路径。我们确定了连接亚稳态和稳态的最佳轨迹，并确定了成核过程的完整时空结构。我们的结果表明，成核不仅受热力学作用，而且还受到波传播和惯性效应等流体动力学现象的影响。该方法预测了水、氮气和氦气的沸腾阈值，与实验一致。它提供了相变动力学的统一的预测性描述，将微观波动与宏观流体动力学可观测值联系起来，为相变的预测和控制开辟了道路。由于成核本质上是一种罕见的多尺度过程，因此对液-汽相变的初始阶段仍然知之甚少。在这里，作者开发了一个理论框架，集成了大偏差理论、多相脉动流体力学和流体热力学来计算流体中最可能的成核路径，并通过准确预测水、氮和氦的沸腾阈值来验证它。
matches.abstract_en: Identifying the incipient conditions of liquid-vapour transformation, the number of bubbles formed, their spatiotemporal scales, and the role of inertia remains a major challenge, reflecting how elusive the early stages of phase change are. Here, we present a theoretical framework that combines large deviation theory, multiphase fluctuating hydrodynamics and real fluid thermodynamics to compute the most probable nucleation pathways in metastable liquids. We identify the optimal trajectories connecting metastable and stable states and determine the full spatiotemporal structure of the nucleation process. Our results reveal that nucleation is not solely governed by thermodynamic forces, but is also shaped by hydrodynamic phenomena such as wave propagation and inertial effects. The approach predicts boiling thresholds for water, nitrogen, and helium, in agreement with experiments. It provides a unified, predictive description of phase-change kinetics linking microscopic fluctuations to macroscopic hydrodynamic observables, opening routes to prediction and control of phase change. Incipient stages of liquid-vapour phase change remain poorly understood because nucleation is an intrinsically rare, multiscale process. Here, the authors develop a theoretical framework that integrates large deviation theory, multiphase fluctuating hydrodynamics, and fluid thermodynamics to compute the most probable nucleation pathways in fluids, and they validate it by accurately predicting boiling thresholds for water, nitrogen, and helium.

matches.title: Rational design of polymer film morphology via structure-performance linkage for enhanced condensation performance
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: Dropwise condensation is essential for heat transfer in power generation, thermal management, and water harvesting, yet remains limited by surface modifications that often fail to maximize the advantages of dropwise mode. Here, we develop a morphology-based design strategy using conformal, pinhole-free fluoropolymer films deposited by initiated chemical vapor deposition. By controlling film thickness and thermal annealing, we identify a structure–performance relationship linking nanoscale aggregate morphology, wettability, and condensation dynamics. Thin films (≤ 100 nm) contain smaller, more densely distributed aggregates and lower roughness than 500 nm films, resulting in higher nucleation densities. Thermal annealing increases crystalline ordering while reducing contact angle hysteresis, enabling droplet removal at smaller diameters. These coupled effects increase surface renewal by combining rapid droplet nucleation with frequent sweeping. Under pure-vapor conditions, the morphology-controlled films improve heat transfer by ~50% compared with hydrophobic self-assembled monolayers, providing design principles for polymer coatings in condensation-based thermal systems. Inducing dropwise condensation is critical for energy transfer applications, yet optimizing surface modifications remains challenging. Here, the authors enhance dropwise condensation by tuning the nanoscale morphology of fluoropolymer deposited via initiated chemical vapor deposition to promote both droplet nucleation and sweeping.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、condensation、heat transfer；期刊：Nature Portfolio: Soft materials

matches.title: Liquid droplet mops
matches.title_zh: 液滴拖把
matches.abstract_zh: 表面污染在各种工业系统中普遍存在，尤其是光伏系统，并会降低系统性能。清洁措施对于解决这一问题至关重要，但由于水利用效率低，清洁措施仍然需要大量用水，特别是在光伏领域。在这里，我们发现清洁效率非单调地取决于水滴能量，并且对于中间水滴能量值可以最大化，这可以用来提高表面清洁中的水利用效率。我们的实验和理论表明，颗粒去除机制受液滴冲击速度和颗粒-液滴界面相互作用的控制。这种机制能够从超疏水表面去除不同密度的污染物。利用这一机制，我们开发了“液滴拖把”方法，可有效清洁超疏水涂层太阳能电池板，去除率达到 99.9%，而耗水量仅为标准液体喷射器的 10%。我们的研究结果不仅增进了对表面清洁的基本理解，而且还为缺水环境下的表面清洁提供了一种简单而有效的节水策略。各种工业系统都需要表面清洁，但由于水利用效率低，仍然需要大量用水。这项研究提出了一种方法——液滴拖把——可以有效地清洁超疏水涂层的太阳能电池板，同时大大减少水的消耗。
matches.abstract_en: Surface contamination is pervasive across various industrial systems, especially photovoltaic systems, and degrades system performance. Cleaning practices are essential to tackle this problem but remain water intensive due to low water utilization efficiency, particularly in photovoltaic fields. Here we found that cleaning efficiency depends non-monotonically on the water droplet energy and can be maximized for intermediate droplet energy values, which can be utilized to improve water utilization efficiency in surface cleaning. Our experiments and theory demonstrate that particulate removal mechanisms are governed by droplet impact velocity and particle–droplet interfacial interactions. This mechanism enables removal of contaminants with varied densities from superhydrophobic surfaces. Leveraging this mechanism, we developed the ‘liquid droplet mops’ method to efficiently clean superhydrophobic-coated solar panels, achieving 99.9% removal with only 10% of the water consumption of standard liquid jets. Our findings not only advance the fundamental understanding of surface cleaning but also offer a simple yet efficient water-saving strategy for surface cleaning in the water-scarcity context. Surface cleaning is needed in various industrial systems but remains water intensive due to low water utilization efficiency. This study proposes a method—liquid droplet mops—that can efficiently clean superhydrophobic-coated solar panels with substantially reduced water consumption.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、interfacial；方法：experiments

matches.title: Slippery hydrophilic radiative cooling surfaces for optimal dew condensation and collection
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: Atmospheric water harvesting is a promising approach for potable water generation, particularly in dry landlocked environments, but high energy costs for condensation and capture remain a fundamental impediment. Passive radiative cooling offers an attractive alternative, cooling surfaces below the dew point without active energy input. However, experimental performance has been limited, with both condensation and collection of dew on radiative cooling surfaces remaining challenging. Here, we introduce a slippery hydrophilic radiative cooling surface that through its high infrared emissivity enables effective sub-ambient cooling, and through its surface wettability optimizes both condensation and collection of atmospheric water. In addition, we demonstrate a vertically oriented device architecture that allows for optimizing convection, collecting 25 g/m² of atmospheric water over 6 h of outdoor nighttime testing at relative humidities of 65% and 45 g/m²/h at relative humidities of 95%. We also develop a model that accurately predicts system performance and show that our approach enables water generation and collection approaching the thermodynamic limit of radiative cooling-driven dew condensation. These results highlight the potential of passive radiative cooling as a practical, cost-effective technology for water generation worldwide. Extracting water from the atmosphere is a promising way to obtain potable water in dry, landlocked environments, but high energy costs for condensation and capture remain a key barrier. Here, the authors introduce a slippery, hydrophilic radiative-cooling surface that enables sub-ambient cooling via high infrared emissivity and optimizes both condensation and collection of atmospheric water through its wettability.

matches.title: Multicomponent Betti reaction affords covalent organic framework nanoreactor for palladium-catalyzed nitroarene reduction
matches.title_zh: 多组分 Betti 反应为钯催化硝基芳烃还原提供共价有机骨架纳米反应器
matches.abstract_zh: 多组分反应 (MCR) 为复杂分子结构提供了可持续且有效的途径。在这里，我们展示了通过一锅三组分溶剂热 Betti 反应设计和合成 α-氨基（2-羟基苄基）连接的共价有机框架（Betti-COF）。该方法通过引入高度有序的晶体框架的多组分途径而无需逐步连接构建，从而扩展了基于 MCR 的 COF 合成策略的范围。所得的 s-Betti-COF 表现出独特的空心球形形态、高热稳定性和坚固的孔隙率。该框架为将小钯纳米颗粒（1-2 nm）固定在其孔内以形成 s-Betti-COF 纳米复合材料提供了理想的支持。通过 FT-IR、DNP 增强 13C CP-MAS NMR、DNP 增强 15N CP-MAS NMR、XRD、HR-TEM、FE-SEM、EDS、XPS 和氮物理吸附分析对制备的样品进行了表征。包括哈米特分析在内的动力学研究支持涉及阴离子中间体的反应机制。本研究介绍了 Betti 反应作为构建功能性 COF 的合成工具，并将这些材料确立为用于多相催化的高效纳米反应器。多组分反应为结晶多孔材料的构建提供了可持续且有效的途径。在这里，作者利用一锅三组分 Betti 反应合成新型共价有机框架，并证明了其作为钯催化硝基芳烃还原的强大纳米反应器的潜力。
matches.abstract_en: Multicomponent reactions (MCRs) offer a sustainable and efficient pathway to complex molecular architectures. Here, we show the design and synthesis of a α-amino(2-hydroxybenzyl)-linked covalent organic framework (Betti-COF) via a one-pot, three-component solvothermal Betti reaction. This approach expands the scope of the MCR-based COF synthesis strategies by introducing a multicomponent pathway to highly ordered crystalline frameworks without the need for step-by-step linkage construction. The resulting s-Betti-COF exhibits a distinct hollow spherical morphology, high thermal stability, and robust porosity. This framework provides ideal support for the immobilization of small palladium nanoparticles (1-2 nm) within its pores to form the s-Betti-COF nanocomposite. The prepared samples were characterized by FT-IR, DNP-enhanced 13C CP-MAS NMR, DNP-enhanced 15N CP-MAS NMR, XRD, HR-TEM, FE-SEM, EDS, XPS, and nitrogen physisorption analysis. Kinetic investigations, including Hammett analysis, support a reaction mechanism involving an anionic intermediate. This study introduces the Betti reaction as a synthetic tool for constructing functional COFs and establishes these materials as highly effective nanoreactors for heterogeneous catalysis. Multicomponent reactions offer a sustainable and efficient pathway for the construction of crystalline porous materials. Here, the authors exploit a one-pot, three-component Betti reaction in the synthesis of a novel covalent organic framework and demonstrate its potential as a robust nanoreactor for the palladium-catalyzed reduction of nitroarenes.

matches.title: Mechanically adaptive crack-resistant hydrogels based on strain-induced macroscopic phase separation and hierarchical energy dissipation
matches.title_zh: 基于应变诱导宏观相分离和分级能量耗散的机械自适应抗裂水凝胶
matches.abstract_zh: 同时实现水凝胶的高刚度、大延伸性和强抗裂纹扩展能力仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们报道了一种水凝胶，它经历了完全可逆的应变诱导的增白转变，具有高模量（~30 MPa）、高拉伸强度（~15 MPa）、大拉伸性（> 1000%）。重要的是，水凝胶实现了约 100 kJ m−2 的优异断裂韧性，并表现出在负载下自主抑制裂纹扩展的能力。该水凝胶由强聚阳离子和弱聚阴离子以不对称摩尔比构建，产生透明且最初各向同性的网络，其中包含富含离子键和富含氢键的纳米域。原位 X 射线散射测量与分子动力学模拟相结合，揭示了拉伸变形下的多尺度结构转变。具体来说，富含氢键的软域的产生增强了域间对比度，引起白化，以及富含离子键的域的定向和适应性解离。该过程形成扩展的各向异性耗散区，从而有效地钝化和阻止裂纹。这项工作展示了成分不对称性如何使宏观均匀透明的水凝胶在应变下自主演化各向异性能量耗散路径，为创建适用于极端机械环境的耐损伤软材料提供了有效的策略。在水凝胶中实现刚度、延展性和抗裂纹扩展性的结合是理想的，但具有挑战性。在这里，作者报道了一种通过结合强聚阳离子和弱聚阴离子而具有应变诱导转变的水凝胶，该水凝胶具有良好的特性。
matches.abstract_en: It remains a significant challenge to simultaneously achieve high stiffness, large extensibility, and strong resistance to crack propagation in hydrogels. Here, we report a hydrogel that undergoes a fully reversible strain-induced whitening transition with a high modulus ( ~ 30 MPa), high tensile strength (~15 MPa), large stretchability ( > 1000%). Importantly, the hydrogel achieves an exceptional fracture toughness around 100 kJ m−2 and exhibits the ability to autonomously suppress crack growth under load. The hydrogel is constructed from a strong polycation and a weak polyanion at an asymmetric molar ratio, producing a transparent and initially isotropic network containing ionic-bond-rich and hydrogen-bond-rich nanodomains. In situ X-ray scattering measurements, combined with molecular dynamics simulations, reveal a multiscale structural transition under tensile deformation. Specifically, yielding of the hydrogen-bond-rich soft domains enhances interdomain contrast, inducing whitening, together with orientation and adaptive dissociation of ionic-bond-rich domains. This process forms an extended anisotropic dissipative zone, thus effectively blunting and arresting cracks. This work demonstrates how compositional asymmetry enables a macroscopically uniform and transparent hydrogel to autonomously evolve anisotropic energy-dissipation pathways under strain, providing an efficient strategy for creating damage-tolerant soft materials for extreme mechanical environments. Achieving a combination of stiffness, extensibility and resistance to crack propagation in hydrogels is desirable but challenging. Here, the authors report a hydrogel with a strain-induced transition with favourable properties by combining a strong polycation and a weak polyanion.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：phase separation；降权方法：simulations；期刊：Nature Portfolio: Soft materials

matches.title: Interfacial-Thermo-Fluid-Adhesion Dynamics of Evaporating Capillary Bridges between Curved Surfaces
matches.authors: Arnov Paul, Subhadeep Mondal, Purbarun Dhar
matches.abstract_zh: 翻译失败：HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests
matches.abstract_en: We probe the evaporation mechanism, and the associated adhesion dynamics of liquid capillary bridges connecting two curved, solid substrates. The coupled thermo fluid species transport and the transient evolution of capillary adhesion during evaporation are systematically examined. An accurate, fully coupled transient numerical framework is developed, wherein the equilibrium capillary profiles are first determined from level set method. Next, the evaporation is simulated via Arbitrary Lagrangian Eulerian ALE framework to accurately track the moving liquid vapor interface. The combined influence of substrate curvature, surface wettability, and solid thermal conductivity on evaporation and capillary adhesion character is comprehensively analysed. The simulation methodology is robustly validated against published literature for capillary profiles, evaporation rates, and capillary forces, demonstrating good agreement. Our results reveal that the evaporation characteristics of both hydrophilic and superhydrophobic SH liquid bridges are strongly governed by substrate curvature and thermal conductivity, and increasing values pose favourable condition for augmented interfacial mass transfer rate. The innately non uniform vapour flux generates spatially varying evaporative cooling, producing surface tension gradients that drive internal thermo capillary circulation. A non dimensional scaling analysis shows that Marangoni flow dominates buoyancy induced flow throughout. Also, increasing substrate curvature decreases the overall capillary force, owing to the reduced curvatures of the liquid bridge, while the temporal evolution of the adhesion force is strongly influenced by both substrate curvature and wettability.

matches.title: An integral surface tension scheme for three-dimensional front tracking frameworks
matches.title_zh: 三维前沿跟踪框架的积分表面张力方案
matches.authors: Gabriele Gennari, Berend van Wachem
matches.abstract_zh: 表面张力是许多两相流的核心，因此准确的数值方案对于预测其影响至关重要。 Popinet 和 Zaleski (1999) 引入的积分公式提供了一种自然的离散化，可以在局部和全局上保存动量，并直接扩展到可变的表面张力，包括 Marangoni 流。然而，据作者所知，仅报道了二维公式，主要是因为三维的稳健实现对于具有复杂几何形状的界面具有挑战性。这项工作提出了第一个三维积分表面张力方案，在尖锐的前跟踪框架内实现。该方法针对静态和平移球形液滴、振荡液滴、热毛细管运动和上升气泡进行了测试。将结果与解析解、实验数据和既定方法（包括连续表面力 (CSF) 和基于平滑的方法）进行比较。所提出的方案产生与 CSF 相当的杂散速度，同时在所有其他测试中提供更高的准确性。最大的改进发生在低 Ohnesorge 数下振荡的液滴、可变表面张力流以及强烈变形的上升气泡。对于热毛细管驱动的液滴，相对于基于平滑的方法，终端速度误差最多减少五个数量级。预测的上升气泡的稳态形状也与实验吻合得更好，特别是在莫顿数较低的情况下。
matches.abstract_en: Surface tension is central to many two-phase flows, making accurate numerical schemes essential for predicting its effects. The integral formulation introduced by Popinet and Zaleski (1999) provides a natural discretisation that conserves momentum locally and globally and extends directly to variable surface tension, including Marangoni flows. However, to the authors' knowledge, only two-dimensional formulations have been reported, mainly because robust implementation in three dimensions is challenging for interfaces with complex geometries. This work presents the first three-dimensional integral surface tension scheme, implemented within a sharp front-tracking framework. The method is tested for static and translating spherical droplets, oscillating droplets, thermocapillary motion, and rising bubbles. Results are compared with analytical solutions, experimental data, and established approaches, including the continuous surface force (CSF) and smoothing-based methods. The proposed scheme produces spurious velocities comparable to CSF, while providing greater accuracy in all other tests. The largest improvements occur for droplets oscillating at low Ohnesorge numbers, variable-surface-tension flows, and strongly deforming rising bubbles. For a thermocapillary-driven droplet, terminal-velocity errors are reduced by up to five orders of magnitude relative to smoothing-based methods. The predicted steady-state shapes of rising bubbles also agree substantially better with experiments, particularly at low Morton numbers.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、Marangoni、Marangoni flows、thermocapillary、surface tension；方法：experimental、experiments；期刊：arXiv: Fluid Dynamics

matches.title: Translation dynamics of evaporating sessile binary-mixture droplet populations
matches.title_zh: 蒸发固着二元混合物液滴群的平移动力学
matches.authors: Debarshi Debnath, Anna Malachtari, George Karapetsas, Daniel Orejon, Khellil Sefiane, Alidad Amirfazli, Omar K. Matar, Prashant Valluri
matches.abstract_zh: 从理论上研究了两个二元混合物液滴的平移动力学，并通过实验得到了证实。所提出的模型考虑了蒸发冷却和浓度梯度以及蒸汽扩散对二元混合物的两种成分产生的马兰戈尼应力的影响。我们考虑薄液滴，使我们能够使用润滑理论来推导液滴轮廓的演化方程。我们使用有限元方法对演化方程进行数值求解，并检查纯液滴对和二元液滴对表现出吸引、排斥和“追逐”等平移行为的各种情况。结果表明，溶液Marangoni、毛细管效应和热Marangoni的综合作用决定了液滴的运动。 “蒸汽屏蔽”产生的不均匀蒸发会产生这种效应。我们观察到，对于具有相同初始成分的液滴，溶质马兰戈尼和毛细力会引起液滴吸引力，而热马兰戈尼效应则驱动它们的排斥。对于具有不同初始成分的液滴，具有较高浓度的易挥发组分的液滴会推动或“追逐”具有较低初始浓度的该组分的液滴，完全由溶液马兰戈尼驱动。我们进行了涉及水-吗啉二元混合物液滴的实验，以验证我们的模型预测的结果。
matches.abstract_en: The translation dynamics of two binary mixture droplets is investigated theoretically and is corroborated with experiments. The proposed model accounts for the effects of Marangoni stresses generated by evaporative cooling and concentration gradients, as well as vapour diffusion, for both components of the binary mixture. We consider thin droplets, allowing us to use the lubrication theory to derive the evolution equation for the droplet profiles. We numerically solve the evolution equations using the finite element method and examine various cases of pure and binary droplet pairs exhibiting translational behaviours like attraction, repulsion, and 'chasing'. The results show that the combined effect of solutal Marangoni, capillary effect, and thermal Marangoni determines the movement of the droplets. The non-uniform evaporation generated from 'vapour shielding' creates such effects. We observe that for droplets with the same initial composition, solutal Marangoni and capillary forces induce droplet attraction, while thermal Marangoni effects drive their repulsion. For droplets with different initial compositions, the drop with a higher concentration of the more volatile component pushes, or `chases', the drop with a lower initial concentration of this component, completely driven by the solutal Marangoni. We carried out experiments involving water-morpholine binary mixture droplets to validate the results predicted by our model.

matches.title: Motile Escherichia coli-laden Droplets Exhibit Reduced Adhesion and Anomalous Wetting Behavior
matches.title_zh: 充满运动大肠杆菌的液滴表现出粘附力降低和异常润湿行为
matches.authors: Sirshendu Misra, Sudip Shyam, Priyam Chakraborty, Sushanta K. Mitra
matches.abstract_zh: 假设：表面的细菌污染对公众健康构成重大威胁。设计有效的抗菌或自清洁表面需要了解载有细菌的液滴如何与固体基质相互作用以及它们如何容易被去除。我们假设细菌运动严重影响载有细菌的液滴的早期表面相互作用（即表面粘附），而传统的接触角测角法无法捕获这种相互作用。实验：研究了含有活和死大肠杆菌（E. coli）的固着液滴，以探究它们的润湿和界面行为。接触角测角法用于探测动态润湿，而基于悬臂梁偏转的方法用于量化粘附力。使用微粒图像测速（PIV）对内部流动动力学进行可视化并进行统计分析。在适度润湿的基底上进行补充滑动实验，以评估倾斜下的接触线移动性。研究结果：尽管表面张力较低，但含有活细菌的液滴表现出比死细菌更低的表面粘附力，并且在细菌浓度较高时粘附力进一步降低。 Micro-PIV显示，有鞭毛的活大肠杆菌通过上游迁移主动抵抗蒸发驱动的毛细管流，而在较高浓度下，出现集体动力学，尽管时间变化，但产生空间连贯的细菌运动。这些协调的流动会破坏被动运输并促进接触线的脱钉，从而减少粘附。滑动实验证实，即使在后退接触角较低和滞后较高的情况下，活动液滴中的接触线移动性也有所增强，并且频繁的粘滑运动。这些发现提供了对液滴保留的机制见解，为自清洁/防污表面的设计提供了信息。
matches.abstract_en: Hypothesis: Bacterial contamination of surfaces poses a major threat to public health. Designing effective antibacterial or self-cleaning surfaces requires understanding how bacteria-laden droplets interact with solid substrates and how readily they can be removed. We hypothesize that bacterial motility critically influences the early-stage surface interaction (i.e., surface adhesion) of bacteria-laden droplets, which cannot be captured by conventional contact angle goniometry. Experiments: Sessile droplets containing live and dead Escherichia coli (E. coli) were studied to probe their wetting and interfacial behavior. Contact angle goniometry was used to probe dynamic wetting, while a cantilever-deflection-based method was used to quantify adhesion. Internal flow dynamics were visualized using micro-particle image velocimetry (PIV) and analyzed statistically. Complementary sliding experiments on moderately wettable substrates were performed to assess contact line mobility under tilt. Findings: Despite lower surface tension, droplets containing live bacteria exhibited lower surface adhesion forces than their dead counterparts, with adhesion further decreasing at higher bacterial concentrations. Micro-PIV revealed that flagellated live E. coli actively resist evaporation-driven capillary flow via upstream migration, while at higher concentrations, collective dynamics emerge, producing spatially coherent bacterial motion despite temporal variability. These coordinated flows disrupt passive transport and promote depinning of the contact line, thereby reducing adhesion. Sliding experiments confirmed enhanced contact line mobility and frequent stick-slip motion in live droplets, even with lower receding contact angles and higher hysteresis. These findings provide mechanistic insight into droplet retention, informing the design of self-cleaning/antifouling surfaces.
