matches.title: Active motility and wetting cooperatively regulate liquid-liquid phase separation
matches.title_zh: 主动运动和润湿协同调节液-液相分离
matches.authors: Dixi Yang, Anheng Wang, Chunming Wang, Hajime Tanaka, Jiaxing Yuan
matches.abstract_zh: 水两相系统中的液-液相分离是物理和生物科学的基础。虽然人们对被动混合物有了很好的了解，但它如何受到运动细菌等活性物质的调节仍然很大程度上未被探索。通过将右旋糖酐-聚乙二醇混合物中的铜绿假单胞菌实验与流体动力学模拟相结合，我们发现细菌活性和界面润湿之间的耦合将自推进转化为机械有效的界面应力，产生一系列稳健的形态，包括自旋液滴、拉长的液滴链和分支毛细管状簇。更重要的是，它赋予活性双重动力学作用：活性通过旋转引起的流体动力排斥抑制液滴状态的粗化，但当葡聚糖为少数相时加速粗化，其中润湿介导的吸引力驱动聚集。为了探讨这一机制的生物学相关性，我们进一步证明生物膜相关蛋白可以充当界面“润湿胶”，即使在稀悬浮液中也能促进细菌聚集。我们的研究结果建立了活性-润湿耦合，而不是单独的活性或润湿，作为主动运动调节模式形态和粗化动力学的机制，并揭示了增强稀悬浮液中细菌聚集的物理途径。
matches.abstract_en: Liquid--liquid phase separation in aqueous two-phase systems is fundamental across physical and biological sciences. While well understood for passive mixtures, how it is regulated by active agents such as motile bacteria remains largely unexplored. By combining experiments on Pseudomonas aeruginosa in a dextran--polyethylene glycol mixture with hydrodynamic simulations, we show that the coupling between bacterial activity and interfacial wetting converts self-propulsion into mechanically effective interfacial stresses, giving rise to a robust sequence of morphologies, including self-spinning droplets, elongated droplet chains, and branched capillary-like clusters. More importantly, it gives activity a dual kinetic role: activity suppresses coarsening in the droplet regime through rotation-induced hydrodynamic repulsion, but accelerates coarsening when dextran is the minority phase, where wetting-mediated attraction drives aggregation. To probe the biological relevance of this mechanism, we further show that a biofilm-associated protein can act as an interfacial ``wetting glue,'' promoting bacterial clustering even in dilute suspensions. Our findings establish activity--wetting coupling, rather than activity or wetting alone, as a mechanism by which active motility regulates pattern morphology and coarsening dynamics, and reveal a physical route to enhancing bacterial aggregation from dilute suspensions.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets、phase separation、liquid-liquid phase separation、capillary、interfacial、wetting；方法：experiments；降权方法：simulations；期刊：arXiv: Soft Condensed Matter

matches.title: Shear-driven dynamics of surfactant-laden droplets on rough substrates
matches.title_zh: 粗糙基材上负载表面活性剂的液滴的剪切驱动动力学
matches.authors: Ninad Vinayak Mhatre, Satish Kumar
matches.abstract_zh: 由于周围不混溶流体的流动而导致的液滴脱钉在提高石油采收率、表面清洁和错流乳化等应用中起着至关重要的作用。尽管这些系统中经常存在表面活性剂，但马兰戈尼应力对外部流导致的液滴脱钉的作用仍不清楚。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种基于润滑理论的模型，用于在具有高斯形缺陷的基材上负载不溶性表面活性剂的薄牛顿液滴，该缺陷用于解释表面粗糙度的影响。液滴在狭长的矩形通道中被不含表面活性剂的不混溶牛顿流体包围，流动由施加的压力梯度驱动。使用前体膜/分离压力方法进行接触线运动，我们推导了液滴厚度和界面表面活性剂浓度的非线性演化方程，并进行了数值求解。压力梯度将表面活性剂从后退接触线输送到前进接触线，产生与压力驱动流相反的马兰戈尼流。这减少了液滴上的净剪切力，导致在更高的临界压力梯度下脱钉。这些发现揭示了一种先前未经检验的机制，其中界面马兰戈尼应力，而不是均匀的界面张力降低，控制着临界流速。结果为使用表面活性剂浓度梯度作为可调手柄来控制粗糙基材上的液滴运动提供了机械基础。
matches.abstract_en: The depinning of liquid droplets due to flow of a surrounding immiscible fluid plays a crucial role in applications such as enhanced oil recovery, surface cleaning, and crossflow emulsification. Although surfactants are often present in these systems, the role of Marangoni stresses on droplet depinning by an external flow remains unclear. To address this, we develop a lubrication-theory-based model for a thin Newtonian droplet laden with insoluble surfactant on a substrate with Gaussian-shaped defects which are used to account for the effects of surface roughness. The droplet is surrounded by a surfactant-free immiscible Newtonian fluid in a long, narrow rectangular channel, with flow driven by an applied pressure gradient. Using a precursor-film/disjoining-pressure approach for contact-line motion, we derive nonlinear evolution equations for the droplet thickness and interfacial surfactant concentration, which are solved numerically. The pressure gradient transports surfactant from the receding to the advancing contact line, generating a Marangoni flow opposing the pressure-driven flow. This reduces the net shear force on the droplet, leading to depinning at a higher critical pressure gradient. These findings reveal a previously unexamined regime in which interfacial Marangoni stresses, rather than uniform interfacial-tension reduction, govern the critical flow rate. The results provide a mechanistic basis for using surfactant-concentration gradients as a tunable handle to control droplet motion on rough substrates.

matches.title: Real-time quantification of fluid flows around bubbles during directional solidification
matches.title_zh: 定向凝固过程中气泡周围流体流动的实时量化
matches.authors: Bastien Isabella, Emma Houllegatte, C\'ecile Monteux, Sylvain Deville
matches.abstract_zh: 气泡液体的定向凝固在塑造许多材料的微观结构和性能方面发挥着关键作用，但对凝固过程中控制气泡行为的流体动力学仍然知之甚少。使用冷冻共聚焦显微镜和粒子图像测速技术，我们量化了含有表面活性剂和示踪剂的水凝固过程中气泡周围的流体流动。我们的结果表明，体积膨胀主导流体运动，速度与凝固速率成线性比例（1-20$~\mu m/s$），而马兰戈尼流动（假设发挥关键作用）在我们的实验条件下可以忽略不计（$< 5~\mu m/s$）。扩散电泳和热泳的贡献也很小。这些发现挑战了现有的理论模型，并为控制凝固材料中的气泡分布提供了框架
matches.abstract_en: Directional solidification of bubbly liquids plays a critical role in shaping the microstructure and properties of many materials, yet the fluid dynamics governing bubble behavior during solidification remain poorly understood. Using cryo-confocal microscopy and particle image velocimetry, we quantify fluid flows around bubbles during solidification of water containing surfactants and tracers. Our results reveal that volumetric expansion dominates fluid motion, with velocities scaling linearly with the solidification rate (1-20$~\mu m/s$), while Marangoni flows-hypothesized to play a key role-are negligible ($< 5~\mu m/s$) under our experimental conditions. Diffusiophoresis and thermophoresis also contribute minimally. These findings challenge existing theoretical models and provide a framework for controlling bubble distribution in solidified materials
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：solidification、Marangoni、Marangoni flows；方法：experimental；降权方法：models

matches.title: Meltwater transport and mixing layer growth near the ice--ocean interface
matches.title_zh: 冰-海界面附近的融水输送和混合层生长
matches.authors: Sof\'ia Allende, Louis-Alexandre Couston, Simon Thalabard, Benjamin Favier
matches.abstract_zh: 冰融化成盐水对于极地海洋冰海界面附近的动力学起着重要作用。冰融化的物理学涉及界面热力学、整体流体动力传输和周围海洋特性之间的重要相互作用。关键控制参数是与环境海洋盐度成正比的密度比 $R_\rho$ 和路易斯数 $Le = \kappa_T/\kappa_S$，它比较热扩散率和盐扩散率。众所周知，增加盐度会减慢融化速度，随着 $R_\rho$ 的增加，融化速率会从次扩散转变为扩散。在这里，我们使用具有缓慢熔化上边界的二维 Boussinesq 方程的高分辨率数值模拟来评估湍流在这一转变中的作用。我们分析了温度和融水混合层的非平稳增长，改变了路易斯数和密度比。虽然融水不断地被主体内部的对流夹带，但我们在界面附近发现了从对流到扩散的转变。这种转变通过界面边界层的形成来反映，该界面边界层调节流入湍流体的融水通量 $R_\rho \gtrsim 10$。使用基于融水浓度阈值的混合层诊断，我们观察到湍流层以超扩散的方式增长$\propto t^{1.33}$，而界面边界层以扩散的方式扩展$\propto t^{0.5}$，但具有非通用的前因子。这些结果表明，双扩散效应仅限于界面，并突出了海洋学应用中基于固定浓度阈值的诊断的潜在局限性。
matches.abstract_en: Ice melting into saline water plays a fundamental role in the dynamics near the ice-ocean interface in polar oceans. The physics of ice melting involves a non-trivial interplay between thermodynamics at the interface, hydrodynamic transport in the bulk and the properties of the ambient ocean. The key control parameters are the density ratio $R_\rho$ proportional to the ambient ocean salinity and the Lewis number $Le = \kappa_T/\kappa_S$, which compares the thermal and salt diffusivities. Increasing the salinity is known to slow down melting, with the melt rate transitioning from subdiffusive to diffusive as $R_\rho$ increases. Here, we ssess the role of turbulence in this transition, using highly-resolved numerical simulations of the two-dimensional Boussinesq equations with a slowly melting upper boundary. We analyse the non-stationary growth of the temperature and meltwater mixing layers, varying the Lewis number and the density ratio. While meltwater is continuously entrained by convection inside the bulk, we identify a transition from convection to diffusion close to the interface. This transition is reflected by the formation of an interfacial boundary layer that regulates the flux of meltwater pouring into the turbulent bulk for $R_\rho \gtrsim 10$. Using mixing-layer diagnostics based on meltwater-concentration thresholds, we observe that the turbulent layer grows super-diffusively $\propto t^{1.33}$, while the interfacial boundary layer expands diffusively $\propto t^{0.5}$ but with a non-universal prefactor. These results indicate that double-diffusive effects are here confined to the interface, and highlight potential limitations of diagnostics based on fixed concentration thresholds in oceanographic applications.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：ice、interfacial、interface、diffusion

matches.title: Marangoni-driven flower-like patterning of an evaporating drop spreading on a liquid substrate
matches.title_zh: 马兰戈尼驱动的蒸发液滴在液体基底上形成花状图案
matches.authors: F. Wodlei, J. Sebilleau, J. Magnaudet, V. Pimienta
matches.abstract_zh: 液体表面的液滴运动由于其在微流体和人造细胞设计中的潜在应用而引起了越来越多的兴趣。在这里，我们报告了当一毫米大小的二氯甲烷液滴在表面张力的影响下在水性基质上铺展时形成的独特的高度有序的图案，两相都含有表面活性剂。蒸发引起马兰戈尼流，迫使在铺展膜的外围形成明显的边缘。在某个时刻，该边缘破裂，产生一圈液滴，从而改变水相特性，从而使薄膜反冲。这个过程不断重复，产生有规律的大幅度脉动。由于蒸发不稳定性，薄膜表面会形成皱纹。在去湿阶段，它们发射出等间距的径向液滴串，这些液滴与先前从边缘排出的液滴结合在一起，使系统的俯视图像一朵花。
matches.abstract_en:
Abstract
            Drop motility at liquid surfaces is attracting growing interest because of its potential applications in microfluidics and artificial cell design. Here we report the unique highly ordered pattern that sets in when a millimeter-size drop of dichloromethane spreads on an aqueous substrate under the influence of surface tension, both phases containing a surfactant. Evaporation induces a Marangoni flow that forces the development of a marked rim at the periphery of the spreading film. At some point this rim breaks up, giving rise to a ring of droplets, which modifies the aqueous phase properties in such a way that the film recoils. The process repeats itself, yielding regular large-amplitude pulsations. Wrinkles form at the film surface due to an evaporative instability. During the dewetting stage, they emit equally spaced radial strings of droplets which, combined with those previously expelled from the rim, make the top view of the system resemble a flower.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplets、drop、evaporation、evaporating、Marangoni、Marangoni flow、surface tension；期刊：Nature Communications

matches.title: The limit of droplet rebound angle
matches.title_zh: 液滴回弹角极限
matches.abstract_zh: 在自清洁、能量收集和微流体等许多领域中，调节液滴撞击固体表面后的运动状态至关重要。液滴的回弹角是决定其运动状态的关键因素。然而，到目前为止，液滴回弹角的极限仍不清楚。在这里，我们揭示了一种以前未被发现的液滴反弹行为，即液滴沿着表面快速滚动，反弹角接近0度，即液滴反弹角的极限。这种意想不到的行为源于液滴的行为就像两个相互垂直的弹簧，这是由异质改性纳米结构提供的连续不对称粘附力实现的。液滴的这种边界滚动行为有助于涉及液滴冲击的各个领域的科学和技术进步，例如增强的清洁效率（提高349%）和在曲折通道中良好控制的液滴传输的例子，这在没有外部场耦合的情况下很难实现。控制液滴撞击固体表面后的运动对于自清洁和微流体等应用至关重要，但液滴反弹角的基本限制仍然未知。这项研究揭示了液滴行为，它以接近零的回弹角快速滚动，定义了纳米结构表面上的不对称粘附所实现的下限，从而大大提高了清洁效率和精确的液滴传输。
matches.abstract_en: Regulating the motion state of droplets after impacting on solid surfaces is crucial in many fields including self-cleaning, energy harvesting, and microfluidics. The rebound angle of the droplet is a key factor in determining its motion state. However, up until now, the limit of droplet rebound angle remains unidentified. Here, we reveal a previously undiscovered droplet rebound behavior that the droplet rolls rapidly along the surface with a rebound angle close to 0 degrees, the limit of the droplet rebound angle. Such unexpected behavior originates from the droplet behaving like two mutually perpendicular springs enabled by continuous asymmetric adhesion provided by the heterogeneous modified nanostructure. This boundary-rolling behavior of droplets contributes to scientific and technical advances in various fields that involve droplet-impact, as illustrated through examples of enhanced cleaning efficiency (improved by 349%) and well-controlled droplet transport in tortuous passages which can hardly be achieved before without external fields coupling. Controlling droplet motion after impact on solid surfaces is crucial for applications like self-cleaning and microfluidics, yet the fundamental limit of the droplet rebound angle remains unknown. This study reveals a droplet behavior where it rapidly rolls with a rebound angle near zero, defining the lower limit, enabled by asymmetric adhesion on nanostructured surfaces, resulting in greatly enhanced cleaning efficiency and precise droplet transport.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：droplet、droplets；期刊：Nature Communications: Fluids

matches.title: Pattern formation in isothermal miscible protein-sugar systems driven by Marangoni effects and evaporation
matches.title_zh: 马兰戈尼效应和蒸发驱动的等温混溶蛋白-糖系统中的模式形成
matches.abstract_zh: 模式形成对于控制生命和合成活性系统中的流体运动和时空组织至关重要。虽然混溶流体系统中的模式形成通常是由反应扩散过程或热梯度驱动的，但我们展示了涉及简单蛋白质和糖溶液的等温混溶流体系统中的模式形成。将密度较低的脲酶溶液引入密度较高的葡萄糖或蔗糖溶液后，蛋白质最初在空气-水界面处扩散，然后在几分钟后形成螺旋图案。该机制涉及马兰戈尼效应、蒸发和气流之间的相互作用。我们的工作表明，可以通过用蒸发引起的不均匀性代替反应引起的不均匀溶质分布来复制反应扩散模式的形成。在这两种情况下，快速扩散或马兰戈尼扩散都会被逆转溶质均质化的较慢步骤所抵消。这些见解使得能够操纵流体运动和表面形态，并对涂层技术、材料科学和微流体学产生影响。混溶流体系统中的图案形成通常由反应扩散过程或热梯度驱动。这项研究证明了由蛋白质和糖溶液组成的等温混溶流体系统中图案的形成，是由马兰戈尼效应、蒸发和气流的相互作用产生的。
matches.abstract_en: Pattern formation is crucial for controlling fluid motion and spatiotemporal organization in living and synthetic active systems. While pattern formation in miscible fluid systems is typically driven by reaction-diffusion processes or thermal gradients, we show pattern formations in an isothermal miscible fluid system involving simple protein and sugar solutions. Upon introducing a less dense urease solution into higher density glucose or sucrose solutions, the protein initially spreads at the air-water interface, then forms spiral patterns after several minutes. The mechanism involves an interplay between Marangoni effects, evaporation, and airflow. Our work suggests that reaction-diffusion pattern formation can be replicated by replacing the reaction-induced inhomogeneous solute distribution by evaporation-induced inhomogeneity. In both cases, the fast diffusive or Marangoni spreading is counteracted by a slower step that reverses the solute homogenization. These insights enable the manipulation of fluid motion and surface morphology, with implications in coating technologies, materials science, and microfluidics. Pattern formation in miscible fluid systems is typically driven by reaction-diffusion processes or thermal gradients. This study demonstrates pattern formation in an isothermal miscible fluid system composed of protein and sugar solutions, resulting from the interplay of Marangoni effects, evaporation, and airflow.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：evaporation、Marangoni、interface；期刊：Communications Physics: Soft materials

matches.title: Free streamline detachment with surface tension: a conformal mapping-based numerical solution
matches.title_zh: 具有表面张力的自由流线分离：基于共形映射的数值解
matches.abstract_zh: 考虑表面张力的影响，考虑自由流线与光滑成形体的分离问题。假设流体是无粘性且不可压缩的，并且假设流动在身体固定框架中是无旋转且静止的。我们采用布里渊-维拉准则来确定自由流线脱离的位置。使用积分光刻法，我们推导了复速度和复势导数的表达式，两者都在辅助参数平面中定义。通过应用动态和运动学边界条件，导出了奇异积分方程组，该方程组以沿自由表面的速度大小和物体的斜率表示。数值方法非常高效，因为它只需要评估这两个非奇异函数。数值结果证明了表面张力对大范围韦伯数的自由流线分离、阻力和自由表面形状的影响。结果表明，由于分离点处流入速度大小的畸变，表面张力产生毛细波，毛细波沿自由流参考系中的自由流线传播。
matches.abstract_en: The problem of the detachment of a free streamline from a smoothly shaped body is considered taking into account the effect of surface tension. The fluid is assumed to be inviscid and incompressible, and the flow is assumed to be irrotational and stationary in the body-fixed frame. We employ the Brillouin-Villat criterion to determine the position of the free streamline detachment. Using the integral hodograph method, we derive expressions for the complex velocity and the derivative of the complex potential, both defined in an auxiliary parameter plane. A system of singular integral equations, formulated in terms of the velocity magnitude along the free surface and the slope of the body, is derived by applying the dynamic and kinematic boundary conditions. The numerical method is highly efficient, as it only requires the evaluation of these two nonsingular functions. Numerical results demonstrate the effect of surface tension on the free streamline detachment, the drag force and the free surface shape for a wide range of Weber numbers. It is shown that the surface tension generates capillary waves due to the distortion of the magnitude of the inflow velocity at the detachment point, which propagate along the free streamline in the freestream reference frame.
matches.reason: 核心兴趣：capillary、surface tension；期刊：Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics
